plan.verdict:
Tifo already has what no competitor has: its own look (night pitch, a stand of club-colour cards, the square card atom), a channel list per country, copy in dialect, and no betting. Right now it is losing trust faster than it earns love:
- A match page fires a false full-screen «هدف» when it opens.
- Prerendered scores are shown as live, and at kickoff the page still says «scheduled».
- The Gulf Cup has no channels outside the UAE.
- 161 future cards all open the same wrong match (/m/null/).
- Home-team lineup squares are invisible, and names are split to «الله حمد».
- Pages print «null», «undefined» and «club_19th_premier_league_match».
- The phone view is crowded: the hero match repeats 3–4 times on home, a scrolled match page stacks 4 bars, the share sheet has 13 rows and المزيد has 26.
- National content is hard-coded to the UAE on a site for all Arabs.
- On desktop the hero fills the whole screen, and prose runs about 110 characters a line.

All of this starts now. The waves set the order, not a delay:
- W1 stops the false and broken states. The static site fixes ship during tonight's match. poller.py (Lambda) and sw.js ship at full time.
- The order after that: W1 on main, then rebase v3, then merge items 387–403, then W2.2 with a screenshot diff of all 35 templates.
- W2 folds the site into one design system that follows the visitor's country.
- W3 adds features only Tifo has, built from the card atom, and removes more blocks than it adds.
- W4 is the long tail.

Build checks warn and strip; they never stop the hourly deploy.
plan.north_star: Open Tifo on your phone and see your match at a glance, in your country's time and on your country's channel, correct within seconds. The screen stays as calm as a stand at night until a goal. Then the whole stand raises its cards.
design_principles: Truth before beauty. A stale score, «null», Latin research notes or a wrong fact is worse than an empty space. Hide what we don't know («ما تأكدنا»). When data may be stale, dim it and show «آخر تحديث 22:14». Never hide the score, and never show old data as live.

One screen, one job. At 390×844 the first screen shows my match and the top of the next rail, above the tab bar. No match appears twice on a page. A page has at most 4 tabs, and they fit without clipping.

Each colour means one thing. Pulse is live, dune is mine or selected, yellow and red are cards. Everything else is chalk or concrete on night. A lint warns on misuse, and the runtime club theme never repaints dune.
The card atom is the only ornament. The mosaic appears only in heroes, the goal moment and share images. Chalk pitch lines are the only dividers. Scoreboard digits are for scores and times only.
Two motions, both answering an event: the split-flap score change and the goal stunt, plus page entry. No loops, no motion every minute, no invisible blurs. Reduced motion turns all of it off.
Country first. The visitor's country decides the hero, countdown, channels, shortcuts and sort order. Any time shown for a place names that place («العشاء في الرياض»). The UAE is one of 22.
Subtract before adding. Every new feature names its host (an existing slot, tab, tile or sheet). Each wave removes more blocks than it adds.
Arabic done properly. Counts agree («4 مباريات», «مرتين»), dates are in Arabic, and compound names stay whole. The copy is light Emirati per DESIGN-v3 §5.
Phone-native. Back closes overlays, sheets drag closed, tap targets are 44px, inputs are at least 16px, first load is 230KB or less, and nothing heavy runs on a 3GB phone.

Guards never stop a deploy (owner rule «العطب المجاور يُذكر ولا يحجز النشر»). A build check strips, unlinks or hides the problem and reports a count; it never exits 1 on the hourly deploy. Live infrastructure (the poller Lambda, sw.js) is never deployed during a match.

waves.name: Wave 1: Stop the lying (now)
waves.goal: Nothing on Tifo is false, stale data shown as live, raw text or a dead end. Static site fixes ship during tonight's match. poller.py (Lambda), sw.js and the watchdog deploy at full time. Every check warns and strips; none blocks the deploy.

items.title: Live freshness: no false goal, no stale live, no dead poll
items.detail:
(a) Stop seeding lastScore from the prerendered #msum (shell.js:181). The first tifo:match only seeds, so opening after a goal fires no «هدف».
(b) poller.py:317: use cache 'hot' for scheduled matches from kickoff−75min to +15min. 'warm' (300s + 60 SWR) keeps «scheduled» up to 6 min after kickoff.
(c) While live, the match page overlays score, minute and status from /v1/live.json (max-age 10, store.py:25) every 10s. The full match JSON stays on 20s. A goal shows in about 10–20s instead of about 60s.
(d) app.js:151-152: re-arm the poll in .catch with 20→40→60s backoff, and add .catch(poll) on home's first load. app.js:61/68/191: a failed day fetch keeps the prerendered list, shows «ما قدرنا نحدّث، نحاول مرة ثانية…» and retries in 30s.
(e) Stamp <html data-built>. When the page is more than 2 min old, a head script dims the live digits, minute and kicker and shows «آخر تحديث 22:14» until the first good poll. Never hide the score.
(f) Add daypage to run() (app.js:351).
(g) Live and md.generated older than 90s: show «الاتصال ضعيف · آخر تحديث 22:14».
(h) AC.resume() on first pointerdown when tifo.goalsnd=1 (shell.js:157).
Safety: (b) is a Lambda deploy, so it goes out at full time. Everything else is static.

(e) Build warning: list comps with a match in the next 72h and no row for a country.
(f) Kit page: drop the «القناة» column when no country has data.

items.title: Wrong match facts on tonight's pages
items.detail:
(a) gen.py:681-684: add venue_city and a neutral flag. PRE_SYS says neither side is at home. checks.py rejects أرضه, جمهوره and برا أرضه when neutral, plus «مب متوفرة», lines that repeat their own label, and «فوزه رقم 2». Regenerate /m/6052086/ («قطر… برا أرضه» is live now).
(b) Distance and «اطلع من بيتك» only when venue.in_uae (render.js:228, stats.js:334). venues.py:60 returns None outside the UAE. Foreign venues read «الملعب · جدة، السعودية».
(c) R.stats (render.js:201-207): count cards from md.events, drop 0|0 rows except possession, and hide «0 تبديلات» when coverage_events.subs is false.
(d) R.h2h (render.js:212): future meetings go under «الياية». insights.py:404-406: no first_meeting when h2h has meetings.
(e) Referee tables (stats.js:119, :377) use source_stats only when scope_comp == comp.
(f) Team report (stats.js:365-371): drop 0-goal lines, and write «في هالبطولة» for national teams.

items.title: Null match/referee ids: skip them
items.detail:
sources/uaepl.py:182 emits id:null for 140/182 ADNOC and 21/42 League Cup fixtures, so 23 round pages link to /m/null/. /r/null/ comes from referee tables.
- render.js:78: a non-link row «الموعد ما تأكد».

Safety: don't use ext_id as the id. It is 'uaepl:<uuid>', which puts colons into URLs and S3 keys, and the URL would change once FotMob publishes the real id. Mapping to FotMob ids is W4.9.

items.title: Colour-remap casualties: invisible squares, goals, tab indicator
items.detail:
build.cjs:166-167 sw('chalk','surf') turns chalk into #123A31 on a #0F3A2F pitch.
(1) Lineup squares: `.pl b{background:var(--chalk);color:var(--night)}` for both sides tonight. Club-colour squares wait for R.colOn (W2.3), because 267 of 698 club colours fall under 3:1 on night.
(2) `.tl .ev.goal,.tl .played{background:var(--chalk)}`, with the goal drawn as a larger chalk circle.
(3) Tab indicator: `.tabs [aria-selected=true]{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--dune)}` and drop the -2px margin (tifo.css:54-55).
(4) The Latin «PAR/BHR» chip becomes a flag (render.js:182, :247).
The regex itself is deleted in W2.2.

items.title: Pitch names: stop splitting Arabic compounds
items.detail:
surname() (render.js:183) drops the first token, which gives «الله الخلاصي», «الدين زهير» and «الله حمد».
For Arabic names only:
- Glue عبد, أبو, بن, ابن and آل to the next word.
- Glue any word to a following الله, الدين or الرحمن.
- Then show the last unit.
A name that is a single unit stays whole («لطف الله»). The Latin path is unchanged.

items.title: Raw text leaks + a warn-only guard
items.detail:
- «وين تنقل»: S.watchWhere (stats.js:302) prints x.package raw. Show it only when it contains Arabic letters. The same rule hides «Bus: yes» and the VVIP parking text on /watch/ and /s/*.
- Suspensions: srcs() uses u.url||u (stats.js:283). Build «عند الإنذار {n} = إيقاف {b}» properly and skip rules where ban is null. Map the until/reason keys (stats.js:615) and hide any unknown key.
- Records (stats.js:438): show a top 3 instead of «undefined». Pressure (stats.js:130): hide rows with a null index.
- Rounds: add a knockout map (1/8 دور الـ16 … final النهائي) before parseFloat. Use ASCII slugs with 301s.
- Groups: fix «المجموعة Grp». Letters become الأولى/الثانية (render.js:92), including the hero kicker «المجموعة B» (next_home_1440_s3c.png).
- stadiums.yaml: «ال نهيان» → «آل».
- Remove «ووش على المحك» (stats.js:49, glossary.js:21).
- Guard: scan visible text for null, undefined, [object Object] and known key prefixes (club_, last_day_, red_card_). Strip the node and log a count. No generic snake_case regex, because it matches slugs and Latin names.
Safety: the guard never exits 1.

- Kit pages: all 27 have an empty «صور للمشاركة» because legacy() (build.cjs:46) moves p.tools into the share sheet.
- The skeleton (v3.css:430) hides the final .empty, so /tv/ shimmers forever on a day with no matches. Put .skel on the placeholders and cap the shimmer at 3 runs.
- Cinema: class «cm» → «cn» (shell.js:187). Release the wakeLock on close.

- /coefficients/ club table: hide it. /explore/: hide seasons before 2020.
- Hide empty derby cards and empty tiles at build time.
- Cup heroes: /c/gulf-cup/ ships data-art='[]' because the bands come from table ids only. Nothing shows tonight because the logo art renders, but a cup with no logo paints an empty canvas. Take group teams too.

items.title: Dead links, back gesture, nav state
items.detail:
- 404s: h2h 25/25 match links, /legends/ 8/9, and /uae/→/t/1925/. build.cjs keeps a Set of written paths, and a link() helper renders plain text when the target is missing.
- Android back: open() (shell.js:17) pushes history state, and popstate closes the overlay. «سكّر» calls history.back(). Search closes on an outside tap.
- page() derives the tab-bar aria-current from the path (build.cjs:58).
- The «مباريات العرب» rail link points to the العرب segment, not /tomorrow/.
Safety: the post-build href check unlinks and reports. It never fails the deploy.

items.title: Shares carry a link and a preview; measure return visits
items.detail:
- share.js:29: share files plus text, where the text is the score line followed by /m/ID/?s=wa. WhatsApp drops the url field when files are attached. Call dl() only when canShare is false, never on AbortError.
- Default og:image /og/tifo.png for every page that has none. That is 91% of pages today, home included.
- Live og images show the teams and kickoff, never «مباشر» or a score. The result image comes with the next hourly build, via og:image ?v=ft-<score>.
- Redeploy the cards Lambda so that /api/tifo/err returns 204.
- POST /api/tifo/hit {path,country,ret}: no cookies. ret is a localStorage bucket: first visit / same day / 1–7 days / 8+ days. The Monday report shows «أقل 10 صفحات» plus the 7-day returning share, which is the habit metric.
Safety: no per-goal builds. build.cjs + og.py take about 1 min and 300MB on the 3GB phone.

items.title: Caches that fight fresh data
items.detail:
- coaches.json is unhashed but marked immutable for a year (build.cjs:617). Rename it coaches.<hash>.json.
- sw.js deletes every tifo-* cache on each deploy. Split into assets-<V>, crest (LRU 300), pages (LRU 60) and data (LRU 40). Don't cache /og/. Enable navigationPreload.
Safety: ship at full time, never during a match. Add a kill switch: on activate the SW reads /sw.json and unregisters itself when it says off.

items.title: Live-feed watchdog
items.detail:
health.json is checked once an hour, which can't see a stall at goal time. While any match is live, the poller compares live.json generated to now. Above 90s it alerts the owner once per match. On a 429/403 from the source it backs off and keeps serving the last good file (the client shows «الاتصال ضعيف», W1.1g).
Safety: Lambda change, so deploy at full time.

waves.name: Wave 2: One system, country first (the look)

  - the kicker «دوري أدنوك · المركز 6» → /c/<slug>/?hl=<id>#table

- Squad rows (render.js:246) link to /p/{id}/ and carry the Arabic name, flag, position in Arabic and age.
- Player page: an outlined shirt number in the club colour (via colOn), and one 4-across stats row. Stats come from comp/<id>/players.json, already loaded (build.cjs:459). Show 0, not «—» (3,039 of 4,183 pages). No per-player fetches, since the pipeline writes player/{id}.json only for the UAE league (analytics.py:482). Hide career rows with no appearances.
- Scorers level on goals share a rank, ordered by fewer minutes.
- Clubs with the same name get the country added («النصر · السعودية»).

items.title: Subtract: share sheet, المزيد, shelves
items.detail:
- Share sheet: a story thumbnail plus 4 rows: شارك (image + link) · صورة النتيجة (ستوري/بوست/إكس) · بطاقة لاعب · شاشة كبيرة. A quiet link «للصحفيين وصنّاع المحتوى» → /m/<id>/kit/. Viewing modes move out: cinema to the mini-bar, «سوّ تشكيلتك» to اللاعبين.
- المزيد has exactly 14 entries:
  - «بلدك: الإمارات · غيّر»
  - وين تنقل · شاشة المجلس · العرب برا · الانتقالات · الديربيات · أرشيف النتايج · قانون الكورة · القاموس · الأساطير · هذا اليوم · ستوديو · اسأل تيفو
  - the switch row
  The golden boot moves to /arabs/, memorable matches under الأساطير, المختبر into ستوديو. If «فريقي» replaces الأسبوع in the nav, الأسبوع takes the الديربيات slot.
- الأرقام: 6 featured tiles plus «كل الأرقام (N)». Merge the overlapping tiles and move all-time tiles to التاريخ. `.shelf3 > :last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1/-1}`.

items.title: Sheets feel native
items.detail:
- A 36×4 grab bar. Drag with pointer events, transform only. A pull past 80px, a flick or a scrim tap closes the sheet.
- A 180ms exit. A 44px ×. inert on the page behind.
- Search becomes the same sheet: form role=search, type=search, enterkeyhint=search, and Enter opens the first hit. On failure it shows «ما قدرنا نحمّل البحث، تأكد من النت» (app.js:34-45).

items.title: Arabic text system
items.detail:
- R.n(k,forms) follows _count_plural: 1 مرة وحدة, 2 dual, 3–10 plural, 11+ singular, and 0 hides the line. Use it in S.faq (stats.js:527, which feeds JSON-LD), the reports, app.js:69/182/326 and stats.js:577/612.
- R.li: «لـال» → «لل» (279 hits).
- R.dmy replaces ISO dates.
- R.kick(m) is the one kicker: مباشر الحين / الليلة / اليوم 15:00 / بكرة / weekday. shell.js:102, app.js:79 and build.cjs:337 disagree today.
- Drop «.0».
- Fusha: «مباريات ما تنتسى», «الشاشة كاملة», «المادة 11: التسلل», and the header «الفرق» → «الفارق».
items.files: site/src/render.js, site/src/stats.js, site/src/app.js, site/src/shell.js, site/src/compare.js, site/build.cjs

items.title: Fast and cool on a mid-range phone
items.detail:
- Self-hosted font subsets: 75KB, against 126KB from 2 origins today. Preload them and add size-adjust fallbacks.
- Crests: /logo/96 webp for rows and /logo/256 for heroes. Hero crests load eagerly with fetchpriority=high (render.js:15).
- Remove backdrop-filter (v3.css:23/39/98).
- .cardflip becomes transform-only and plays once on a score change, not every minute.
- Polling: set() skips unchanged HTML. match() returns early when md.generated is unchanged. One shared live.json poller runs only while something relevant is live. Comp pages poll live.json and standings only.
- Speculation-rules prefetch (moderate).
- Key art at DPR 1, the wave on click, and parallax via animation-timeline.

items.title: Desktop and Fold composition (880–1440)
items.detail:
Evidence:
- next_match_1440_feat.png: «ليش هالنتيجة؟» runs about 1130px, roughly 110 characters a line. The tab rule spans 100–1340 while the content ends at 1302. The events strip is 830px of sparse yellow squares.
- next_home_1440_s3c.png: the nav floats in empty space, and the rail bleeds off the left edge while the hero ends at 1302.
Proposal:
- One 12-column grid, max 1200, whose edges the header, hero, tab rule and rails all share.
- Prose max 68ch.
- The events strip caps at 8 columns, with minute labels at 15' steps.
- At 880–1240 (the Fold unfolded): rail cards 2-up. Tabs sit under the hero, aligned to the grid.
The two-column match page at 1240+ is in needs_owner.

waves.name: Wave 3: Signature moves & reasons to come back
waves.goal: Tifo is recognisable at a glance and worth opening every day, with no accounts. There are two motions only. This wave removes more than it adds. It adds 3 blocks: the stakes card, the team form strip and the «العرب الليلة» strip. It removes 7: #since, «المباراة ما بدت.», the YouTube search link, the 92-row table and 16 links on /arabs/, the 11 native selects, /watch/ as its own page, and the calendar row in the share sheet.

items.title: Signature: the stand is there at first paint
items.detail:
- On hero templates only, build.cjs inlines each mosaic as a data URI (1px per card, scaled pixelated under a 2px night grid). No new files, no JS. The canvas takes over only for motion. Today the hero is empty for up to 1.3s.
- The intro is a card raise, right to left, on a session's first page only.
- Prerendered live digits stay dimmed until the first poll, then flap.
- .top and .tabbar get view-transition names.

items.title: Signature: the card-stunt goal
items.detail:
- Replace the 55% full-screen wash (v3.css:390-394). The stand's columns flip from the scorer's side into his colours and spell the new score (fillText on a cols×rows canvas; getImageData gives the mask). Hold 2s, then flip back.
- «هدف» and the Arabic scorer name slide in from his side and hold 1.5s.
- Hero off-screen: the mini-bar gets a 1.2s club-stripe fill plus the flap.
- On home it plays only when the hero is in view.
- My team scores: a dune underline. A goal against my team: only the quiet flap. A disallowed goal: a reverse flap and «انلغى الهدف».
- Static under reduced motion.

items.title: Signature: split-flap digits (the one score-change component)
items.detail:
- Built on 400's .cell. Keep the previous value and fold only the digits that changed (180+180ms, clip-path halves). flip3 (v3.css:395) wobbles digits that are already new.
- Used in the hero, rail .dg, day rows, the mini-bar and cinema.
- A card whose score rose gets .just for 60s: one top-edge flash in the scorer's club colour.
- While live, the tab title reads «1-0 · 67' البحرين ضد الإمارات», except in بدون حرق.

items.title: Signature utility: your channel on every row
items.detail:
- In matchRow and the rail card: a small chalk chip with the first channel in the visitor's country (bc.json), plus «مجاني». The prerender shows the UAE and the client swaps it. /today/ promises «القنوات الناقلة» but has 0 channel strings.
- /guide/ takes in /watch/'s package, price and source lines. Only then does /watch/ 301 there.
- The match wwbox (build.cjs:515) reads the same data.
items.files: site/src/render.js, site/src/v3.js, site/src/app.js, site/build.cjs, site/build_arabs.cjs, arabs.py

items.title: Prayer time, labelled with the city
items.detail:
- Port compute/prayer.py (about 3KB) to the client with each country's calculation method.
- One line in the match hero and the pre-kickoff tab: «العشاء في الرياض 19:52 · حوالي الدقيقة 20». Today poller.py:209-213 computes it for UAE venues only.
Safety: always name the city. In SA, DZ, EG, SD, IQ and LY the capital can be about 30 min off (Riyadh and Jeddah are 7.5° apart), so those countries get a city choice inside the «بلدك · غيّر» row. Ramadan labels wait until Jan 2027.

items.title: Install + calendar: coming back without push
items.detail:
PWA (353, approved):
- manifest with ar and rtl, #0A2620, and the shortcuts «مباشر الحين» and «اليوم»
- a maskable 3×3 mark and a 180px apple-touch-icon
- /offline/ listing the cached matches
- the install ask only on the 2nd visit or after «هذا فريقي»; iOS gets «شارك ← أضف للشاشة الرئيسية»
Calendar:
- Android uses calendar.google.com ?cid= (webcal is dead on Android Chrome, app.js:172).
- The link moves from the share sheet to the team hero.
- .ics events get URL, the channel and VALARM -PT30M.
- Build /v1/comp/538.ics, which is 404 today.
Safety: the sw.js parts ship after full time, with the W1.11 kill switch.

items.title: «فريقك» that follows you (no new block)
items.detail:
- The «فريقك» slot absorbs the daily card and replaces #since (app.js:278-283). On a day's first open it leads with yesterday's result for my team and national team, then today's match with time and channel. With no favourites it falls back to the country's national team and league. A «يديد» dot marks rows finished since the last visit.
- After full time, the result stays first for 24h, with «ليش هالنتيجة؟» and «صورة للستوري». app.js:88 jumps straight to the next fixture today.
- Player follow is cut until W4.9 writes player form.

items.title: Match page moments
items.detail:
- Before kickoff, «شو على المحك» replaces «المباراة ما بدت.»: the table or group rows around both teams, plus 3 lines «لو فازت… / تعادلوا… / خسرت…» computed with R.liveTable.
- Before kickoff, the hero shows the W2.7 form strip plus «فيفا #68» for national teams.
- At full time: a «نجم المباراة» row inside «ليش هالنتيجة؟», and a 16:9 card that links md.highlights.url instead of the YouTube search.
- og.py adds scorers, red cards and the star to its empty band.
Safety: points arithmetic only. Write «تتأهل» only when points alone settle it; otherwise «تقرّب من التأهل». Tie-breakers are easy to get wrong.

items.title: /arabs/ becomes a section front
items.detail:
- Order:
  1. A live «العرب الليلة» strip (player, club, minute, goal/assist).
  2. The star card.
  3. 4 group cards, each with one live number.
  4. The 16 links folded under «كل الأقسام».
- The 92-row «العرب في أوروبا» table moves to /arabs/europe/. The golden boot joins it.

items.title: Lineup builder on the pitch
items.detail:
- The 11 native selects (feat_xi.png) become the lineups pitch: 11 squares in the chosen formation. Tapping a square opens a sheet with the squad and numbers.
- «شارك تشكيلتي» exports the image.
- Host: a text link at the top of the team's اللاعبين tab.

items.title: Search that knows context
items.detail:
- A subline on each result («النصر · دوري روشن»; there are 3 × النصر and 3 × الأهلي). Ties break by the visitor's country.
- Index today's and upcoming matches («البحرين» → «البحرين ضد الإمارات 22:00»), plus coaches and referees.
- Empty state: فريقي chips · مباشر الحين · آخر بحث.
- Pan-Arab nicknames beyond app.js:31.

items.title: Richer leaderboards + one quiet promise
items.detail:
- Add «الأعلى تقييم» and «الحراس» as cells in the existing scorers control. comp/<id>/players.json already has rating, clean_sheet and saves.
- One quiet line, «تيفو بدون مراهنات», in the footer, the about page and the install sheet. Kooora, FotMob, Goal and 365 all show odds.

waves.name: Wave 4: The rest
waves.goal: Page merges, one URL per national team, accessibility, deep performance, data depth, and the audits nobody has done yet.

items.title: /thisday/ opens on today
items.detail:
- Today's block comes first (S.thisday, stats.js:290), titled «اليوم، 27 سبتمبر», with أمس/بكرة arrows. The other days fold by month.
- Today the page is 23,789px long and starts at «2 يناير».

items.title: Merge duplicate pages
items.detail:
- /match-of-week/ → a pinned card on /week/ with the live kickoff, then a 301.
- /w/ → /tv/?mine=1.
- /year/ → /calendars/.
- /academy/ examples move under /glossary/ terms, then a 301.
- /countdowns/ stays, without the red edge.
- Update inbound links.

items.title: One page per national team: /t/<id>/ stays canonical
items.detail:
- /t/<id>/ already polls and uses the team template. It gets 4 tabs: الياية · النتايج · اللاعبين · التاريخ. Today's /national/<cc>/ content becomes التاريخ.
- /national/<cc>/ and /uae/ 301 to it. The UAE has 3 self-canonical URLs today.
- The /national/ landing leads with «منتخبك», then «الشغالة الحين», then 22 flags.

items.title: Round, h2h, coach, referee and transfers pages
items.detail:
- Round: results and 3 numbers first. «شغّل الجولة» autoplays on the table.
- H2H: date line «19 سبتمبر 2026», no 5.5rem date column (tifo.css:331 clips «الشار…»). A next-meeting card and an 11/6/4 bar.
- Coach: label the scope (Dalić's 82 = league only).
- Referee: hide VAR when null, and add dates and cards.
- Transfers: default to country() and show the latest 30.

items.title: Squads for every Arab club; og and h1 everywhere
items.detail:
- Poll team/{id}.json weekly for the clubs in 536, 535, 519, 530 and the Algeria, Tunisia and Iraq leagues. 635 of 650 club pages say «ما في قائمة لاعبين» today.
- og images for national teams, Arab clubs and a generic match card. The default og is already in W1.10.
- h1s: a hidden «نتائج مباريات اليوم مباشر» on home, and team names on match pages (about 5,148 have none).
Safety: rate-limited and off-peak, never while a match is live. The same feed carries the live scores.

items.title: Accessibility pass
items.detail:
- aria-label on each match link («اليمن 0، قطر 1، مباشر الدقيقة 86»).
- One polite live region, for goals and full time.
- Forms: 16px inputs, role=status on #aska and #nlmsg, the email field dir=ltr, and buttons disabled while sending.
- Tabs: RTL arrow keys with a roving tabindex.
- Footer rows 44px. Labels .78rem or more (the tab bar is .7rem today).
- The 404 page gets search plus today's list.

items.title: Deep performance
items.detail:
- Comp pages prerender only the visible tab (296KB and about 7,800 nodes today; Lighthouse fell from 85 to 67).
- content-visibility:auto below the fold.
- 8–10KB of critical CSS inline, esbuild minify, share.js loaded on first tap.
- 3D pitch: InstancedMesh, DPR 1.5 or less, one orbit then stop, hidden when deviceMemory is 3 or less.
- deploy.sh copies only changed logos and og images, and invalidates /sw.js and / only. Today it uploads about 39MB and purges /* every hour.
Safety: fcp.cjs reports LCP, CLS and TBT and warns above 2.5s / 0.05 / 300ms. It never blocks a deploy.

items.title: Feed: period_start for a true live clock
items.detail:
- Add period_start (UTC) to live.json and the match JSON; both period_start and clock are null today.
- The hero and mini-bar then tick the minute locally.
- Don't fake a ticking minute before that.

items.title: Data depth: player form, FotMob ids, Arabic packages
items.detail:
- analytics.py:482 writes player/{id}.json with no form, although SCHEMA.md:257 promises the last 10 appearances. 0 of 4,183 pages show «فورمته». Add it, which unlocks player follow in «فريقك».
- Match uaepl fixtures to FotMob ids by (date, home, away) so future cards link.
- Add package_ar to broadcast.json (0 today).
Safety: off-peak and rate-limited, never while a match is live.

items.title: Audit what nobody checked
items.detail:
- Check first: the AI and API cost and abuse surface. /api/tifo/ask, /tts (Polly), /subscribe and gen.py need per-day caps, rate limits and a prompt-injection test on ask. Sample 20 AI texts (digest, commentary, thread) for accuracy.
- iOS Safari on a real iPhone: svh, view transitions, PWA install.
- SEO against Kooora and Yallakora for «مباريات اليوم» in Search Console, and JSON-LD validity (an English venue in SportsEvent).
- Visual design of the newsletter, the /embed/ widget (5,183 pages) and og.py.

signature_moves: The card-stunt goal («الملعب يرفع الكروت»). When a goal goes in, the stand of club-colour cards flips column by column from the scorer's side into his colours and spells the new score, then flips back. When you have scrolled, the mini-bar takes it, and a disallowed goal flips it back. It is the only big motion on the site, so it means something.

Split-flap scoreboard digits: the site's one score-change component. Scores and times sit in Barlow cells, and only the digit that changed flips, like a stadium board. It is used in the hero, rails, list rows, the mini-bar and the browser tab title. A row that just had a goal keeps an edge in the scorer's colour for 60 seconds.

The stand at first paint, and the square card atom everywhere. The mosaic is inlined into the hero before any JS runs. Lineups are chalk squares tonight and club-colour squares once colOn lands, so the XI reads like a tifo. Form is five squares, and you pick your team from a crest grid. It is one shape language from a phone glance to a WhatsApp story.

«بلدك» on every row. Each match shows the channel in your country and «مجاني» when it is free-to-air, and the countdown is for your national team. Prayer time names its city («العشاء في الرياض 19:52 · حوالي الدقيقة 20»). None of FotMob, SofaScore, 365, Kooora or Yallakora offers this pan-Arab utility, and Tifo has no betting.
needs_owner: Bottom nav (DESIGN-v3 rule 1): swap «الأسبوع» for «فريقي», with my crest as the icon. It opens my team, or the crest grid when none is set. الأسبوع takes the الديربيات slot in المزيد, so المزيد stays at 14. FotMob, SofaScore and 365 all put Following in the bar. Recommend yes.

Home (DESIGN-v3 §2 and rule 2): cap the hero so the first rail peeks through at 390×844 and at 880+. Today the hero is 750 of 1000px at 880 and fills the screen at 1440. Drop rail:today and rail:arab, and put «فريقك» right under the hero. Hero dedupe ships regardless. Recommend yes.
Subtractions (W2.8): share sheet from 13 rows to a preview plus 4; المزيد from 26 to 14; الأرقام from 28 tiles to 6 plus «كل الأرقام». Recommend yes.
«شو على المحك» before kickoff in place of «المباراة ما بدت.», with points arithmetic only (W3.8). Recommend yes.

Desktop match page at 1240+: two columns, 8 main columns (events, analysis) and a sticky 4-column side with the mini lineup, the group table and the next match, replacing tab-switching on wide screens (W2.12). Recommend yes.
Motion rule 12: replace the infinite scrim pulse (v3.css:401, about 2h of GPU per match) with one breath per data update. Recommend yes.

Art direction in DESIGN-v3: the mosaic only in heroes, the goal and share images; pitch lines as the only ornament; scoreboard digits only for scores and times. Drop the magenta logo bloom (.lgart .bloom). Recommend yes.

AI content you asked to switch off if broken. (a) «ملخص أسبوعك» on 14 UAE club pages talks to every visitor as a fan («فريقك الوحدة») and never names the opponent. Show it only to fans of that club, or rewrite it in the third person. Recommend hiding it now. (b) Finished matches carry 3 AI blocks on top of «الخلاصة». Keep one, and move «ثريد إكس» to the kit page.

Un-defer web push once the PWA ships: per team only, three toggles (بداية، هدف، نهاية), and the prompt only after «هذا فريقي». It is the loop that keeps FotMob and 365 on home screens, and the poller already sees goals every 20s.

Un-defer a one-tap «منو بيفوز؟», local-only: a pick before kickoff, «توقعك طلع صح» after full time, and «صح 7 من 10» in «فريقك». No crowd %, because bars next to «تيفو بدون مراهنات» read like a market. No points, no accounts.
WhatsApp channel (349, approved): you create it. After that, one «تابع تيفو على واتساب» line goes in the «فريقك» empty state, the footer and the full-time card.

SEO: noindex and drop from the sitemap about 3k thin pages (players under 90 minutes with no career, referees with fewer than 3 matches, teams with no squad or fixtures, JS-shell compare pages). They stay reachable.
Copy: does your film-lexicon rule «في + اسم → فـ» («فالشارقة») also apply to the site? It uses «في» everywhere today.

dropped: Foreign-language package and stadium text has no owner. remove_or_hide sends it to 'W1.7, W1.2', but neither item mentions it. S.watchWhere (stats.js:302) prints x.package raw into the «وين تنقل» box on every upcoming EPL/LaLiga/UCL/AFC/Saudi match; 25 of 44 packages are English. /watch/ and /s/* show «Bus: yes» and the VVIP parking text. package_ar has 0 hits in broadcast.json. Add to W1.7: hide non-Arabic package, bus and parking strings now; add package_ar as a separate data task.

Player form pipeline. The pipeline never writes `form` into player/{id}.json, although SCHEMA.md:257 promises it, so 0 of 4,183 pages render «فورمته». W2.7 leaves this out, yet W3.7 (followed player's 'last rating') and the player last-5 proposal both assume the data exists. Either schedule the pipeline job or cut player-follow.

Live latency is diluted and has no owner. The 'hot' cache is max-age 20 + SWR 20, and the client polls every 20s, so a goal can take about 60s to show. W1.1b fixes only kickoff, and W2.11 only the redraw cost. No item overlays live.json (10s TTL) on the match page, as the match-page lens proposed, so the north star 'true to the second' is unowned.
Default og:image. Verified: 91% of pages, including home, share with no preview. The fix is a build default (/og/tifo.png), but it sits in W4.5. Sharing is the growth loop, so move it into W1.10.

Crest view-transition names are wiped by the first poll (verified broken). The plan demotes this to signature W3.1, but the fix is one line: emit the name inside R.matchHead/R.standCap. Put it in W1 or W2.
The v3 worktree's CLS fix (live match CLS 0.125 on live vs 0 in the worktree) is never referenced. Make it W2.1 acceptance.
Minor: the /memorable/ English score cards and competition names (stats.js:288) have no owner, because 397 covers people only.
cut: The plan breaks its own targets. The W2.8 المزيد list has about 17 links, plus the «بلدك» row and the switch row, which comes to about 21 against '≤14'. needs_owner #1 then adds /week/ and W4.6 adds «خط أكبر». The W4.3 national page has 5 tabs against 'at most 4'. W3 is net-additive: it adds about 10 blocks (daily card, stakes card, star row, highlight card, prayer line, form strips ×3, channel chips, العرب الليلة strip, «ذكّرني», install ask) and removes about 2, against 'each wave removes more than it adds'.

W3.7 daily card as a new home block. It repeats today's match already in the hero (the W2.1 pick) and in «فريقك», which breaks 'no match twice'. Fold it into the «فريقك» slot. Drop player-follow until the form data exists.

Motion sprawl across four items:
- W3.1: dim → flap
- W3.2: stand stunt, mini-bar stripe fill, vibrate, dune underline, 60s share chip
- W3.3: flap, 60s .just edge, «هدف» tag, favicon dot, app badge
- W2.11: cardflip replays 2 cycles on every minute change, so every live dot moves every minute, against 'motion answers an event'
Ship one score-change component plus the stand stunt. Cut vibrate, favicon/badge, the share chip, the per-minute cardflip and the W4.8 seconds hairline.

W4.3 points the redirect the wrong way. 301-ing /t/<natId>/ to /national/<iso>/ moves national teams onto the build_arabs template, which doesn't poll, and duplicates the team template. Reverse it, as the hubs lens proposed: /t/<id>/ stays canonical and gains an «التاريخ» tab; /national/<cc>/ and /uae/ 301 to it.

Scope creep to defer or cut:
- the W2.1/392 shotmap, a new block pushed into in-flight polish
- the W3.11 two-tier search index (15KB + 100KB)
- the W3.6 «ذكّرني» button, a second pre-kickoff primary that clashes with 393
- the W3.5 Ramadan labels (Feb 2027)
- the W4.6 «خط أكبر» switch, since the W2.2 type floor covers it
W3.1 emits a mosaic PNG per page, adding thousands of files to the 39MB hourly deploy that W4.7 is trying to shrink. Inline it as CSS or a data URI, on hero templates only.
needs_owner «منو بيفوز؟»: crowd % bars read like a market price sitting next to «تيفو بدون مراهنات». If it is un-deferred, keep the pick local-only.
unaudited: Desktop and tablet craft. 518 screenshots at 880/1440 exist, but no lens judged composition, grid, type scale or key art at those widths; they were used only for pixel checks. Awwwards juries look at desktop first, and the plan is phone-only. Also unreviewed: the 600–900px band where the 880 breakpoint flips, which includes the owner's own Fold4 unfolded.

Cost and abuse of the AI and API surface. Nobody checked /api/tifo/ask, /tts (Polly), /subscribe or gen.py for rate limits, per-day cost caps, prompt injection in ask, or answer accuracy. AI text accuracy beyond the single preview (digest, commentary, X thread, /ask answers) was also not audited.

How to measure 'habit-forming'. W1.10's cookieless per-path counter cannot see return visits. It needs something like a localStorage 'first visit today / returning' bit sent with the hit, plus a defined retention metric.

Upstream feed resilience at goal time. Every lens trusts the FotMob-derived feed. Nobody checked what happens if the source rate-limits or blocks us mid-match, or whether live-feed lag raises an alert (run-job checks health.json age only once an hour).
SEO competitiveness. No lens checked indexing, Search Console or rankings against Kooora/Yallakora for «مباريات اليوم». JSON-LD validity (English venue in SportsEvent) came up only incidentally.

The opt-in club theme (#themebtn, app.js:290-292) rewrites --dune globally to the club's first colour at runtime, so for a red club, 'mine' becomes card red. The W2.3 build lint cannot see this, and nobody audited it against the colour rule.

Newsletter email design, the embed widget (/embed/ on 5,183 pages), and share-image (og.py) visual design were not audited. iOS Safari behaviour was not checked either (svh, view transitions, PWA install); all evidence is Chromium.

Gulf Cup cup-page key art. The comp-team-player summary says 27 of 53 cup pages have an empty mosaic ('fix tonight'). It was never a verified finding and is not in the plan. The /c/gulf-cup/ markup matches the league page, so the claim is still unverified. Check it before the next Gulf Cup match.
risky: W1.1e hides live digits whenever the page is more than 2 min old. Pages are rebuilt hourly (cron :25) and cached 60s, so almost every load blanks the score on first paint. On a weak signal, the case W1.1c/g exist for, the score never appears at all. It also contradicts W3.1, which says 'dimmed'. Dim the digits and show «آخر تحديث HH:MM»; never hide. This blocks W1.1 as written.

Build-failing gates: W1.7 (regex over visible text), W1.9 (any missing href), W2.3 (colour lint), W4.7 (perf thresholds). build.cjs:724 calls exit(1), which stops the whole hourly deploy mid-tournament, freezing new fixtures, previews and og images. The pattern `\b[a-z]+_[a-z_]{5,}\b` will also hit Latin names and slugs. This goes against the owner's rule «العطب المجاور يُذكر ولا يحجز النشر». Warn and strip or unlink instead; fail only when a count rises.

W1.4 'use ext_id as a stable id' turns ids into 'uaepl:<uuid>' (sources/uaepl.py:182). That puts colons into URLs, S3 keys and data-mid, and the URL changes once FotMob publishes the real id (dead shares, duplicate sitemap entries). Just skip null ids now, and map to the FotMob id later.

W1.5 puts var(--hc) raw on the pitch tonight, but colOn() only arrives in W2.3 and --hc-ink doesn't exist. By the plan's own count, 267 of 698 club colours are under 3:1 on night, so about 38% of clubs would get invisible squares again. For tonight, use chalk squares with night ink.

W1.10 'poller rebuilds the match page + og on status flip/goal'. The poller is a Lambda (template.yaml rate(1 minute)), but build.cjs and og.py run on the phone (about 1 min and 300MB, behind wait_for_mem 1200). That means a full phone build per goal during live matches, on a 3GB phone that is also running the live watcher. Render og in Lambda, or only version the og URL.

Deploys during the match. W1.1b (poller.py) is a live Lambda deploy, and W1.11 rewrites sw.js, which sticks for every returning visitor and has no self-unregister kill switch. Ship both after full time, not tonight. W1 is also overloaded for 'tonight': 11 items, 8 of them M, including a new DynamoDB counter and sourced research for 8 countries. Triage it down to W1.1a/d, W1.2a-c, W1.3a-b, W1.4 skip-null, W1.5 and W1.6.

Worktree collision. W1.1, W1.5 and W1.6 edit shell.js, v3.css, tifo.css and render.js on main while the design agent is editing the same files on branch v3. W2.2 then deletes the sw() remap and tifo.css rules, which flips every v2 colour at once. Order: W1 hotfixes on main, rebase v3, merge 387–403, then W2.2 with a screenshot diff of all 35 templates. W2.1 also pushes 9 amendments, some of them new features, into an agent that is already running.

Upstream load. W2.7 fetches player/{id}.json for all 4,183 players on every hourly build (build.cjs get() over CloudFront, pool 8). W4.5 polls team/{id}.json for about 635 clubs. If that pushes the FotMob-fed pipeline into rate limits, live scores go down. Rate-limit both, run them off-peak, and never during live matches.

W3.5 computes prayer times at each country's capital. Riyadh and Jeddah are 7.5° of longitude apart, about 30 minutes of Isha; the same problem applies to Algeria, Egypt and Sudan. So «حوالي الدقيقة 20» is wrong for many viewers, against 'truth before beauty'. Use the venue city or ask for the viewer's city, and label it (e.g. «بتوقيت الرياض»).

Owner gates dropped. Lenses flagged needs_owner on hero height (DESIGN-v3 §2), «شو على المحك», the share-sheet and shelf trims, and «خط أكبر»; the plan sets all of them to false. W2.1 also moves «ثريد إكس» while needs_owner #5 asks the owner about those same AI blocks. W3.8's «لو فازت… تتأهل» lines get tie-breakers wrong easily, so limit them to points arithmetic.

lenses.summary:
I looked at home, live, match, comp, team and player at 390px using the live screenshots, the CSS and JS in site/src, and the heroPick/homeRails code in the v3 worktree.

**Broken now:**
- In the lineup pitch, the home team's player squares are invisible. The cause is the build colour remap.
- The short-name function cuts Arabic compound names in half (e.g. «الدين زهير», «الله حمد»).

**Hierarchy problems:**
- The home hero gives a neutral live match priority over the UAE's own game 18 minutes before kickoff.
- On home, each of the two matches appears 3 to 4 times.
- A scrolled match page loses about 25% of the screen to four stacked bars.
- The competition page shows zero table rows on the first screen.

**Unfinished UI:**
- The share sheet is 13 plain rows.
- The build-your-XI sheet is 11 native dropdowns.
- Sheets have no swipe-to-close.
- The player hero is just a name.
- Several grids have empty cells.

**Identity leaks:**
- Pulse green is used on ratings of finished matches.
- Dune is used on the «حامي» chip.
- The table zones use FotMob's raw lime, yellow and red.

None of this repeats items 387–403. Findings 3, 6 and 9 build on 388, 394 and 395.

findings.title: Lineup pitch: home team's player squares are invisible (build colour remap)
findings.evidence: next_match_390_lineups_final.png and next_live_390_lineups_final.png: the bottom team's numbers float with no square, while the top team has outlined squares. Cause: build.cjs:150 sw("chalk","surf") rewrites tifo.css `.pl b{background:var(--chalk)}` to #123A31, which disappears on the #0F3A2F/#124233 pitch.
findings.proposal: Override in v3.css: `.pl b{background:var(--hc);color:<ink of hc>}` and `.pl.away b{background:var(--ac)}`. That gives club-colour squares, the stand's own atom, so the XI reads like a tifo. Also replace the Latin «PAR/BHR» chip (render.js:182 `<span class="flag">`) with a small square flag or remove it.
findings.verified: Looked at next_match_390_lineups_final.png. The bottom team (الوحدة, the home side in the RTL header) shows bare numbers 35/44/3/5/23/11/8/12/19/25/70 with no visible square. The top (away) team's numbers sit in outlined squares. Read the source: tifo.css:191 has `.pl b{background:var(--chalk);color:var(--ink)}`. The swap is not at build.cjs:150, it is at build.cjs:166-167, where sw("chalk","surf") rewrites it to var(--surf). v3.css:5 sets --surf:#123A31 and v3.css:6 sets --ink:#F6F7F2. Checked the live CSS with curl (/assets/tifo.6b99163974.css): it serves `.pl b{...background:var(--surf);color:var(--ink)}` on `.pitch{background:#0F3A2F}`, which leaves a dark-green square on a dark-green pitch. Nothing in v3.css overrides `.pl`. The away rule `.pl.away b` becomes background var(--inkbg) #2A3833 with a chalk outline, which is why the top team's squares show. render.js:182 does print the raw country code in `<span class="flag">`, and «PAR» is visible in the screenshot.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, with one line-number fix. The remap happens at build.cjs:166-167 (the `sw` helper, then sw("chalk","surf")), not at build.cjs:150. It turns the home team's `.pl b` background into --surf #123A31 on the #0F3A2F pitch, so the home team's number squares disappear. The away squares survive only because of their chalk outline. The fix is a v3.css override, e.g. `.pl b{background:var(--hc,var(--chalk));color:var(--hc-ink,var(--night))}` with a matching away rule, and it needs contrast-safe ink per club colour. The Latin «PAR» chip comes from render.js:182 (and also render.js:247 on team squads).

findings.title: surname() cuts Arabic compound names in half
findings.evidence: next_match_390_lineups_final.png shows «الدين زهير» (from علاء الدين زهير) and «الله حمد» (from عبد الله حمد). next_live_390_lineups_final.png shows «الله الخلاصي». src/render.js:183 `p.slice(1).join(" ")` always drops the first token.
findings.proposal: Keep compounds together. If p[0] is one of عبد/أبو/ابو/بن, or p[1] is one of الله/الدين/الرحمن/العزيز/الإسلام, treat the first two tokens as one unit. With ≤3 tokens, show the full name. Prefer a short_ar field from players_ar.json when it exists.
findings.verified: Code: site/src/render.js:183 `surname(n)` splits on whitespace and returns `p.slice(1).join(" ")` whenever there is more than one token. It is used only for the pitch-diagram labels (render.js:190). The list view below the pitch uses the full name through players(). Screenshots: next_match_390_lineups_final.png shows «الدين زهير» on the pitch (#5), while the list below shows «علاء الدين زهير». The same frame also shows «الله حمد» (#12). next_live_390_lineups_final.png shows «الله الخلاصي» (#23, Bahrain) and «الدين زهير» (#5, UAE) in the live Bahrain v UAE match. The claim is confirmed. On the proposal: names/players_ar.json has only latin/ar/source/qid/checked fields, and grep finds no short_ar anywhere, so a "short_ar field" does not exist yet and would have to be created. The screenshot also shows «لطف الله» from إبراهيم لطف الله. That one is correct and must stay: a check on p[1]==الله does not match it (p[1]=لطف), but the "≤3 tokens → full name" rule would lengthen it.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed with one clarification: the bug affects only the pitch-diagram labels (render.js:190 via surname at :183), not the lineup list. Fix in surname(): if p[0] is one of عبد/أبو/ابو/بن, or p[1] is one of الله/الدين/الرحمن/العزيز/الإسلام, treat tokens 0–1 as one unit and return that compound together with the rest (for example «علاء الدين زهير» → «زهير» or the full name, but never «الدين زهير»). Any compound that ends the name must stay whole (keep «لطف الله»). There is no short_ar field in names/players_ar.json today, so adding one would be new data work, not a lookup.

findings.title: Home shows the same match 3–4 times in the first 2.5 screens
findings.evidence: next_home_390_full_before.png: Yemen–Qatar appears in the hero, rail:live and list:day. Bahrain–UAE appears in the hero countdown, rail:today, the rail:arab peek card and list:day. v3.js:83 homeRails never excludes the hero match, and the arab rail overlaps today.
findings.proposal: Skip the hero match in every rail, and let each match appear in at most one rail. Drop rail:today whenever list:day, which sits right below it, shows the same day. Otherwise merge today and arab into one rail. This amends DESIGN-v3 §3.2's slot list.
findings.verified:
I read /root/.claude/jobs/abd28f85/tmp/next_home_390_full_before.png and next_home_390_full_live.png, plus ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/v3.js (R.homeRails at lines 84-93) and src/shell.js (the tifo:day handler around line 101).

In the before screenshot:
- Yemen–Qatar (live, 1-0, 83') shows in the hero, then in the مباشر الحين rail, then in the كأس الخليج block of كل المباريات.
- Bahrain–UAE shows in the hero countdown line («البحرين ضد الإمارات 00:18:58»), then in the اليوم rail as the lead card, then as a peek card at the edge of the مباريات العرب rail, then in كل المباريات.

The live screenshot shows the same thing in its pre-match state. Bahrain–UAE is the hero, then the lead card or peek card in the اليوم rail, then in كل المباريات. Yemen–Qatar (19:55) shows in the اليوم rail, then as a peek in مباريات العرب, then in كل المباريات.

The code explains why:
- homeRails(ms, index, o) is never given the hero match, and nothing skips it. The heroPick/featured call happens separately in shell.js.
- The `arab` list is built from the same sorted day array as `today`/`up`. It only drops live matches, so every Arab or Gulf Cup scheduled or finished match lands in both today and arab.
- The day list (#day) then renders all of them again.
findings.corrected: The claim holds. There are two small corrections. The function is at src/v3.js:84, not :83. In the pre-kickoff state the count is 3 appearances per match, not 4: hero, then one of the two rails (sometimes both), then the day list. It rises to 4 only when the hero also carries a countdown line for a second match. The proposal is sound: pass the hero id into homeRails to exclude it, remove from `arab` the ids already in `today` (or merge the two rails), and hide rail:today when list:day shows the same day.

findings.title: Hero pick rule: a neutral live match beats your own team's match (input to 388)
findings.evidence: next_home_390_before.png: Yemen v Qatar at 83' fills the hero, while UAE's own match, 18 minutes from kickoff, is a single grey countdown line. v3.js:95 heroPick scores live +1000, mine +500, UAE 5789 +120, and has no visitor-country weight, although the site is now pan-Arab.
findings.proposal:
New order:
1. My team, live.
2. My team, or the visitor's national team (by R.COUNTRIES/TZ), kicking off within 3h or live.
3. Other live Arab matches.
4. Tonight's biggest match.
Apply it in both the build-time pick and R.featured, as the rule for #388.

findings.title: Scrolled match page: four stacked bars take about 25% of the screen
findings.evidence: next_match_390_scrolled_final.png and next_live_390_scrolled_final.png: top bar (56px), mini score bar (48), sticky tabs (48) and bottom tab bar (~58) add up to about 210 of 844px. On phones:

findings.evidence: feat_pcard_list.png: 13 equal text rows with no icons and no preview; the sheet needs scrolling. Five rows are image exports: ستوري, three «صورة جاهزة» sizes and «صورة لأي قسم». next_match_390_sheet_final.png shows the same pattern.

Top of the sheet: a story-image thumbnail, then 3 icon buttons (انسخ · شارك · ستوري). Next, one «صورة» row with a size segment (ستوري/بوست/إكس) plus the section picker. Below that, two folded groups:

- «للمبدعين»: العدّة، ضمّن، بطاقة لاعب

findings.title: Player page: hero is only a name, stats show dashes and gaps
findings.evidence: next_player_390_s3c.png: the hero is the mosaic plus a name, and the club is a tiny «شالكه» link. There is no number, crest, flag or position. «موسمه» shows «—» for goals and assists (build.cjs:446 `p.goals ?? "—"`), and 4 cells in a 3-column grid leave 2 empty bordered cells. next_player_390_full_s36.png: the tcard floats at 225px centred and repeats the name. Show stats as one 4-across row. Make the tcard gutter-width and drop its name. Print one year when a season's start equals its end.

findings.title: Reserved colours used for other meanings (pulse, dune, card yellow/red)
findings.evidence:
- tifo.css `.rt.hi{background:var(--pulse)}` paints finished-match ratings live-green (8.6/7.8/7.6 in lineups_final).

findings.evidence: v3.css `.hhero{min-block-size:clamp(30rem,86svh,46rem)}` makes the hero 726px at 844, so the «مباشر الحين» heading sits at about y=775, under the 60px tab bar (next_home_390_before.png, home_nav crop). findings.evidence: next_match_390_sheet_final.png, next_home_390_more_final.png, next_home_390_edpanel_final.png, feat_xi.png: close is a boxed «سكّر» button top-left, and there is no handle. v3.js and shell.js have no touch or pointer drag handlers (grep for touch* finds none). - next_comp_390_full_before.png: «الموسم بالرسم 1» is a single half-width tile next to an empty half.

lenses.summary:
Design-system audit of the live CSS: tifo.css after the build's regex remap, plus src/v3.css (80 KB, 17.9 KB gzip). I measured it against screenshots at 390px phone width and computed WCAG contrast ratios.

The identity (night pitch, chalk, dune, pulse, square atom) is strong. It leaks in three ways:
1. **Reserved colours used for other things.** Red and yellow appear off cards, pulse off live, dune off "my team". Raw FotMob and club colours also land on night with no guard.
2. **Contrast failures on fills.** The most-seen live element, the green live-score chip in the home match list, has white text at 3.41:1.
3. **Token sprawl.** 64 raw hex values, 59 font sizes, 13 durations, 5 easings, 15 z-index values and 7 breakpoints. Two token names are inverted: in v3 `--ink` is chalk and `--concrete` is night. One real break: the selected-tab indicator is clipped to 1px on every tabbed template, and it is invisible (night on night) on the 15 compare pages.

Recommendation: stay dark-only. `color-scheme:dark` and `theme-color` are already set, and a light theme would double the surface area against the "simple" brief. Make the dark side survive sunlight instead: a clearer raised surface, 3:1 borders on controls, and a chalk focus ring.

Focus handling is otherwise sound: a global `:focus-visible` and no `outline:none`.

The signature proposal needs no new decoration. It turns what exists into three rules:
- The mosaic appears only in heroes and moments.
- Chalk pitch lines are the only ornament.
- Scoreboard digits are only for scores and times.

Of the in-progress items:
- 401 (floodlights) will be invisible under the new scrim.
- 395 (table zones) and 389 (sub arrows) carry the colour-meaning leaks forward.
- 402 (line icons) uses round caps, but the rest of the icon set uses square caps.

findings.title: Selected-tab indicator is broken: 1px on match/comp, invisible on compare
findings.evidence: Pixel check: next_match_390_feat y=595 and next_comp_390_feat y=771 show a single row of #B07A3B. The 3px border is clipped by .tabs{overflow-x:auto} plus margin-block-end:-2px (tifo.css:54-55). The plain .tabs on 15 c/*/compare pages uses border-color var(--night) on a night ground (tifo.css:56), so no underline shows in next_compare_390_feat.
findings.proposal: Remove the negative margin and draw the indicator as .tabs [aria-selected=true]{box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--dune)}, so it cannot be clipped. Delete the v2 border-color:var(--night).
findings.verified:
I checked the live CSS (/assets/tifo.235c403a26.css), the source files src/tifo.css:54-56, src/v3.css:111-113 and build.cjs:165-167, and the screenshots.

Match and comp pages:
- A pixel scan finds dune #B07A3B on only one row under the selected tab: y=595 on next_match_390_feat (63px wide, under «الأحداث») and y=771 on next_comp_390_feat. The 390px screenshots are at 1x, so one row is 1 CSS px. Rows 785-786 in the comp shot are the bottom nav, not the tabs.
