lenses.summary:
Audited the comp, team, player, coach, referee, h2h and round pages from the live HTML (curl), the build code and the 390/1440 screenshots, and checked each bug against the v3 worktree. None of these is fixed there.

**Fix tonight (Gulf Cup is live):**
- 27 of 53 cup pages have no stand mosaic, because composite standings give an empty key art.
- The Gulf Cup round chips show raw «1/2» and «final», and the semi-final sorts between rounds 1 and 2.
- The draw tile says «المجموعة Grp».
- Premier League tiles leak raw keys (club_19th_premier_league_match, red_card_last_match, «إيقاف null»).

**Structural gaps against FotMob and SofaScore:**
- Squad rows link to none of the player pages that exist.
- Club and national-team pages never show the table or the team's position.
- Player pages are thin:
  - 73% show «—» where the value is 0.
  - «فورمته» renders on 0 of 4,183 pages.
  - Positions show as «CAM».
- Leaderboards cover only goals and assists, although rating, clean sheets and saves are already in players.json.

**Clutter to cut:**
- The الأرقام shelf has 28 tiles, with overlaps and empty-state tiles.
- The duplicate «ملخص أسبوعك» tab on club pages.
- The goal-clock tile always answers «90».
- The round page makes you scroll about 3,700px, then lists the same results again.

**Latin names:** comp tiles still show 87 or more Latin names that the dictionary already covers. That should be added to the in-flight Latin-names pass (referees and clubs are already in it).

Main files: /root/workspace/saas/football/site/build.cjs (lines 140, 224, 250, 295, 436-442), /root/workspace/saas/football/site/src/render.js (lines 149, 246), /root/workspace/saas/football/site/src/stats.js (lines ~107, 503), /root/workspace/saas/football/site/src/app.js (line 127).

findings.title: Gulf Cup round chips show «1/2» and «final», in the wrong order; draw tile says «المجموعة Grp»
findings.evidence: Chips read '1 · 1/2 · 2 · 3 · final'. build.cjs:250 and app.js:127 use esc(k) instead of R.roundLabel. parseFloat('1/2')=1 in R.rounds (render.js:149), so the semi-final sorts between rounds 1 and 2. The draw tile shows «المجموعة Grp» twice because build.cjs:140 prepends 'Group ' to 'Grp. A'. The group headers say «المجموعة A» while the hero says «المجموعة الأولى».
findings.proposal: Map stages to Arabic: 1/2 → نص النهائي, final → النهائي. Treat only /^\d+$/ as a numeric round and put stages after the rounds. Pass g.name straight to stageAr. Render A/B as الأولى/الثانية.
findings.verified:
I checked the live page https://tifo.elyoxe.com/c/gulf-cup/ with curl and read the code in ~/workspace/saas/football/site. Everything in the claim is confirmed except one line number. (1) The server-rendered chips read, in this order: 1, 1/2, 2 (pressed), 3, final. The labels are raw English/fraction strings, not Arabic. (2) The build.cjs code that renders them is at line 272, not 250. It prints `${esc(k)}` inside each button. app.js:127 (roundsUI) prints `isNaN(parseFloat(k)) ? R.esc(k) : k`. Neither uses R.roundLabel (render.js:152), and even that function would pass '1/2' through as «الجولة 1/2». (3) R.rounds (render.js:147-149) sorts with parseFloat, and parseFloat('1/2') is 1. So the semi-final sorts after round 1 and before round 2. (4) drawHtml (build.cjs:137-140) calls R.stageAr("Group " + g.name). The live draw section shows «

المجموعة Grp

», and grep counts it twice on the page. That fits g.name being 'Grp. A': the regex in stageAr (render.js:92) matches "Group " and then captures "Grp" as the group id. (5) The same page has 4× «المجموعة A», 4× «المجموعة B», 1× «المجموعة الأولى» and 1× «المجموعة الثانية», so the group naming is inconsistent.
findings.corrected: The claim is accurate. One correction: the chips code in build.cjs is at line 272, not 250. The other citations hold: build.cjs:137-140 (drawHtml), app.js:127 (roundsUI) and render.js:149 (the parseFloat sort). Also note that simply switching to R.roundLabel would not be enough, because it would render «الجولة 1/2». The fix needs to map stage keys explicitly (1/2 → نص النهائي, final → النهائي). It should also treat a key as a numeric round only when it matches /^\d+$/, both when sorting and when labelling, and it should pass g.name to stageAr directly.

findings.title: Raw API keys and «null» in Premier League tiles
findings.evidence: /c/premier-league/ shows «(لين club_19th_premier_league_match)», «(لين last_day_of_season)», «إيقاف null مباراة» and «Abdul Fatawu red_card_last_match (موقوف)». Sources: stats.js:503 (x.until, x.ban_matches) and S.absences (p.reason escaped raw).
findings.proposal: Map until/reason values to Arabic (لين الجولة 19، لين آخر الموسم، طرد في آخر مباراة) and drop rules whose ban is null. Add a build guard that fails on /\b[a-z]+_[a-z_]{5,}\b|\bnull\b|undefined/ in visible text.
findings.verified: I fetched the live /c/premier-league/ page with curl --compressed (249,542 bytes). All four strings are in the visible text. In the «الإيقافات» section: «كل 5 إنذارات = إيقاف 1 مباراة (لين club_19th_premier_league_match)», «كل 15 إنذارات = إيقاف 3 مباراة (لين last_day_of_season)» and «كل 20 إنذارات = إيقاف null مباراة». In «غيابات الجولة 6», under إبسويتش تاون: «Abdul Fatawu red_card_last_match (موقوف)». Each appears twice, once in the tile and once in the facts list. I found the sources in ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/stats.js. Line 503 concatenates x.ban_matches without a null check (so it prints "null") and prints esc(x.until) raw. Line 615 (the absences renderer) prints esc(p.reason) raw. The 5-yellow rule also has no ban-match fallback, and there are grammar slips: «5 إنذارات … 3 مباراة».
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed as stated. There is also a grammar nit: «إيقاف 3 مباراة» should read «3 مباريات», and «كل 20 إنذارات» should read «كل 20 إنذار». The fix goes at stats.js:503 and stats.js:615. Map the `until` and `reason` codes through an Arabic dictionary: club_19th_premier_league_match → «لين الجولة 19», last_day_of_season → «لين آخر الموسم», red_card_last_match → «طرد في آخر مباراة». When a code is unknown, hide it instead of printing it raw. Skip any rule where ban_matches is null.

findings.title: Player pages: «—» for 0, «فورمته» never renders, position shown as «CAM»
findings.evidence: 3,039 of 4,183 pages show «—» for goals, including players with minutes (Džeko /p/15403/: 86 min, «— أهداف — صناعة»). «فورمته» renders on 0 of 4,183 pages: player/{id}.json has no form key although SCHEMA.md:257 promises one, and the JSON is fetched only for UAE players (build.cjs:436). Position and country appear as raw «CAM»/«ITA» on the 292 pages that have them. Joao Félix's career has empty stub rows («تشيلسي 2025–2025»).
findings.proposal: Show 0 when minutes > 0. Map positions to Arabic and codes to a flag. Build the last 5 matches from stored lineups (opponent crest, rating chip, goals/assists, link) for every player with a page, plus a next-match card. That is the reason to come back after each game. Hide career rows with no appearances.
findings.verified: Live /p/15403/ (Džeko) shows «— أهداف — صناعة | 86 دقيقة | 6.2», yet /v1/player/15403.json has goals:0, assists:0, minutes:86. Cause: build.cjs:460 fetches player/{id}.json only for ids in the UAE league (uaeP). Every other player falls back at build.cjs:466 to sv("goals") from the league stats lists, which is null when the player has no entry, and build.cjs:469 prints `p.goals ?? "—"`. In the built pages (site/out/p) there are 4,183 pages; 3,039 contain `—أهداف`, 0 contain «فورمته», and 292 contain `المركز `. The «فورمته» section (build.cjs:472) depends on p.form. I sampled UAE player JSONs (1084245, 1282441, 851198, 608428): none has a form key, even though SCHEMA.md:257 promises one. Their live pages show raw «CAM»/«ST» and «BRA»/«MAR»/«MLI» in a plain `.flag` text box (tifo.css:231); no JS turns the code into a flag. No João Félix page exists in out/p, but the empty-row pattern is real: /p/264096/ (أحمد علاء الدين) has «الغرافة 2025–2025» with no appearances or goals, and 35 pages contain «2025–2025».
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, with small fixes. The JSON fetch is limited to UAE-league players at build.cjs:460, not :436. The «—» also has a second cause: the fallback path (build.cjs:466) reads league stats lists that leave out players with 0 goals. So a direct fix is to fetch player/{id}.json for every player (the file exists, e.g. Džeko's has goals:0), or to default to 0 when minutes > 0. «فورمته» never renders because the pipeline does not write `form` into player/{id}.json, even for UAE players; the fix is in the pipeline, not in rendering. For the empty career rows, use /p/264096/ («الغرافة 2025–2025», no appearances) as the example instead of Félix, who has no page.

findings.title: Remove the «ملخص أسبوعك» tab on club pages
findings.evidence: On /t/102122/ the 5th tab repeats the hero and the fixtures in prose. It addresses every visitor as a fan («فريقك الوحدة»، «بتلعبونها») on a static page, and «هالمواجهة بتلعبونها تاريخ 1 أكتوبر» never names the opponent.
findings.proposal: Drop the tab so the page has 4 tabs. Its one useful fact (position, form) goes into the mini-table from the finding above.
findings.verified: Fetched live https://tifo.elyoxe.com/t/102122/ with curl. The tabs are الياية / النتايج / اللاعبين / بالأرقام / ملخص أسبوعك, so the digest is the 5th tab. Its pane (data-pane="week", data-slot="tab:week") reads: «يديد نادي الوحدة هالأسبوع — فريقك الوحدة ما لعب أي مباراة هالأسبوع. … في المركز 6 برصيد 9 نقاط عقب ما لعب 5 مباريات… فارق أهدافه +1، وفورمة الفريق 3 انتصارات عقب خسارتين. هالمواجهة بتلعبونها تاريخ 1 أكتوبر 2026 الساعة 19:45». The same block as the hero (بني ياس، 19:45، 1 أكتوبر) sits right above the tabs, so the tab repeats the next fixture and never names the opponent (بني ياس). It speaks to every visitor as a fan («فريقك»، «بتلعبونها») on a static page that is the same for everyone. It is static prerender: in site/build.cjs:432-444 the tab is built from the AI digest cache (AIDG) behind APPROVED.digest in site/ai/approved.json, and no client code personalises it. The claim's facts all hold.
findings.corrected: The claim holds, with one caveat. The tab is an AI digest the owner switched on (APPROVED.digest in site/ai/approved.json, build.cjs:432), so removing it should be flagged needs_owner. Proposal: stop showing the tab by default (build.cjs:436). A digest that is not redundant could come back only when it adds something: the team played that week, it is written in a neutral voice (no «فريقك»/«بتلعبونها» unless the page is the visitor's own team), and it names the opponent. On this page it adds nothing beyond the hero and the fixtures, so 4 tabs is right.

findings.title: The «الأرقام» shelf has 28 tiles, with overlaps and empty tiles
findings.evidence: The /c/uae-pro-league/ الأرقام tab has 28 tiles (44 templates on the page). Overlapping pairs: «ملوك الدقايق الأخيرة» and «أهداف بعد 90»; «أفضل محترف أجنبي», «أحسن صفقات» and «الأكثر تطوّر»; «منو الحاسم» and «الاعتماد على الهداف»; «تصنيف تيفو», «ترتيبهم بين العرب» and «ضد العالم». «أنجح المدربين في التاريخ» is in الأرقام rather than التاريخ. Some tiles only hold an empty state («المواهب الإماراتية تحت 23: للحين ما في لاعب…»), and «تقرير الشهر» is just 2 links. «الموسم بالرسم» is a shelf with a single tile.
findings.proposal: Merge down to about 16 tiles. Show 6 featured tiles plus «كل الأرقام (N)», in rows for players, teams, and coaches and referees. Hide empty-state tiles at build time. Move history tiles to التاريخ.
findings.verified: I curled https://tifo.elyoxe.com/c/uae-pro-league/ (297KB) and checked the الأرقام pane (section data-pane="num"). The page itself labels the shelf «الأرقام كلها» with the count 28. It is one flat `.shelf3` grid of 28 `button.sht` tiles, with no featured subset and no rows. I counted 28 h2 panels behind those tiles. The named tiles are there: «ملوك الدقايق الأخيرة» (teams that score or concede late) and «أهداف بعد الدقيقة 90» (a list of individual 90+ winners, so they do overlap), «أفضل محترف أجنبي», «أحسن صفقات الموسم», «الأكثر تطوّر», «منو الحاسم؟», «الاعتماد على الهداف», «تصنيف تيفو للأندية», «ترتيبهم بين الأندية العربية», «الدوري الإماراتي ضد العالم», and «أنجح المدربين في التاريخ», which sits in الأرقام and not in the hist pane. The empty state is confirmed: the «المواهب الإماراتية تحت 23» tile preview and its panel both show only «للحين ما في لاعب إماراتي تحت 23 سنة لعب 270 دقيقة أو أكثر هالموسم.» «الموسم بالرسم» is a shelf with 1 tile («رحلة الموسم»), but it is in the الترتيب (table) pane, not الأرقام. «تقرير الشهر» does not appear anywhere on this page (0 matches). I could not verify the "44 templates" figure.
findings.corrected: Mostly true. On /c/uae-pro-league/ the الأرقام tab is a flat grid of 28 tiles labelled «الأرقام كلها 28», with no featured tiles and no grouping. The overlapping pairs and trio are real (the actual titles are «أهداف بعد الدقيقة 90» and «ترتيبهم بين الأندية العربية»). «أنجح المدربين في التاريخ» sits in الأرقام when it belongs in التاريخ. «المواهب الإماراتية تحت 23» is a tile with only an empty state. Two corrections: «تقرير الشهر» is not on this page at all, and «الموسم بالرسم» (a shelf with 1 tile) is in the الترتيب tab, not الأرقام. The proposal stands: merge the overlaps to about 16 tiles, show 6 featured tiles plus «كل الأرقام (N)» in rows (players / teams / coaches and referees), drop empty-state tiles at build time, and move the all-time coaches tile to التاريخ.

findings.title: Squad tab: rows don't link to player pages, codes and names in Latin
findings.evidence: /t/102122/ squad pane has 36 rows and 0 /p/ links, although 21 of those player pages exist; /t/5789/ has 26 rows, 0 links, 26 pages exist. Country codes print raw: SEN, PAR, TUN (render.js:246). The served HTML has Latin names (Khalid Eissa, Hazaa Ammar); Arabic only arrives after app.js:165 re-fetches, even though players_ar has 36/36 and 26/26 by id.
findings.proposal: In R.squad, make each row <a href=/p/{id}/> when the page exists. Pre-map the name by id at build time (the map is already built at build.cjs ~445). Replace the country code with a flag and its Arabic name, and add age plus the position in Arabic.

findings.title: Arabic names missing in comp tiles, though the dictionary has them
findings.area: comp tiles / round XI (extends the in-flight Latin-names pass)
findings.evidence: /c/uae-pro-league/ has 150 Latin names, and one player appears in both scripts on the same page (إيغور كورونادو ×4 and Igor Coronado ×2; سيرجينيو and Serginho). 87 of them are exact keys in players_ar/coaches_ar (Saudi 65, PL 59). Tiles are static <template>s, so the page's PN map (102 entries) never reaches them. build.cjs:239-243 maps only allPlayers, cards and stats lists. Referees and clubs are already in flight; tile players and coaches are not.
findings.proposal: Add a final pass in write() that swaps X for Arabic when X is a unique Latin key (7,692 of them). Also map by id in team-of-round, foreigners, improved, transfers, records, alltime and coaches.

findings.title: Team page never shows the table or the team's position
findings.evidence: t/102122 and t/5789 contain 0 standings tables. Al Wahda's position (6th, 9 pts) appears only as prose in the 5th tab. Tonight the UAE page doesn't show its Gulf Cup group (قطر 4، الإمارات 3، اليمن 1، البحرين 0); it sits in «سيناريوهات» tile 2 of an 8-tile shelf. FotMob, SofaScore and 365 all lead the team overview with this.
findings.proposal: At the top of «الياية»: a 5-row slice of the table (this team's row in dune), a strip of the last 5 results, one line «لو فاز/تعادل/خسر» for tournaments, and a link to the full table.

findings.title: The goal-clock tile always answers «90»
findings.evidence: «أكثر دقيقة انسجل فيها: 90 (مع الوقت بدل الضايع)» appears on the UAE, PL and Gulf Cup pages alike. Stoppage time is folded into the 45 and 90 buckets (stats.js ~105-107), so 90 always peaks and the tile's only insight is the same everywhere.
findings.proposal: Leave 45 and 90 out of the peak. Report «أكثر ربع ساعة» and «X% من الأهداف في الوقت بدل الضايع» as two separate facts.

findings.title: Scorers on the same number of goals get ranks 1, 5 and 8
findings.evidence: On the /c/uae-pro-league/ الهدافين list, 9 players have 3 goals each but are ranked 1,1,1,1,5,5,5,8,8. FotMob's hidden tie-break rank is passed through (stats.json lists.goals[].rank).
findings.proposal: Rank on the shown value only, so all 9 are 1. Order ties by fewer minutes and show it («185 د») so the order explains itself.

findings.title: Leaderboards cover only goals and assists
findings.evidence: comp/538/players.json already holds rating (230 players), clean_sheet, saves, big_chance_created and yellow_card, for 538, 536 and 535. The lead segment offers only «الهدافين · صناع الأهداف». FotMob's stats tab leads with these.
findings.proposal: Add «الأعلى تقييم» and «الحراس» (clean sheets, saves) as cells of the same segmented control. That stays within one control and needs no new block.

findings.title: Round page lists the same results twice after about 3,700px of scroll
findings.evidence: /c/uae-pro-league/r/5/: «قصة الجولة» is 8 steps at min-block-size 55vh (about 3,700px on an 844px phone) under a sticky table of about 26rem. Then the same 7 results appear again with «7 مباراة خلصت · 17 هدف». The team-of-round names are in Latin (Serginho, Berkaoui, Tetteh).
findings.proposal: Lead with the results and the 3 numbers. Replace the scroll steps with an in-place «شغّل الجولة» autoplay on the table (1.2 s per result, no scroll hijack). Use Arabic names for the XI.

findings.title: H2H: short names truncated, ISO dates, no competition, no next meeting
findings.evidence: In next_h2h_390_full_s3b.png the bold winner shows as «الشار…» while the loser «الشارقة» fits in the same row. Cause: a 5.5rem date column (tifo.css:331) plus the bold weight. Dates are ISO («2026-09-19»). Rows carry no competition, and the page has no upcoming meeting.
findings.proposal: Move the date into a small line «19 سبتمبر 2026» with the competition name under each row, and drop the date column. Put a next-meeting card with a countdown on top. Draw 11/6/4 as a bar split in the two clubs' colours.

findings.title: Team fixture rows don't say which competition
findings.evidence: /t/5789/ mixes Gulf Cup rows (البحرين، قطر) with Asian Cup rows (فيتنام، اليمن، كوريا) and shows no competition. The /t/102122/ list doesn't say «ناساف كارشي» is an AFC match.
findings.proposal: Give each row a competition crest and short name, or group the rows under competition headers.

findings.title: Coach and referee pages show misleading scope and zeros
findings.evidence: /coach/886759/ (Dalić, UAE coach tonight) shows «82 مباراة», which is only Al Ain and Al Hilal league games 2012–17: no Croatia and no UAE record, and nothing says so. Many of the 884 coach pages have 1–2 matches. /r/1001072180/ shows «قرارات الفار 0» where the source has no VAR data; its match rows have no date and no cards; cards per match has no league average (fouls does).
findings.proposal: Coach: label the scope, add the current job's record from our national/club fixtures, and noindex pages under 5 matches. Referee: hide VAR when it is null, add the date and yellow/red counts per row, and a league average for cards.

findings.title: Comp page on a phone: the table starts below the fold (flag on the in-flight logo item)
findings.evidence: In next_comp_390_before.png the tabs start at about 745 of 844px, so no table row is visible without scrolling. «الجولة الياية 6 الجمعة 16 أكتوبر» reads as one run of numbers. The in-flight «smaller comp logo on phone» item saves only about 100px.
findings.proposal: Acceptance for that item: the top 5 table rows are visible above the bottom bar at 390×844. That means a 56–64px logo inline with the title and the stats on one line. Write the round line as «الجولة 6 · الجمعة 16 أكتوبر».

findings.title: Team hero repeats the next match; names and dates need cleaning
findings.evidence: In next_team_390_before.png, «الياية البحرين ضد الإمارات الأحد 27 سبتمبر 22:00» is followed straight away by «البحرين ضد الإمارات 00:18:36». Al Wahda's coach appears as the full legal name «بيريكليس رايموندو أوليفيرا شاموسكا» and the stadium as «استاد ال نهيان». Tiles use ISO dates («أكبر فوز 7-1 … 2016-11-02»).
findings.proposal: Put the countdown inside the الياية line. Trim coach names to FotMob's display form, as was done for players' wd_label. Correct the stadium to «آل نهيان» in stadiums.yaml. Format tile dates as «2 نوفمبر 2016».

lenses.summary:
I audited about 45 hub, reference and tool pages. I used the live site (curl, including /v1 and /api), the built out/ folder, the code and the screenshots. Six root URLs return 404 by design because they are nested routes: /compare/ → /c/<slug>/compare/, /kit/ → /m/<id>/kit/, /poster/ and /month/ → /t/<id>/…, /power/ → /c/uae-pro-league/power/, and /coach-compare/ → /coach/compare/.

Tonight's biggest problem is data. The Gulf Cup (comp 329) is missing from the per-country channel data, so /guide/, the kit page and the home «المجاني في بلدك» filter all drop Bahrain v UAE. Three hubs have real bugs: /m/null/, the /coefficients/ club table, and blank team names on /explore/. The structural problem is that the menus and /week/ are built for the UAE, while 15 pan-Arab hubs can only be reached from /arabs/. There is also a lot of overlap, with 11 pages answering «متى/وين».

Verdict per page:

**Keep (checked, healthy):**
- /studio/, /lab/, /c/*/compare/ (15 competitions), /coach/compare/ (linked from coach pages), /c/uae-pro-league/power/
- /t/*/poster/ (679 pages), /t/*/month/
- /embed/m/ and /embed/t/: the embed button is on 5,183 pages
- /cast/: audio returns 206 audio/mpeg, and the RSS feed exists
- /newsletter/: the API validates input, and cron sends it Thursday 18:00
- /ask/: the API is alive
- /laws/, /legends/, /streaks/, /golden-boot/, /poty/, /clashes/, /nations-h2h/, /worldcup-arabs/
- /national/ hub table, /break/, /today/ and /tomorrow/ (search landing pages), /tv/, /arabs/week/
- /memorable/ and /stadiums/: keep, with the text fixes in finding 12

**Fix:** /arabs/, /week/, /thisday/, /coefficients/, /explore/, /transfers/, /derbies/, /watch/, the kit pages, and the 21 League Cup fixtures that share /m/null/.

**Merge and redirect (301):**
- /countdowns/ and /match-of-week/ → /week/
- /w/ → /tv/
- /guide/ → /watch/, as one page that changes by country
- /year/ → /calendars/
- /academy/ → /glossary/
- /national/<cc>/ → the team page; /t/5789/ should point its canonical to /uae/

**Hide now:** the empty sections on the kit pages, and /m/null/.

There is no pageview data anywhere, so any keep/remove call is a guess until counting is added (finding 16).

Evidence folders: /root/workspace/saas/football/site/build.cjs, /root/workspace/saas/football/site/build_arabs.cjs, /root/workspace/saas/football/site/src/app.js, /root/workspace/research/tifo-2026-09-27/broadcast_by_country.json, and the screenshots in /root/.claude/jobs/abd28f85/tmp/.

findings.title: Tonight's Gulf Cup has no channel data: /guide/, the kit page and «المجاني في بلدك» all drop Bahrain v UAE
findings.evidence: bc.583b2da6af.json has comp 329 = null for all 22 countries. research/tifo-2026-09-27/broadcast_by_country.json has no 329 for AE, and also none for 11027, 9943 or 9470. But broadcast.json, which feeds /watch/ (build.cjs:657), does list 329: أبوظبي الرياضية and الشارقة الرياضية, both free. Live results: /guide/ never mentions كأس الخليج, not even while Yemen v Qatar was live. /m/6052085/kit/ shows «غير معروف» in all 22 rows. app.js:64 freeIn() hides the match when «المجاني في بلدك» is on.
findings.proposal: Now: at build.cjs:175, when bc[AE][comp] is missing, fall back to the broadcast.json rows. Change freeIn() so an unknown channel shows the match instead of hiding it. /guide/ should list matches with no known channel under «القناة: ما تأكدنا». Next: sourced research for comp 329 in the other 21 countries (roadmap rule: no channel names from memory). Add a build warning when a competition with a match in the next 48 hours has no channel rows.
findings.verified: I checked the live site, the data files and the code, and the claim holds. (1) site/out/assets/bc.583b2da6af.json: all 22 countries lack key 329. The AE entry's comp keys are 42, 47, 53, 54, 55, 73, 87, 289, 290, 519, 525, 526, 530, 536, 538, 9468, 9469, 10196, 10197, 10216, 10242 and 10608, so 329, 11027, 9943 and 9470 are all missing. (2) ~/workspace/research/tifo-2026-09-27/broadcast.json does have 329, "Arabian Gulf Cup (Khaleeji 27)", listing أبوظبي الرياضية and الشارقة الرياضية, both marked free, with a WAM source and confidence high. That file only feeds BC (build.cjs:197 and /watch/ at :684). Live /watch/ does show both channels. (3) The API at /v1/match/6052085.json gives comp 329, status live. (4) /v1/guide/AE.json, /BH.json and /SA.json, generated 18:05Z, contain no 329, no 6052085 and no «الخليج». On the live /guide/ page, «كأس الخليج» appears only in the nav shortcut link. (5) The /m/6052085/kit/ table is built client-side in app.js:266. With bc[c][329] missing for every country, each row falls to `غير معروف`, so the result is 22 × «غير معروف», confirmed from the code. (6) In app.js:253, freeIn() returns false when BCD[c][comp] is missing, and app.js:64 filters those matches out when «المجاني» is on, which hides Bahrain v UAE. Small inaccuracies in the claim: the per-country build is at build.cjs:192, not :175, and /watch/ is at build.cjs:684, not :657. Also, /guide/ is not built by build.cjs. It comes from /v1/guide/{iso}.json, produced by ~/workspace/saas/football/arabs.py from broadcast_by_country.json (the build/lambda copy also lacks 329). So the proposed fallback in build.cjs alone fixes the kit page and the free filter but not /guide/.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, with two corrections. The per-country channel map is built at build.cjs:192 (not :175) from broadcast_by_country.json. It has no 329 (Gulf Cup), 11027, 9943 or 9470 for any country, while broadcast.json (build.cjs:197, used by /watch/ at :684) lists the free channels أبوظبي الرياضية and الشارقة الرياضية for 329. The effects are live now: /m/6052085/kit/ shows «غير معروف» in all 22 rows (app.js:266), «المجاني» hides the match (app.js:64/253), and /v1/guide/{AE,BH,SA}.json omit the match. Fix plan: at build.cjs:192, fill bc.AE[329] from broadcast.json for the UAE only; the other countries still need sourced research. Make freeIn() keep matches whose channel is unknown. Apply the same fallback, plus a «القناة: ما تأكدنا» row, in arabs.py where /v1/guide/{iso}.json is generated, because a build.cjs change does not reach /guide/.

findings.title: 21 League Cup fixtures share one page, /m/null/
findings.evidence: /v1/comp/11027/fixtures.json: 21 of 42 matches have id null and no kickoff. Two pages are live (200): out/m/null/ («الشارقة ضد حتا — كأس رابطة المحترفين») and /m/null/kit/. /m/null/ is in sitemap.xml, and 25 built pages link to it (c/uae-league-cup/r/4, r/5, r/6, c/uae-pro-league/r/8 and others). Every one of those fixtures opens the same wrong match.
findings.proposal: In build.cjs, skip any match whose id is null: no page, no kit, no sitemap URL. Show those fixtures as plain rows without a link, labelled «الموعد ما تأكد». Separately, fix the adapter that feeds the League Cup so every fixture gets a stable id.
findings.verified: Live API /v1/comp/11027/fixtures.json has 42 matches, and 21 of them have id=null, kickoff=null and date_tbd=true. They come from source 'uaepl', and each still has a unique ext_id such as 'uaepl:327b9924-...'. curl shows https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/null/ returns 200 with the title «الشارقة ضد حتا — كأس رابطة المحترفين | تيفو», and /m/null/kit/ also returns 200. /m/null appears in the live sitemap.xml once. grep of ~/workspace/saas/football/site/out found exactly 25 built files with href="/m/null/". These are league-cup r/4, r/5 and r/6, pro-league r/7 to r/26 (20 pages), and m/null plus m/null/kit themselves. Live /c/uae-league-cup/r/4/ and /c/uae-pro-league/r/8/ each have 7 cards with href="/m/null/" data-mid="null". The auditor missed that the Dubai Pro League (ADNOC) feed has the same problem: live /v1/comp/538/fixtures.json has 140 of 182 matches with id=null, covering every round from 7 to 26. That is why the pro-league round pages link to /m/null.
findings.corrected: [broken/high] 161 UAE fixtures open one wrong page, /m/null/: 140 in ADNOC Pro League (comp 538, rounds 7–26) and 21 in the League Cup (comp 11027, rounds 4–6). All come from the 'uaepl' adapter with id=null. /m/null/ and /m/null/kit/ are live with status 200 and show «الشارقة ضد حتا — كأس رابطة المحترفين». /m/null/ is in sitemap.xml. 23 round pages link to it (7 cards on each round page checked): c/uae-pro-league/r/7 to r/26 and c/uae-league-cup/r/4 to r/6. So nearly every future league card on the site's main competition sends the user to the same wrong match. The fix in build.cjs/render.js is to not render a match page, kit page, sitemap URL or link when id is null, and to show the row as plain text with «الموعد ما تأكد». In the uaepl adapter, the ext_id (unique and already present) should become a stable id, or be used to match the fixture to its fotmob id.

findings.title: /coefficients/ club table shows countries where the clubs should be
findings.evidence: The table «الأندية العربية في تصنيف أفريقيا» has 24 rows, and its النادي column reads مصر، تونس، المغرب، الجزائر، مصر… Two Libyan rows show rank 0. Cause: in coefficients.json, caf_clubs[].name_ar holds the country name, and site/build_arabs.cjs:144 prints `a.name_ar || a.club`.
findings.proposal: Map a.club to the Arabic club name (teams_ar.yaml or arab_clubs.json), and show the country as a small label with a flag. Drop the rank-0 rows. Until the fix ships, hide this one table; the two country-level tables above it are correct.
findings.verified: Live page: curl --compressed https://tifo.elyoxe.com/coefficients/. The table «الأندية العربية في تصنيف أفريقيا» has 27 rows (the claim says 24). Every cell in the النادي column holds a country name: مصر، تونس، المغرب، الجزائر، مصر، مصر… Data: ~/workspace/saas/football/coefficients.json, caf_clubs_2026_27. Every Arab entry has the English club in `club` (for example Al Ahly, Espérance de Tunis, RS Berkane) and the country in `name_ar` (for example مصر، تونس، المغرب). Code: ~/workspace/saas/football/site/build_arabs.cjs:144 prints `esc(a.name_ar || a.club)`. So name_ar, which holds the country, always wins, and the club name never shows. Three Libyan rows have rank 0, not two: Abu Salim, Al Hilal Benghazi and Al Ittihad. They appear on the live page as ليبيا / 0 / 6, 3 and 2. The two tables above it (AFC and CAF, one row per country) use name_ar correctly.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, but two counts are wrong. The table has 27 rows, not 24, and three Libyan rows show rank 0, not two (Abu Salim, Al Hilal Benghazi, Al Ittihad). Cause as stated: in coefficients.json, caf_clubs_2026_27[].name_ar holds the country name, and build_arabs.cjs:144 prints `a.name_ar || a.club`. So every النادي cell shows the country (مصر، تونس…), and the English club name in `club` is never rendered. The proposal stands. Map `club` to its Arabic name, with name_ar or iso2 shown as a small country label and flag. Drop or mark the rank-0 rows, and hide this table until the fix ships.

findings.title: The kit pages are hollow: all 27 have an empty section
findings.evidence:
All 27 kit pages (/m/*/kit/) show the «صور للمشاركة» heading with nothing under it. Cause: legacy() at build.cjs:45 moves any `

` button into the share sheet, and the kit body at build.cjs:524 uses exactly that markup. 5 of the 27 show «ما في أرقام للحين», including tonight's /m/6052085/kit/, and its country table is «غير معروف» throughout (see finding 1). next_kit_390_full_s36.png shows it. The page is reachable only from the match share sheet.
findings.proposal: At build.cjs:521-525, render the story button with a class other than .tools so it stays on the page. Skip the numbers section when it is empty. When the channel is unknown, show only the date and time and leave the channel cell out. If the numbers stay empty for national-team matches, don't generate a kit page for those matches.
findings.verified:
Code: at build.cjs:46, legacy() uses a regex to take every `

` that holds only buttons out of the body and adds them to the share sheet's tools. The kit page does not set v3:true, so it goes through legacy(). At build.cjs:551 its «صور للمشاركة» section is `

`, which is exactly that markup, so the story button moves into the sheet. Live page: curl of /m/6052085/kit/ returns `صور للمشاركة` with nothing under the heading, and the story button text is present in the page (it is inside the sheet). The live page also shows «ما في أرقام للحين». Local build: out/m/*/kit/index.html has 27 pages. All 27 have the empty section, and 5 of them show «ما في أرقام للحين». Country table: src/app.js:266 prints «غير معروف» whenever the broadcast data has no entry for the competition. The live /assets/bc.583b2da6af.json has 22 countries and none of them has broadcasters for comp 329, so all 22 rows say «غير معروف». Screenshot next_kit_390_full_s36.png matches this: the heading has nothing under it, the numbers section is empty, and every channel cell reads «غير معروف». Links: the kit link at build.cjs:518 is an `` inside the match page's `tools`, which is rendered inside the #share sheet. It does not appear in sitemap.xml (0 kit URLs). So the page is reachable only from the share sheet, as claimed.
findings.corrected:
The claim is true. Only the line numbers are wrong: the regex in legacy() is at build.cjs:46, not 45. The kit body is at build.cjs:548-553, and the story button's `

` is at :551, not 524. The kit link in the share sheet is at build.cjs:518. The proposed fix holds: at :551, render the button without the p.tools wrapper (or pass v3:true and build the hero yourself) so it stays on the page. Hide the numbers section when `nums` is empty. Drop the «القناة» column when the broadcast data has no entry for md.comp in any country (comp 329 has none in all 22 countries).

findings.title: Merge /countdowns/ and /match-of-week/ into /week/, and /w/ into /tv/
findings.evidence: /countdowns/ is the /week/ list plus timers, with a legacy red #D8343F bar (tifo.css:361) that breaks the red-only-for-cards rule. /match-of-week/ stores a stale kickoff: it shows Yemen v Qatar at 19:00, but /v1/match/6052084.json says 19:55. For anyone without a saved team, /w/ shows only «اختار فريقك من صفحة النادي…», yet it is in every footer. Eleven pages answer «متى/وين»: home, today, tomorrow, week, countdowns, match-of-week, break, guide, watch, tv and w.
findings.proposal: On /week/, add a pinned first card «مباراة الأسبوع» with its live kickoff, and a small countdown on each row. Redirect (301) /countdowns/ and /match-of-week/ to /week/; the national-team countdown (item 62) stays on home and /uae/. On /tv/, add a «فريقي» toggle and redirect /w/ to /tv/?mine=1. Remove both links from the footer and sheet.
findings.verified:
Fetched the live /countdowns/, /match-of-week/, /w/, /week/ and /tv/ pages with curl, plus /v1/match/6052084.json, and read src/tifo.css. Four of the claim's points hold up:
(1) tifo.css:361 `.cd{...border-inline-start:.5rem solid #D8343F}`. That is the same value as --card-r (tifo.css:6), so red is used outside cards.
(2) /match-of-week/ is stale. It is baked with `<time class="tt" data-u="2026-09-27T19:00:00+04:00">19:00</time>` for Yemen v Qatar, but the API says kickoff_uae 19:55 (FT 0-1). The client only formats data-u, so the page shows 19:00.
(3) /w/ with no saved team shows only «اختار فريقك من صفحة النادي، وبعدها افتح هالصفحة.», and «وضع المتابعة» sits in the footer and the sheet. /week/ and /tv/ each carry href="/w/" twice.
(4) /break/, /guide/, /tomorrow/, /today/ and /watch/ all return 200, so the list of 11 «متى/وين» pages is roughly right.
One point is wrong: /countdowns/ is NOT "the /week/ list plus timers". Its data-u runs from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-18 and it is a curated big-match list (UAE v Qatar, Pro League Cup, Zamalek v Ahly, ADNOC league). /week/ runs only from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-03 and includes Moroccan league games. So a 301 to /week/ would lose the 2-3 week horizon.
findings.corrected:
Mostly true. Fold /match-of-week/ into /week/ as a pinned first card whose time comes from the live match JSON, not a baked data-u. That also fixes the stale 19:00 vs 19:55. Then 301 the page to /week/.
Do not 301 /countdowns/ to /week/, because it covers big matches out to 18 Oct and /week/ stops at 3 Oct. Either keep it as the «كم باقي؟» long-horizon page, or add a «الكبيرة الياية» section below /week/ that lists the same fixtures before redirecting.
Change the .cd bar at tifo.css:361 from #D8343F to a non-card colour, such as chalk or the club colour.
The /w/ merge into /tv/?mine=1 is reasonable. At minimum, /w/ needs a crest picker for the empty state instead of a dead-end sentence, and its footer and sheet links should be hidden when no team is saved.

findings.title: Two «وين تنقل» pages with different data
findings.evidence: /watch/ covers only the UAE (broadcast.json) and includes the Gulf Cup. /guide/ covers 22 countries (broadcast_by_country.json) and has no Gulf Cup. The sheet links /watch/, /arabs/ links /guide/, and /today/ adds a third entry point with «وين تنقل كل بطولة».
findings.proposal: Keep one page, /watch/: a country picker (defaulting to country()), channels per competition at the top (today's /watch/ layout), and the next 3 days' matches with their channel below (today's /guide/). Use one data file for both. Redirect (301) /guide/ to /watch/.
findings.verified: Code: build.cjs:684-685 builds /watch/ from broadcast.json (BC) and titles it UAE-only ("وين تنقل المباريات في الإمارات"). build_arabs.cjs:187-189 builds /guide/ ("دليل القنوات") from /v1/guide/{iso}.json and adds a country picker (#gsel). The live AE guide's source field reads "broadcast_by_country.json x FotMob fixtures". build/lambda/broadcast_by_country.json has 22 countries, and AE's competition keys (47, 87, 53, 42, …, 290) do not include 329, the Gulf Cup. Live site: /watch/ has an h2 «كأس الخليج العربي» among 23 competition sections. /v1/guide/AE.json and /v1/guide/SA.json each list 24 matches (22 AFCON qualifiers, 2 Botola) and leave out tonight's live Gulf Cup match, Bahrain v UAE (6052085, comp 329). The only «الخليج» on /guide/ is the nav link to /c/gulf-cup/. Links: the sheet (build.cjs:67) and footer (build.cjs:84) point to /watch/. /arabs/ links /guide/ (build_arabs.cjs:102, confirmed live). /today/ has the button «وين تنقل كل بطولة» linking /watch/ (build.cjs:631, confirmed live). The match page's wwbox is a fourth UAE-only block, and app.js:251-256 swaps in the visitor's country from broadcast_by_country.
findings.corrected: The claim is essentially true, and the gap is visible tonight: /guide/ does not show the live Bahrain v UAE Gulf Cup match, because broadcast_by_country.json has no key 329. One small fix to the wording: /today/ is not a third page. Its «وين تنقل كل بطولة» button links to /watch/, so there are two pages and three kinds of entry point (sheet/footer/today to /watch/, /arabs/ to /guide/). When merging, add the Gulf Cup (329) and the other competitions that are in broadcast.json but missing from broadcast_by_country.json, or the single page will lose them. Also point the match-page wwbox (build.cjs:515-516) at the same data.

findings.title: /explore/ archive shows blank team names (45% of rows in 2015/16)
findings.evidence: In /v1/archive/all/2015-2016.json, 761 of 1,705 rows use team ids that are missing from /v1/teams.json, so app.js:343 prints an empty name. In 2025/26 it is 291 of 2,681. The rows are not links, and the page is reachable only from /arabs/.
findings.proposal: Store the home and away names in each archive row at build time, or ship a small team-name map for the archive. Skip a row that has no name instead of printing a score with one side blank. Then link it from each competition page as «المواسم السابقة». Until the fix ships, hide seasons before 2020.
findings.verified:
I downloaded the live /v1/archive/all/2015-2016.json, /v1/archive/all/2025-2026.json and /v1/teams.json and checked the home and away ids (m[3], m[4]) of every row against teams.json. In 2015-2016, 761 of 1,705 rows (44.6%) have at least one team id that is missing from teams.json or has no name. In 2025-2026 it is 291 of 2,681. Both counts match the claim exactly.

The code confirms the effect. In site/src/app.js, the explore block around lines 343-345 uses nm(id), which returns "" when T[id] is missing. draw() then prints that empty string inside a <span> next to the score, with nothing to skip such rows.

The rows are plain <li>/<span> elements, not links. A grep for '/explore/' in site/src and the *.cjs build files matches only build_arabs.cjs, and the live /arabs/ page links to /explore/. The claim holds.

findings.title: Merge /year/ into /calendars/ and /academy/ into /glossary/
findings.evidence: /year/ is 9 month tiles, each hiding a single line such as «6 سبتمبر لين 9 أكتوبر توقف الدوري الكويتي الممتاز» (next_year_390_s3b.png). /calendars/ lists the same league breaks. The SHELF_PATH rule at build.cjs:42 turns both into tap-to-open tiles. Each /academy/ lesson ends with «أو في القاموس» and explains the same terms as /glossary/: تصنيف تيفو، نسب الفوز، محاكي الموسم، الأهداف المتوقعة، الضغط.
findings.proposal: Make /calendars/ one inline month timeline, with no tiles, that includes the finals from /year/; redirect (301) /year/. Add each academy live example under its /glossary/ term, for example «الحين: العين 1736»; redirect (301) /academy/ to /glossary/. The «اقرا وتعلّم» group then shrinks to قانون الكورة and القاموس.
findings.verified: Looked at next_year_390_full_s3b.png, which shows the «كل الأقسام» shelf of 9 month tiles. Each tile shows one line, for example «6 سبتمبر لين 9 أكتوبر توقف الدوري الكويتي الممتاز». Fetched /year/, /calendars/, /academy/ and /glossary/ with curl --compressed (all 200, 3-5KB each). The /year/ break entries match /calendars/ date for date: Kuwait 6 Sep to 9 Oct, ADNOC 11 Sep to 16 Oct, Qatar 12 Sep to 8 Oct, and so on. /calendars/ is also shelved («كل الأقسام 10», one tile per league). /year/ has two things /calendars/ does not: the finals (6 أكتوبر نهائي كأس الخليج, 5 فبراير نهائي كأس آسيا) and a view by month across leagues. build.cjs:42 SHELF_PATH does match both /year/ and /calendars/. Every one of the 7 /academy/ lessons ends with «شوفها في الموقع ، أو في القاموس». Its terms (تصنيف تيفو, نسب الفوز, محاكي الموسم, الأهداف المتوقعة/الحظ, الضغط) are already defined on /glossary/. What academy adds is live examples: العين 1736, الظفرة 32%, 63%, سيتي 15 against 9.1, الشارقة 9.7. Checked the nav at build.cjs:68 (same at redesign/build_next.cjs:90): the «اقرا وتعلّم» group has 6 links, namely الأساطير, مباريات لا تُنسى, هذا اليوم, قانون الكورة, الأكاديمية and القاموس.
findings.corrected: The claim is mostly right, with one factual error and two additions. Fold /year/ into /calendars/: 301 /year/ to /calendars/ and add a month view to /calendars/ that includes the Gulf Cup and Asian Cup finals, which today appear only on /year/. Take /calendars/ out of SHELF_PATH (build.cjs:42) so it renders inline, and also take /year/ out if it stays as a redirect stub. Fold /academy/ into /glossary/: put each academy live example under its term (for example «الحين: العين 1736») and 301 /academy/ to /glossary/. The error: the «اقرا وتعلّم» group (build.cjs:68 and redesign/build_next.cjs:90) does not shrink to قانون الكورة and القاموس. It drops only الأكاديمية and keeps 5 links: الأساطير, مباريات لا تُنسى, هذا اليوم, قانون الكورة, القاموس. The /year/ link sits elsewhere in the nav and footer. Update the inbound links too: /today/, /week/, /watch/ and /arabs/ link to /year/ or /academy/.

findings.title: The «المزيد» sheet and footer are UAE-only; 15 pan-Arab hubs are orphaned
findings.evidence: build.cjs:66 hardcodes the «اختصارات» row to دوري أدنوك, /uae/ and كأس الخليج for every country. The footer and sheet appear on all 12,697 pages and link 16 pages; 6 of them cover only the UAE (legends, memorable, thisday, stadiums, watch, cast). /arabs/ is in neither. Nine hubs have exactly one inbound link, from /arabs/: /year/, /calendars/, /coefficients/, /guide/, /explore/, /clashes/, /golden-boot/, /poty/, /transfers/.
findings.proposal: Fill «اختصارات» in the browser from country(): the visitor's league, /national/<cc>/ and their cup. The ISO-to-league map already exists as ARAB in newsletter/send.py. Add a sheet group «العرب» with /arabs/, /golden-boot/, /transfers/, /streaks/ and /derbies/. Rename the UAE-only group «من الإمارات» and put it last unless country() is AE. The footer should mirror the sheet.

findings.title: /arabs/ is a bare list of 16 links, followed by a 92-row table
findings.evidence: In next_arabs_390_s3c.png the whole first screen is plain text links, with no numbers or previews. Further down: a 92-row «العرب في أوروبا» table, about 60 coach names and 23 referee names in Latin letters, and a list of friendlies (7,614 characters of text in all). It is the only way into 15 pages.
findings.proposal: Turn it into a section front with 4 groups: اللاعبين، المنتخبات، الأندية، الروزنامة. Each card shows its title and one live number, for example «ياسر زبيري 6 أهداف» on الحذاء الذهبي or «نادي الكويت 39 بدون خسارة» on السلاسل. Keep نجم الأسبوع as the hero. Move the 92-row table to /arabs/europe/, and put the coach and referee lists behind cards.

findings.title: /week/ is a bottom-nav tab, but it ranks UAE matches first for every country
findings.evidence: The ranking in build.cjs:565 (wscore) adds +100 for UAE competitions and +150 for the UAE team. The page text at build.cjs:568 says «بتوقيت الإمارات: مباريات الإمارات أول». In next_week_390_full_s36.png, 9 of the 12 picks are UAE League Cup or Gulf Cup games. There is no Saudi, Egyptian or big European match. A Moroccan visitor's «الأسبوع» tab leads with الشارقة ضد الظفرة.
findings.proposal: Put about 40 candidates with a base score into #wkdata. In app.js, re-rank them by country(): +100 for the visitor's league, +150 for their national team, +60 for an Arab derby (R.H2HK), then keep the top 12. Change the text to «بتوقيت بلدك: مباريات بلدك أول».

findings.title: «هذا اليوم» shows the whole year, starting 2 January
findings.evidence: next_thisday_390_full_s36.png is 23,789px tall and opens on «2 يناير». The page has 139 date headings and 185 events, and no anchors or jump to today's date (the page body has no ids). It covers only UAE football, yet it is linked from every page.
findings.proposal: Open on today's date: render today's block first using the existing S.thisday(events, ar, mmdd, n) at stats.js:290, with ‹أمس / بكرة› arrows, and collapse the rest by month. If nothing happened today, show the nearest date with «ما صار شي في هاليوم». Later: one URL per day (/thisday/09-27/) for search.

findings.title: The UAE team has 3 self-canonical URLs; other Arab teams have 2
findings.evidence: Three indexed pages each point their canonical at themselves: /uae/ (a copy of /t/5789/ made at build.cjs:430), /t/5789/, and /national/ae/. The other 21 Arab teams each have both /t/<id>/ and /national/<cc>/. /national/ae/ links to both of the others, which splits search ranking and confuses visitors.
findings.proposal: Move the /national/<cc>/ content (Tifo rank, FIFA history, تاريخه الدولي, record against each opponent) into a «التاريخ» tab on the team page. Set the /t/5789/ canonical to /uae/. Redirect (301) /national/<cc>/ to the team page, and link the /national/ hub table straight to team pages.

findings.title: English research notes on Arabic pages, and «ال» where «آل» is meant
findings.evidence: /watch/ shows «beIN subscription (tier carrying AFC not stated)», «Free (720p) / Basic / Premium» and «TOD Full Pass». On /s/hazza-bin-zayed-stadium/, the address and bus route are in English (next_stadium_390_full_s36.png). /memorable/ shows «2025-11-18 Iraq 2-1 United Arab Emirates» and «2026 FIFA World Cup qualification (AFC)». /stadiums/ spells «استاد ال نهيان» and «ال مكتوم» (stadiums.yaml:33, 43, 75). None of this is covered by item 397, which is limited to referees, subs and clubs.
findings.proposal: Fix «آل» in stadiums.yaml now; it is a ruling-family name. Render only the Arabic fields: on /watch/, drop the English price notes and keep «مجاني» or «اشتراك». On /s/*, hide the English address and bus lines until translated and keep the map link. On /memorable/, replace the English scoreline with the Arabic score row.

findings.title: /transfers/ is one endless list, mostly in Latin letters
findings.evidence: 269 rows on one page: 160 KB of HTML and 23,501px on a phone (next_transfers_390_full_s36.png). The filter defaults to «كل الدول». There are 130 Latin-text names (João Pedro Chermont, AC Boulogne-Billancourt, JS Massira) and Latin position codes (RB, ST, CM).
findings.proposal: Default the filter to country(). Show the latest 30, grouped by day, with a «المزيد» button. Use Arabic position labels (ظهير، مهاجم). Add a «انتقالات فريقك» block to team pages. Send the player and club names through the item 397 name-dictionary pass.

findings.title: No pageview data, so keep/remove decisions are guesses
findings.evidence: There is no CloudFront logging in site/template.yaml and no analytics script in any page. The only signal is the error beacon /api/tifo/err, which samples 20% of visits (app.js:8). About 45 hubs cannot be ranked by use.
findings.proposal: Reuse the error beacon: POST /api/tifo/hit with {path, country}, no cookies, and keep one daily counter per path in DynamoDB. Add «أقل 10 صفحات زيارة» to the existing Monday 8:00 report. After two weeks, hide hubs with fewer than about 5 views a week.

findings.title: /derbies/ shows empty cards for the two biggest North African derbies
findings.evidence: The cards for «ديربي الدار البيضاء (الوداد والرجاء)» and «ديربي العاصمة (شباب بلوزداد ومولودية الجزائر)» both say «ما عندنا سجل مواجهاتهم للحين». These are the derbies Moroccan and Algerian fans care most about. Item 340 (the Wydad–Raja record) is approved but not done.
findings.proposal: Hide derby cards with no record until item 340 lands, or show the last 5 meetings from the match archive. Put Wydad–Raja first once it is filled.

findings.title: The compare tools use the «فريقي» colour (dune) to mark the winning number
findings.evidence: `.cmpt b.w{background:var(--dune)}` in tifo.css paints the better number dune on both compare pages (next_compare_390_full_s36.png, next_coach-compare_390_full_s36.png). compare.js:25 also falls back to #B07A3B when both clubs share a colour. Dune is reserved for «فريقي».
findings.proposal: Mark the winning number in bold chalk with a 2px chalk underline (or a concrete fill with night text). Use concrete #E9ECE7 as the fallback when the club colours clash.

lenses.summary:
I sampled 262 sitemap URLs and scanned 1,412 of the 1,440 c/s/national/t/h2h pages. Every page returned 200, but several are broken. I re-checked the key items after the 18:32 UAE deploy and they are still live.

The worst is the UAE Pro League. 140/182 fixtures have id null, so 161 links on 23 round pages all go to /m/null/, and that URL shows one wrong match (الشارقة ضد حتا). The same null problem creates /r/null/, and both are in the sitemap.

Other defects visible to users:
- "undefined" and "null" appear on the pages themselves (most goals in a season; the Botola pressure index).
- The suspension box states wrong rules on 18 league pages: «إيقاف null», raw rule keys, a duplicated Bundesliga rule, and [object Object] source links.
- The UAE referee table shows foreign-league stats (Meler: 35 Süper Lig matches).
- Formation labels cut Arabic names into «الله حمد» and «الدين زهير».
- Raw English research notes appear in «وين تنقل» (25/44 packages) and on stadium pages («Bus: yes»).
- Knockout rounds are labelled «الجولة 1/8» and «3rd Place Final», and 5 sitemap URLs contain spaces.
- 30 placeholder team pages are published («Winner SF 2», «1B»).
- Dead internal links: 42/262 sampled pages; h2h 87% dead, /legends/ 8/11.

Structural gaps:
- 91% of pages, including home, have no og:image.
- Home and match pages have no h1.
- About 3k of the 11,989 sitemap URLs are thin.
- 98% of club pages have no squad.
- Same-name clubs are indistinguishable (3 × النصر، 3 × الأهلي).
- /api/tifo/err returns 404 because the cards Lambda wasn't redeployed.
- There is no PWA manifest (item 353).

Data freshness is fine. live.json, today's day file and tonight's /m/6052085/ update every 10–20 s, and health.json has no failures. Only the analytics jobs 'careers' (never succeeded) and 'improved:530' (403) are failing.

Referee h1s on /r/* are still Latin (15/15 in the sample), so the in-progress «remaining Latin names» item should cover referee pages too.

findings.title: Future UAE fixtures all link to one wrong match at /m/null/ (and /r/null/)
findings.evidence: Full scan: 23 round pages (/c/uae-pro-league/r/7..26/, /c/uae-league-cup/r/4..6/) carry 161 links to /m/null/. That URL is a live 200 page showing «الشارقة ضد حتا» (League Cup R6) with a self-canonical, and it is in the sitemap. Cause: 140/182 fixtures in v1/comp/538/fixtures.json and 21/42 in 11027 come from source 'uaepl' with id:null. /r/null/ («Sultan Mohamed») is linked from the referee tables on /c/uae-pro-league/, /c/saudi-pro-league/ and /c/laliga/. Re-checked after the 18:32 deploy: r/24 still has 7 null links.
findings.proposal: render.js:78: when !m.id, render the row as a non-clickable div. stats.js:119: when !r.id, don't link the referee. build.cjs: skip write() and the sitemap entry for any id==null. Later, attach fotmob ids to uaepl rows by matching (date, home, away).
findings.verified: Checked with curl --compressed on the live site. The UAE Pro League rounds /c/uae-pro-league/r/7..26/ and the UAE League Cup rounds /c/uae-league-cup/r/4..6/ each have exactly 7 href="/m/null/" links, 161 in total, which matches the claim. /m/null/ returns 200 with the title «الشارقة ضد حتا — كأس رابطة المحترفين | تيفو» and a canonical pointing to itself (https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/null/). /r/null/ returns 200 with the title «الحكم Sultan Mohamed: كروته وبلنتياته ومبارياته». Both URLs are in sitemap.xml. /r/null/ is linked 3 times on /c/uae-pro-league/ and on /c/laliga/, and it also appears on /c/saudi-pro-league/. In v1/comp/538/fixtures.json, 140 of 182 fixtures have id null, all from source 'uaepl'. I did not check comp 11027. In the code, src/render.js:78 builds href="/m/'+m.id+'/" with no null guard, and src/stats.js:119 (S.referees) builds href="/r/'+r.id+'/" with no guard. The claim is confirmed as stated. The proposed fix fits the code: guard at render.js:78 and stats.js:119, and skip null ids in build.cjs and in the sitemap.

findings.title: Suspension-rules box states wrong rules and has dead source links
findings.evidence: All 18 league pages with the box have href="[object Object]" source links, because sources in suspension_rules.json are {url,what,quote} while srcs() at stats.js:283 expects strings. /c/premier-league/ shows «إيقاف null مباراة» and «(لين club_19th_premier_league_match)» / «last_day_of_season». /c/caf-champions-league/ shows «كل 9 إنذارات = إيقاف null». /c/bundesliga/ lists «كل 5 إنذارات» twice, because the 10-yellow rule renders repeat_every (stats.js:502).
findings.proposal: srcs(): use u.url||u. Rule text: '5 إنذارات = مباراة، وبعدها كل 5 = مباراة'. Hide a rule when ban_matches is null. Map 'until' keys to Arabic («لين الجولة 19», «لين آخر الموسم») or drop them.
findings.verified: Code: srcs() at ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/stats.js:283 wraps each source in esc(u), so a {url,what,quote} object turns into "[object Object]". S.suspensions at stats.js:500-505 prints "كل " + (x.repeat_every || x.yellows) and passes ban_matches and until through raw. Data: ~/workspace/saas/football/build/lambda/suspension_rules.json has 22 competitions; 20 have sources, and every source is a dict, not a string. Live pages (curl --compressed) confirm every symptom in the claim. /c/premier-league/ shows «(لين club_19th_premier_league_match)», «(لين last_day_of_season)» and «كل 20 إنذارات = إيقاف null مباراة», with 3 links of href="[object Object]". /c/caf-champions-league/ shows «كل 9 إنذارات = إيقاف null مباراة», with 3 bad links. /c/bundesliga/ shows «كل 5 إنذارات = إيقاف 1 مباراة» twice, with 2 bad links. I did not curl all pages to confirm the exact count of 18.
findings.corrected: The claim is true, and the damage is wider than reported. (1) Every source link is dead. There is one per source (up to 3 per page) on every league page whose rules have sources: 20 competitions in the JSON, not verified as exactly 18 live pages. (2) The "كل N" wording is wrong for any threshold that does not repeat. Examples: /c/premier-league/ says «كل 10 إنذارات = إيقاف 2» when the 10th yellow is a one-off threshold. /c/serie-a/ renders «كل 1 إنذارات = إيقاف 1 مباراة» (from repeat_every=1 on the 19-yellow rule). /c/champions-league/ renders «كل 2 إنذارات» twice and «(لين end_of_play_offs)». Botola will say «كل 4» for its 12-yellow rule. (3) Raw 'until' keys appear on PL and UCL, and null ban_matches appears on PL and CAF. Fix: srcs() should use u.url||u. Render «عند الإنذار {yellows} = إيقاف {ban}», and add «ثم كل {repeat_every}» only when repeat_every is set. Skip a rule when ban_matches is null. Map the until keys (club_19th…→«لين الجولة 19», club_32nd…→«لين الجولة 32», last_day_of_season→«لين آخر الموسم», end_of_play_offs→«في التصفيات والملحق بس») and drop any key that has no mapping. The "الطرد المباشر = 1 على الأقل" line is technically true but thin; for the PL, red_ban.note says violent conduct and serious foul play carry 3 matches.

findings.title: Pages show the words undefined and null

findings.title: Referee table mixes in other leagues' stats
findings.evidence: On /c/uae-pro-league/ (re-checked after 18:32), Halil Umut Meler shows 35 matches, 4.3 yellows, 5 reds, 19 pens. His source_stats.scope is Süper Lig (v1/comp/538/referees.json: he has 1 UAE match). Mariani shows 33 and Pinheiro 31. stats.js:119 uses r.source_stats whatever its scope_comp, and sorts by r.matches while displaying s.matches.
findings.proposal: stats.js:119 (and :377 on /r/ pages): use s only when s.scope_comp===comp id, otherwise use the ledger counts, and sort by the same value that is displayed. Same fix for every comp.
findings.verified: Read stats.js:119 (S.referees): it sorts by r.matches but shows s = r.source_stats in every column, and never checks scope_comp. Fetched the live v1/comp/538/referees.json and the live /c/uae-pro-league/ table. Meler: ledger 1 UAE match, source_stats.scope_comp 71, and the page shows 35 / 4.3 / 5 / 19. Mariani shows 33 (scope 55) and Pinheiro 31 (scope 61). Other referees are wrong too: Valenzuela shows 50 (scope 339), Lambrechts 37 (scope 40), Tejera 12 (scope 45), and Martínez 6 and Barton 5 (both scope 297). The matches column comes out of order (2,2,...,1,33,31,...,50,...,35) because rows are sorted by ledger matches while source matches are displayed. Checked stats.js:377 (S.refPage) and the live /r/1001074881/ page: the headline counts use the ledger (1 match, 0.0). But the fouls row takes s.fouls_per_match with no scope check, so it shows «أخطاء بالمباراة 25.5 (معدل الدوري 26.1)», which is the Süper Lig average labelled as «الدوري».
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, with a few extra details. In S.referees (stats.js:119), use source_stats only when s.scope_comp equals the comp id. Otherwise use the ledger counts, and sort by the same value you display. In S.refPage (stats.js:377), the fouls row has the same problem: it shows another league's fouls average labelled «معدل الدوري», so apply the same scope_comp check there. The /r/ headline counts already come from the ledger and are fine. Some UAE referees whose scope is 538 also show season-long source totals, for example Omar Al Ali with 28 against 2 in the ledger. That is the same league, but the column then mixes two sources. Separately, the same table has 3 rows with no id that link to /r/null/ (Sultan Mohamed, Zayed Al Nuaimi, Mohamed Abdalla Al Harmoodi). Zayed Al Nuaimi also appears twice, once with an id and once without, and Mohamed Abdalla Al Harmoodi / Alharmoodi likewise. These should be merged or left unlinked.

findings.title: Pitch labels cut Arabic names into «الله حمد» and «الدين زهير»
findings.evidence: next_match_390_lineups_final.png shows «الدين زهير», «الله حمد» and «El Majhed». v3.js:19 swaps in the Arabic name, then render.js:183 surname() drops the first word, which breaks compounds (عبد الله، علاء الدين). This hits every lineup, including tonight's /m/6052085/.
findings.proposal: surname(): for Arabic, take the last word, but keep 2 words when the one before is عبد/أبو/بن/ابن or the last is الله/الدين/الرحمن. Also bake PN names into the prerendered HTML so no Latin flashes before JS runs.
findings.verified: 1) next_match_390_lineups_final.png: the pitch shows «الله حمد» (#12), «الدين زهير» (#5) and the Latin «El Majhed» (#35). The list under the pitch shows the full name «علاء الدين زهير». 2) site/src/v3.js:19: ar() replaces p.name with PN[p.id]. v3.js wraps R.lineups so that runs before pitchSide. 3) site/src/render.js:183: surname() = p.slice(1).join(" "), which drops only the first word. 4) curl --compressed https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/6052085/: the prerendered pitch already has Arabic names baked in, and the bug shows there too: «الله الخلاصي» (#23, the home side) and «الدين زهير» (#5, the away side). It also shows «عبد الجبار حسن» (#12), a 3-word label, because surname() keeps everything after the first word.
findings.corrected: The main claim holds. surname() at render.js:183 drops the first word of the Arabic name that v3.js:19 swaps in, and that splits compound names. This is confirmed in the screenshot («الله حمد», «الدين زهير») and in the live prerender of /m/6052085/ («الله الخلاصي», «الدين زهير»). Two parts need correcting. (a) The second half of the proposal is already done. The prerendered HTML for /m/6052085/ already contains Arabic pitch names, so no Latin flashes before JS runs. «El Majhed» appears because that player has no entry in players_ar.json (a names-coverage gap), not because of a pre-JS flash. (b) Because surname() drops only the first word, 3+ word names come out as long labels («عبد الجبار حسن»). The fix is to use a short Arabic label: take the last word, and keep two words when the word before it is عبد/أبو/بن/ابن/آل or the last word is الله/الدين/الرحمن. Apply it only when the name is Arabic, via the p._ar flag, and leave the current Latin logic unchanged.

findings.title: English research notes shown in «وين تنقل» and stadium guides
findings.evidence: 25/44 broadcaster packages in broadcast.json are English and print raw via stats.js S.watchWhere x.package. Every upcoming EPL/LaLiga/UCL/Ligue1/AFC/Saudi match shows e.g. «ULTIMATE / PREMIUM (tier not specified)», «TOD 4K/HDR | TOD HD | TOD Mobile», «beIN subscription (tier carrying AFC not stated)» (/m/5803095/, /m/6049999/). /s/sharjah-stadium/ shows «Bus: yes», «A car park space is included with the VVIP season card…» and the address «Sharjah Stadium - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates» (re-checked after 18:32).
findings.proposal: Add package_ar to broadcast.json and print package only when it is Arabic, never the parenthetical notes. In stadiums: bus yes→«في باص», use the Arabic address, and hide English parking text until it is translated (extend enAr at stats.js:310).
findings.verified: I fetched the live pages with curl and read the code, and the claim holds. /m/5803095/ shows «ULTIMATE / PREMIUM (tier not specified)» and «TOD 4K/HDR | TOD HD | TOD Mobile». /m/6049999/ shows «beIN subscription (tier carrying AFC not stated)». /s/sharjah-stadium/ shows «Bus: yes», the English car-park note «...car park space is included with the VVIP season card; general parkin...», and the address «Sharjah Stadium - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates». In the code, stats.js:302 (S.watchWhere) prints esc(x.package) as it is, with no Arabic field and nothing that drops English text. At stats.js:310, enAr only rewrites a few set phrases (parking available, free parking, minutes walking), so bus yes/no and the VVIP parking sentence get through. findings.title: Many internal links go to 404
findings.evidence: Sample: 42/262 pages have at least one dead link. Dead: h2h 222/254 match links (e.g. /h2h/102117-102119/ → /m/5282472/ 404), comp pages 324/4069 (/c/algeria-ligue-1/ 42 dead), /legends/ «صفحته في تيفو» 8/11 (→ /p/201165/ 404), match pages 41/349, /uae/ → /t/1925/ 404. Every /m/ and /p/ target outside the sitemap that I checked returned 404 (85/85).
findings.proposal: In build.cjs, keep a Set of written paths and pass a link(href) helper that renders plain text when the target wasn't built. Add a post-build check that fails the deploy if any internal href is missing.
findings.verified:
I checked the live site with curl on 2026-09-27. Every example in the claim checks out.
- The targets it names are all dead: /m/5282472/, /p/201165/ and /t/1925/ each return 404.
- The pages that link to them are all live (/h2h/102117-102119/, /legends/, /uae/, /c/algeria-ligue-1/, and the live match /m/6052085/ each return 200).
- /h2h/102117-102119/ has 25 distinct /m/ links, including /m/5282472/. All 25 return 404.
- /legends/ links to 9 player pages. 8 return 404 (117054, 117477, 131661, 167196, 167395, 170716, 201165, 341753) and only /p/197054/ returns 200.
- /uae/ contains href="/t/1925/", which returns 404.
- Code: src/stats.js:285 writes the «صفحته في تيفو» link whenever p.fotmob_id is set. It never checks whether that player page was built. build.cjs has no check for links to pages it didn't build.
- Not checked: I didn't finish the full link count for /c/algeria-ligue-1/ (143 distinct /m, /p and /t links, the check timed out), and I didn't redo the sitewide counts (42/262, 324/4069).
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed. Pages link to /m/, /p/ and /t/ pages that the static build never wrote. Measured: h2h match lists 25 of 25 dead, /legends/ 8 of 9 dead, and /uae/ links to /t/1925/, which is a 404. The cause is that links are written whenever the data has an ID, without checking that the page was built (for example src/stats.js:285). The proposed fix is right: in build.cjs, keep a set of paths that were actually written, and only turn a name into a link when its target is in that set. Add a post-build check that fails the deploy if any internal href is missing. Since h2h pages are almost all dead links, fix that first.

findings.title: Knockout rounds shown as «الجولة 1/8» and «3rd Place Final»
findings.evidence: R.roundLabel (render.js:152) uses parseFloat, so '1/8'→«الجولة 1/8» (/c/world-cup/r/1/8/) and «الجولة 3rd Place Final», «8th Finals», «1st Preliminary Round». 36 sitemap URLs are non-numeric. 5 have raw spaces in <loc> (/c/arab-cup/r/3rd Place Final/), which is invalid XML. Brackets show «1/8 1/4 1/2 final» (/c/uae-presidents-cup/) and «Preliminary Round … Semi-finals Final» (/c/amir-cup/).
findings.proposal: Extend R.stageAr with a knockout map: دور الـ32/الـ16، ربع النهائي، نصف النهائي، النهائي، تحديد المركز الثالث، الدور التمهيدي. Use ASCII slugs (r/r16/, r/qf/, r/sf/, r/final/, r/3rd/). Check for this map before parseFloat.
findings.verified:
Code: in ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/render.js:152, R.roundLabel is `isNaN(parseFloat(k)) ? esc(R.stageAr(k)) : "الجولة " + esc(k)`. parseFloat reads the leading number, so it gives 1 for '1/8', 3 for '3rd Place Final', 8 for '8th Finals' and 1 for '1st Preliminary Round', and all of these get the «الجولة» prefix. R.stageAr (render.js:92) only translates group names, so labels like 'Semi-finals' and 'Final' come through in raw English.

Live site (curl): /c/world-cup/r/1/8/ has the title «الجولة 1/8 2026 | تيفو» and the H1 «الجولة 1/8», and the slash in the slug makes the URL a nested path. /c/arab-cup/r/3rd%20Place%20Final/ returns 200 with «الجولة 3rd Place Final» in the title, meta and heading. /c/uae-presidents-cup/ shows round tabs labelled 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2. /c/amir-cup/ shows «8th Finals», «Preliminary Round», «Semi-finals» and «Final».

Sitemap: 36 /r/ URLs are non-numeric, and 5 <loc> entries contain raw spaces (arab-cup and afc-u23-asian-cup '3rd Place Final', amir-cup '8th Finals', caf-confederation-cup '1st' and '2nd Preliminary Round').
findings.corrected:
The claim is confirmed, with one correction. A raw space inside <loc> is still well-formed XML. The real fault is that it breaks the sitemap protocol and RFC 3986, because URLs must be escaped, so crawlers may drop or mangle those 5 entries.

Two more points should be added to the claim. First, the problem is wider than the «الجولة» prefix: stageAr leaves every non-group stage in English, including 'Semi-finals', 'Final' and 'Preliminary Round'. Second, the '1/8' slug turns into the nested path /r/1/8/. The proposed fix is still right: a knockout map checked before parseFloat, with ASCII slugs and redirects or canonical tags for the old URLs.

findings.title: 30 placeholder 'teams' are published pages («Winner SF 2», «1B»)
findings.evidence: Full scan: 30 sitemap /t/ pages are bracket placeholders with Latin h1, e.g. /t/1984/ «Winner SF 2», /t/1871/ «1B», /t/180625/ «3CDE», /t/437649/ «Winner 1D/3BEF». They also appear as-is in /c/asian-cup/ and /c/gulf-cup/ brackets («Winner QF», «Winner SF»).
findings.proposal: Detect ids whose name matches /^(Winner|Loser)\b|^[123][A-F](\/|$)|^3[A-F]{3,4}$/. Build no page, no link and no sitemap entry for them. In brackets, show «الفائز من نصف النهائي 2» / «أول المجموعة B» / «أحسن ثالث».
findings.verified: I fetched the four example pages. All four return 200. /t/1984/ has the title «Winner SF 2: المباريات والنتايج واللاعبين | تيفو», /t/1871/ has «1B: …», /t/180625/ has «3CDE: …» and /t/437649/ has «Winner 1D/3BEF: …». I then checked every one of the 739 /t/ URLs in the live /sitemap.xml against the proposed regex, going by each page's title. Exactly 30 match: 3ABF, 3ACD, 3BEF and 3CDE (4); 1A–1F (6); 2A–2F (6); Winner QF 1–4 (4); Winner SF 1–2 (2); and 8 R16 labels, «Winner 1A/3CDE» and so on (ids 437648–437654 and 6440). On /c/asian-cup/ the bracket shows 14 Latin «Winner …» labels (R16, QF, SF). On /c/gulf-cup/ the final is Winner SF 1 – Winner SF 2, as plain unlinked spans. build.cjs and src/*.js have no rule that filters these placeholders out.
findings.corrected: The claim is right apart from one detail. The h1 is not always Latin: some pages already show an Arabic h1 (/t/1984/ reads «الفائز من نصف النهائي 2» and /t/1871/ reads «متصدر المجموعة الثانية»). Others still have a Latin h1 (/t/180625/ «3CDE», /t/437649/ «Winner 1D/3BEF»). On all 30 pages the <title> and share metadata are still Latin, and all 30 are published with status 200 and listed in the sitemap. So the proposal stands: build no page, no sitemap entry and no link for any id that matches the regex, and render bracket slots with Arabic labels. The bracket slots are currently plain <span>s, not links, so they only need the Arabic text.

findings.title: Browser error reporting endpoint returns 404
findings.evidence: POST /api/tifo/err → 404 (the HTML 404 page). /api/tifo/ask, /subscribe and /tts answer 400 JSON, so the Lambda is up. The route exists in saas/cards/src/app.py:2102, but the deployed build lacks it. app.js:8 sends 20% of JS errors into this 404, so there is no JS error telemetry (item 347).
findings.proposal: Redeploy the cards Lambda (saas/cards deploy.sh), then confirm POST /api/tifo/err returns 204 and that tifo_err lines appear in the logs.
findings.verified:
I tested the live site with curl. POST https://tifo.elyoxe.com/api/tifo/err returned 404 as text/html, which is the site's Arabic 404 page. POST /api/tifo/ask, /subscribe and /tts each returned 400 as application/json with their own validation errors, so the Lambda is up. POST /api/tifo/nonexistent also returned 404, which is what a missing route looks like.

In the code, /root/workspace/saas/cards/src/app.py:1997 defines tifo_err, which always returns 204, including once the daily cap of 2000 is reached. Line 2102 routes POST ["tifo","err"] to it. The route arrived in commit 0904d07, dated 2026-09-27 16:16:42 +0400.

The deployed Lambda, elyoxe-cards-api, was last modified at 2026-09-27T09:47:32Z, which is 13:47 +0400. That is about 2.5 hours before the commit, so the live build does not have the route.

The client side matches the claim. /root/workspace/saas/football/site/src/app.js:8 has a beacon that fires on 1 in 5 page views, sends at most 3 reports each, and POSTs to /api/tifo/err. All of those requests currently hit the 404, so no JS error telemetry is being collected.
findings.corrected: The claim is accurate and the proposal is right. The Lambda was last deployed at 13:47 +0400 on 2026-09-27, before commit 0904d07 (16:16 +0400) added the tifo_err route. Redeploy with saas/cards/deploy.sh, then check that POST /api/tifo/err returns 204 and that tifo_err JSON lines show up in the elyoxe-cards-api CloudWatch logs.
