lenses.summary: Perf and tech audit of the live tifo.elyoxe.com, done read-only with curl, code, the screenshots and the Lighthouse JSONs already on disk. First load on the home page is about 230KB compressed: HTML 7.4, CSS 17.4, 7 JS files 56, fonts about 126, /v1 about 10, crests about 10. Fonts are more than half of that. Caching of hashed assets is correct (1 year immutable, br). The biggest problems are about freshness, not size. (1) The hourly prerender puts live states into the HTML: at 18:21Z the home hero showed a finished match as «مباشر الحين 86'» while Bahrain–UAE was live. (2) During live matches the page polls too often, redraws everything even when nothing changed, and a goal can reach the screen about 60s late. (3) Every deploy wipes the service-worker cache: 23 app.js versions went up today. Lighthouse runs on this phone (relative numbers only, since they used a python http.server with no compression): the v3 competition page dropped from perf 85 to 67 (FCP +1.5s, Style & Layout about 2s). The live match page has CLS 0.125 (the v3 worktree run shows 0). redesign/fcp.cjs has no recorded result, and it blocks fonts and /v1 while measuring only FCP, so it cannot catch these problems. Evidence from the Lighthouse runs is copied to /tmp/perfaudit_lh_old_match.json and /tmp/perfaudit_lh_new_match.json.

findings.title: Hourly prerender shows stale live score/match on first paint
findings.evidence: At 18:21Z the live / (Last-Modified 17:52:59Z; cron runs at :25 hourly) hero #standcap showed «مباشر الحين · اليمن 0-1 قطر 86'». /v1/live.json at the same moment: 6052084 finished, Bahrain–UAE 21' live. JS then swaps the whole hero (crests, colours, canvas). sw.js serves cached HTML after 4s on a weak signal, which makes it even older.
findings.proposal: build.cjs: stamp <html data-built>. Add an inline head script that sets .stale when the page is more than 3 minutes old. CSS for .stale: visibility:hidden on .st.live, .hsc .dg and #standkick (space stays reserved). Remove .stale after app.js gets its first live.json. Start the fetch in <head> (window.__lv=fetch('/v1/live.json')) and have get() reuse it.
findings.verified: At 18:39Z I curled https://tifo.elyoxe.com/. The response had Last-Modified 18:33:18Z, cache-control max-age=60 and came from the CloudFront cache. The prerendered hero #stand/#standcap read «مباشر الحين · البحرين 0 - 0 الإمارات 29'». /v1/live.json, generated at 18:38:50Z, had 6052085 live at 38' with a score of 0-1. So the first paint showed a wrong score and a wrong minute on the owner's key match, on a page that was only 5 minutes old. The crontab line for the hourly job is `25 * * * * ... run-job.sh tifo`. The live sw.js serves pages network-first with a 4 s budget and then falls back to the last cached copy (setTimeout 4000 → c.match). live.json itself is network-only, so it is never served stale on a timeout. In src/app.js:61 the home hero is repainted only after Promise.all([index(), day/…json, live.json]) resolves (line 79 sets #standcap and #standkick). The stale markup therefore stays up until the slowest of the three fetches returns.
findings.corrected: The claim holds, with more precision needed. Pages are not rebuilt only hourly: the live page was rebuilt at 18:33Z, outside the :25 cron. Even so, a page a few minutes old already shows a wrong live score and minute on first paint (0-0 29' shown, 0-1 38' real). The stale window is set by build age plus the slowest of three fetches on home, because app.js:61 waits on Promise.all(index, day, live) before swapping the hero. On a weak signal, sw.js adds more age by serving the cached HTML after 4 s. The proposal still fits: stamp data-built and hide the live score, minute and kicker when the page is more than about 2 minutes old. It should also repaint the hero from live.json alone as soon as that fetch returns, without waiting for index/day, and start that fetch early from the head.

findings.title: Every deploy wipes the SW cache; the cache has no cap and no navigation preload
findings.evidence: The cache name is tifo-2-<ASSET_V> (build.cjs:691). activate deletes all other tifo-* caches. S3 has 23 app.*.js versions dated 2026-09-27, so returning visitors lost cached crests and offline pages 23 times today. Pages, every /v1 response and /og/ images are cached with no limit (sw.js:13-21). No navigationPreload, so SW startup delays every navigation on low-end Android.
findings.proposal: Split into tifo-assets-<V> (deleted on version change), tifo-crest-1 (stable name, LRU about 300), tifo-pages (LRU about 60) and tifo-data (LRU about 40). Stop caching /og/. In activate, call registration.navigationPreload.enable(); in the page branch, use e.preloadResponse.
findings.verified: Live https://tifo.elyoxe.com/sw.js (V="tifo-2-235c403a26"), the source ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/sw.js and build.cjs:718, where __V__ is replaced with ASSET_V (the claim cited build.cjs:691, which is wrong). activate deletes every cache that starts with "tifo-" and is not V. /assets/, /logo/ (crests) and /og/ are all cache-first in the same cache V. Pages and non-live /v1 are network-first and use c.put with no eviction. LIVE /v1 (live.json, match/, day/) also uses c.put on every OK response with no cap. There is no navigationPreload or preloadResponse anywhere in src/. On S3 (stack elyoxe-tifo-site, ap-south-1), 24 files named assets/app.<hash>.js carry the date 2026-09-27. ASSET_V is a hash of the asset code, so the hourly data-only deploys do not change it. Only code or CSS changes wipe the cache, and that happened about 23 times today.
findings.corrected: The claim is essentially true. Corrections: (1) The cache version comes from build.cjs:718 and src/sw.js:6, not build.cjs:691. (2) A wipe happens when the asset hash changes (a code or CSS change), not on every deploy. The hourly data deploys keep the cache. Today that was still about 23 wipes, and each wipe also drops the /logo/ crests, which have stable URLs, and the offline pages. (3) The unbounded growth also includes the LIVE branch: every /v1/match/* and /v1/day/* response is put into the cache, not only pages, /og/ and other /v1 files. The real risk is quota pressure on phones, where the browser can evict the whole origin's storage. (4) "broken" overstates it. Nothing fails, but the offline and slow-signal promise, and the crest reuse, break down on every code deploy. It fits better as perf/high. The proposal is sound: stable crest and page caches with LRU caps, stop caching /og/, and navigationPreload.enable() with e.preloadResponse in the page branch.

findings.title: coaches.json has no hash but is cached immutable for a year
findings.evidence: curl /assets/coaches.json returns cache-control public,max-age=31536000,immutable, last-modified today. It is written each build as assets/coaches.json (build.cjs:590), and the SW serves /assets/ cache-first. Anyone who opened coach-compare once sees frozen data.
findings.proposal: Content-hash it like bc.<hash>.json and search.<hash>.json (pass the version in a data- attribute) and fetch it by that name in app.js:269.
findings.verified:
I checked the live headers, the build, deploy.sh and sw.js, and the claim holds.
1) Live headers: `curl -I /assets/coaches.json` returns `cache-control: public,max-age=31536000,immutable` and `last-modified: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 18:32:17 GMT`.
2) Build: build.cjs:617 writes the unhashed file `assets/coaches.json` on every build. By contrast, bc.${BC_V}.json (line 193), cc.${CC_V}.json (line 353) and search.${SEARCH_V}.json (line 699) are content-hashed.
3) Deploy: deploy.sh:23 syncs all of out/assets with `public,max-age=31536000,immutable`, on the assumption that "assets are content-hashed". The /* invalidation only clears the CloudFront edge, not browsers.
4) Page: src/app.js:269 fetches the fixed URL `/assets/coaches.json`.
5) Service worker: src/sw.js:12-13 serves /assets/ cache-first. Its cache name `tifo-2-${ASSET_V}` changes only when code changes. ASSET_V (build.cjs:169) hashes css and js only, not data, and is live as tifo-2-235c403a26. So on a data-only rebuild the SW keeps serving the old coaches.json, and the browser HTTP cache would keep it for a year anyway.
findings.corrected: Confirmed, with one nuance. Returning visitors do get fresh data after a deploy that changes code: the SW cache name changes and old caches are deleted. Even then, the browser HTTP cache (immutable, 1 year) can still hand back the stale copy. In between code changes, data-only builds never reach visitors who already opened coach-compare. Fix as proposed: build.cjs:617 should write coaches.${hash}.json, pass the version to the page (for example a data- attribute on #ca), and app.js:269 should fetch that name.

findings.title: Live polling redraws everything every 20s and goals arrive up to ~60s late
findings.evidence: app.js:142-151: match() refetches match/{id}.json every 20s and rewrites 7 panes with innerHTML. set() at app.js:15 never checks for changes. comp() (app.js:96-103) refetches fixtures.json (231KB raw) + stats (55KB) + standings every 20s and rebuilds the rounds UI. More live.json pollers: fav toast every 30s on every page, all day (app.js:285-287), watch box every 20s (app.js:302), home every 20s. match file is 'hot' = max-age 20 + SWR 20 (store.py:26).
findings.proposal: Use one shared live.json poller every 10s, and only while a relevant match is live. Fetch match/{id}.json only when that id's score, minute or status changes in live.json. Return early if md.generated has not changed. Keep a per-selector HTML cache in set(). comp: poll only live.json + standings; fetch fixtures and stats once.

findings.title: Fonts are about 126KB from 2 third-party origins, with no preload and no fallback metrics
findings.evidence: 5 woff2 files (LH network list): Kufi ar 46KB + latin 10.6KB, Readex latin 31.4KB + ar 22.8KB, Barlow 14.9KB. The Latin files load only because of spaces and digits. They go through a chained googleapis CSS request. tifo.css:8 has no size-adjust fallback, so Kufi and Barlow swap in with a reflow.
findings.proposal: Self-host subsets built from site/fonts/*.ttf (sizes measured here): Kufi 800 Arabic+ASCII 41KB, Readex 400-600 29KB, Barlow digits 5KB, so 75KB same-origin under /assets. Preload Kufi and Readex. Add fallback @font-face rules with size-adjust/ascent-override against Noto Sans Arabic.

findings.title: Crests are 192px PNGs in 24-34px slots, and hero crests are lazy-loaded
findings.evidence: 697 PNGs at 192x192 (median 9.7KB). Unique crests: home 47, comp 21, transfers 201. Resized from 120 of them: 96px quantized PNG median 3.3KB (-69%), 72px WebP 2.9KB. R.logo (render.js:15) always sets loading=lazy, including the above-the-fold hero .xl/.lg crests on home and match. The .xl crest can be up to 120px wide (v3.css:57), so 192px is soft at DPR 3.
findings.proposal: Build /logo/96/<id>.webp for rows and /logo/256/<id>.webp for heroes (srcset). R.logo: add an eager + fetchpriority=high option for hero crests. Update the regex in shell.js:128 and the SW prefix to match.

findings.title: Competition and transfers pages ship huge DOMs
findings.evidence: /c/uae-pro-league/: 296KB raw HTML, 2,744 live nodes plus 5,073 inside 45
findings.proposal: Prerender only the visible tab. Build tv/form/pred/hist/leaders from the JSON already fetched when the tab opens. Add content-visibility:auto; contain-intrinsic-size:auto 600px on below-fold .rail, .blk and .comp-block. Set table-layout:fixed on standings. Transfers: show the first 40, then «المزيد».

findings.title: Add speculation-rules prefetch so taps feel instant
findings.evidence: There are no prefetch, prerender or speculationrules hints anywhere (grep in build.cjs and src). Pages are 2.3–9.5KB br static HTML, and @view-transition{navigation:auto} is already on (v3.css:433).
findings.proposal: In the layout <head>: <script type=speculationrules>{"prefetch":[{"where":{"and":[{"href_matches":"/*"},{"not":{"href_matches":"/api/*"}}]},"eagerness":"moderate"}]}</script>. On Chrome Android the HTML then starts loading on touch, and the crest morph plays with no wait.

findings.title: backdrop-filter on the 3 fixed bars costs GPU work but is invisible
findings.evidence: blur(10px) on .top.solid (bg #0A2620eb = 92% opaque, v3.css:23), .tabbar (#061B16f2 = 95%, v3.css:39) and .mini (95%, v3.css:98). At that opacity you can't see the blur, but the backdrop over the canvas and content is re-blurred on every scroll frame.
findings.proposal: Remove backdrop-filter from all three and make the backgrounds fully opaque or 96%. Scrolling on mid-range Android gets smoother, with no visible change.

findings.title: The same 80KB CSS and 7 JS files block every page
findings.evidence: tifo.css+v3.css are concatenated with no minification (build.cjs:147): 80KB raw / 17.4KB br, render-blocking, 85% unused on comp (LH unused-css 66KiB). v3 overrides tifo rules instead of replacing them. JS: 7 sync files, 56KB br / 177KB raw, comments included, 74-80% unused on comp (LH).
findings.proposal: Inline about 8-10KB of critical CSS (top bar, hero, tabbar, rail card) and load the rest non-blocking. Delete tifo.css rules that v3 overrides. Minify with esbuild. Load share.js on the first share tap, and colors.js only on pages with key art.

findings.title: Key-art canvas is the biggest main-thread cost on the match page
findings.evidence: LH today on /m/1000020522/: keyart.js is the top item, 2,758ms (live) / 5,775ms (v3 worktree), mostly rendering rather than script. Headless has no GPU, so this is overstated. TBT 3.4s / 4.6s. The canvas runs at DPR 2 over the full hero (keyart.js:27), and the 1.1s intro redraws the full canvas every frame. The live build also has CLS 0.125 on .hero-in; the worktree shows 0.
findings.proposal: Draw at DPR 1 with CSS image-rendering:pixelated (flat squares look the same, 4x fewer pixels). Skip the intro when navigator.deviceMemory<=4 or saveData, and start it after load. Ship the worktree's CLS fix.

findings.title: First search tap downloads the full ~100KB index
findings.evidence: search.b7cd0e7729.json is 296KB raw / 100KB br. It is fetched, parsed and normalised entry by entry (app.js:37) before the first result can show, which is about 1s+ on 4G.
findings.proposal: Load a small top index on search open (Arab clubs, comps, national teams, top players; about 15KB). Fetch the full index on idle after the first page view, unless saveData is on. Precompute the normalised fields at build.

findings.title: The perf gate can't see the regressions
findings.evidence: It has no recorded result: it only prints to stdout, and gate.json is the page inventory, not performance. It aborts Google Fonts and /v1 and checks only FCP<1000ms on 4 pages, so it misses font-swap CLS, LCP and TBT, which is exactly where v3 regressed (comp 85 to 67, match CLS 0.125). The /tmp/lh_*.json files get overwritten by other runs.
findings.proposal: Record LCP, CLS and the long-task total through PerformanceObserver, with fonts allowed (local copies) and a /v1 fixture. Write redesign/perf.json on every deploy. Fail the deploy above LCP 2.5s, CLS 0.05 or TBT 300ms at 4x CPU.

findings.title: Each hourly deploy re-uploads ~39MB and purges the whole CDN
findings.evidence: build.cjs:236,251 copyFileSync every crest and league logo, and og images are rewritten too, so all files get fresh mtimes (697 logos at 21:44, 445 og at 21:51) and s3 sync re-uploads 8MB + 31MB from the phone. The deploy also runs invalidation /*, which clears immutable /assets, logos and /v1 at every edge.
findings.proposal: Copy only when a file is missing or changed, or use --size-only for logo/lg/og. Invalidate only /sw.js and / (pages are max-age 60 anyway). With faster deploys, the home can be rebuilt every few minutes.

findings.title: Home countdown fetches the UAE team file and rewrites innerHTML every second
findings.evidence: app.js:176-182: every visitor in every country fetches /v1/team/5789.json (22KB raw / 3.2KB gz) just to get the next UAE match, then rebuilds #uaecd with innerHTML every 1s. /tn/5789.json (3.3KB / 0.5KB) already has next/last.
findings.proposal: Use /tn/<id>.json with the visitor's national team (pan-Arab), not a hard-coded 5789. Build the markup once, then each second update only the .dg text.

lenses.summary:
COMPETITOR TEARDOWN. Checked live: FotMob (home, /match/6052085, /ar), 365Scores /ar, Kooora, Yallakora, beIN AR and Goal AR. SofaScore returned 403, Flashscore timed out, and OneFootball /ar/home redirects to /es/home (it has no Arabic), so those three rest on my own knowledge.

Competitor by competitor:
- **FotMob:** the best mobile match centre. It shows followed teams first, live ratings, momentum and xG. Its pre-match block has form, FIFA rank, venue city, weather, insights and a "Who will win?" vote. Habit loop: push alerts plus the Following tab. It has an Arabic RTL version that already writes «خالد عيسى» and «إبراهيم لطف الله», so Arabic names are parity, not a Tifo win. Weakness for Arab fans: 84 "Odds" strings on the Arabic match page, no dialect, no per-country free channels, no prayer times.
- **SofaScore:** the deepest data (heatmaps, attack momentum, team of the week). Habit loop: gamified votes that rank predictors, plus pushes. Weakness: dense, odds, Latin-first names.
- **365Scores AR:** the biggest Arab reach, with a «نتائجي» favourites tab, polls and news. Weakness: its game cards carry an odds grid (CSS game-card_textual_odds_container), heavy ads, machine-translated names.
- **OneFootball:** a polished news and video feed built around the teams you follow. No Arabic at all.
- **Kooora (now on the Footballco/fco platform):** trust since 2002 and every Arab league. Each match row has a «شاهد» button with provider logos, there is an «اختر الفائز» vote, and it publishes a daily SEO article «جدول مباريات اليوم.. القنوات الناقلة والمعلقين». Weakness: 1.16MB of HTML, 14 «إعلان» ad slots, an «احتمالات» odds button, and a sponsored almanasa.iq link.
- **Yallakora:** channel on every match row, polls, a predictions contest, reels and push. Egypt-centric, with a dated look.
- **beIN AR:** owns the video and the rights, but only its own channels. Scores are secondary and much is paywalled.
- **Goal AR:** transfers and rumours. 873KB of HTML with 72 odds/betting strings.
- **Flashscore:** fastest and densest, with starred "My games". Odds, and weak Arabic.

Compressed page weight: Tifo home 7.4KB, FotMob 55KB, Kooora 150KB, Goal AR 142KB. Response times are not a fair comparison because every site took about 5 s through this phone.

WHAT TIFO LACKS:
- a personal tab
- push alerts
- a one-tap who-will-win vote
- a channel on every match row
- commentators
- match-page form, FIFA rank and venue city
- weather and prayer times outside the UAE
- a live score in the browser tab title
- news. Deliberate, so I do not propose it.

WHERE TIFO CAN WIN:
- channels per country with a free-to-air filter, once fixed
- prayer times at the viewer's own location, and a Ramadan mode
- the Arabs-abroad hub (none of these competitors has one)
- dialect copy
- no betting anywhere
- lightness and speed
- the majlis, car and second-screen modes
- WhatsApp story images

TWO THINGS BROKEN TONIGHT:
- The Gulf Cup has no channel data for any of the 22 countries.
- The generated preview says Bahrain is playing at home, but the match is in Jeddah.

The Latin player names on /m/6052085/ are already Arabic after the 22:13 dictionary rebuild, so I dropped that finding. Any new UI must keep the identity rules: no green or red outside live and cards, and dune only for "my team".

findings.title: Tonight's Gulf Cup shows UAE channels to Bahrainis and every other Arab country
findings.evidence: /m/6052085/ has data-comp="329". /assets/bc.583b2da6af.json covers 22 countries and has no key "329". So app.js (the 204/205 block) prints «ما لقينا معلومة مؤكدة لـ<بلدك>، وهذي القنوات في الإمارات» and lists AD Sports and Sharjah Sports. /guide/ lists no Gulf Cup match at all: «كأس الخليج» appears only in the More-sheet shortcut. Kooora puts «شاهد» with provider logos on every match row.
findings.proposal: Tonight, add comp 329 to research/broadcast_by_country.json for at least the 8 participating countries plus beIN MENA. Every entry needs a source URL, following the ROADMAP rule of no memory. Then rebuild bc.json. Add a build check: every competition with a match in the next 72 h must have an entry for each country, or the build logs a missing-coverage list.
findings.verified: I checked the live page, the channel data file and the code, and the claim holds. 1) curl /m/6052085/ shows #wwbox data-comp="329" and data-bc="583b2da6af". The server-rendered box reads «وين تنقل في الإمارات» and lists أبوظبي الرياضية and الشارقة الرياضية, both marked مجاني. 2) /assets/bc.583b2da6af.json has 22 countries (AE, BH, DJ, DZ, EG, IQ, JO, KM, KW, LB, LY, MA, MR, OM, PS, QA, SA, SD, SO, SY, TN, YE). No country has key "329". 3) site/src/app.js:253-255 (the 204/205 block) returns early for AE and "xx". For any other country with no entry, it keeps the UAE list and adds «ما لقينا معلومة مؤكدة لـ<بلدك>، وهذي القنوات في الإمارات.» So Bahraini, Saudi, Qatari and every other Arab visitor sees only UAE channels. 4) /guide/ has no 6052085 link. «البحرين» appears there only in the country dropdown, and «كأس الخليج» only as the /c/gulf-cup/ shortcut. Note: research/broadcast_by_country.json is not at ~/workspace/saas/football/research. The copy I found is ../build/lambda/broadcast_by_country.json, so the fix needs the real source path. I did not check the Kooora comparison.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed with one detail to add. The page does not hide the problem: the note saying there is no confirmed information for the visitor's country is shown. Visitors whose country is unknown ("xx") get the UAE list with no note. The proposal holds. Add comp 329 for the 8 Gulf Cup countries (at least), each with a source URL, and add a build check that lists missing coverage. Edit the source file that feeds bc.json. The copy I found is at football/build/lambda/broadcast_by_country.json, not football/research/.

findings.title: Preview text says Bahrain plays at home at a neutral venue in Jeddah
findings.evidence: /m/6052085/ «قوة الأول: منتخب البحرين يبا يستغل أرضه». FotMob places the match in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The same card says «أكثر وقت يسجل فيه: الدقايق 1-15 (0 أهداف)» and «من أرقام الفريقين هالموسم في الدوري» for national teams, and «أول مشاركة لـ Mahdi Abduljabbar Hasan» is still in Latin. gen.py:240 passes only venue name_ar, and checks.py has no venue rule.
findings.proposal: Pass neutral=true into the facts when the venue country differs from the home team's country, or the competition is a tournament. In checks.py, reject «أرضه/جمهوره/ملعبه» when neutral. Drop the «أكثر وقت يسجل/يستقبل» lines when their count is 0. For national teams, write «في آخر مبارياته» instead of «في الدوري». Run the «أوائل» names through players_ar.json.
findings.verified: Cache file ~/workspace/saas/football/site/cache/ai/preview/6052085.json, line 1: «منتخب البحرين يبا يستغل أرضه…». The live /m/6052085/ JSON-LD and venue give Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Stadium in Jeddah, in_uae:false. build.cjs:494 shows the preview only while status is "scheduled", and it was approved (ai/approved.json preview:true), so the text was public before kickoff. It is not on the page now: curl shows status "live", minute 26, and no «تحليل ما قبل» section. The next Gulf Cup match /m/6052086/ (UAE v Qatar, scheduled, Jeddah) has the same fault now: «منتخب قطر يبا يراوي الجميع قوته برا أرضه». Its line 5 also says «نسب توقعات تيفو مب متوفرة الحين», which the PRE_SYS prompt at gen.py:282 forbids. /m/6052086/ «تقرير الفريقين» shows «أكثر وقت يستقبل فيه: الدقايق 1-15 (0 أهداف)» for both teams and ends with «من أرقام الفريقين هالموسم في الدوري» (stats.js:365-371, rendered from build.cjs:497 when scheduled). /m/6052085/ shows «أول مشاركة لـ Mahdi Abduljabbar Hasan هالموسم» in Latin (stats.js:551). gen.py:240 is in match_facts(), which feeds the post-match summary, not the preview. The preview ctx at gen.py:681-684 carries no venue at all, so the model is left to assume that "home" means home ground. checks.py has no venue rule.
findings.corrected: Mostly true, but some details need fixing. (1) The 6052085 preview said «يستغل أرضه» for Bahrain in Jeddah and was public before kickoff. It is not showing now because the match is live. The same fault is live now on /m/6052086/: «قطر… قوته برا أرضه» for a neutral match in Jeddah, and line 5 there leaks «مب متوفرة», which the prompt forbids. (2) The root cause is not gen.py:240, which is match_facts() for summaries. The preview ctx built at gen.py:681-684 has no venue or neutral flag at all. Fix: add "venue_city" and "neutral": venue.in_uae/country != the home team's country (or the competition is a tournament such as كأس الخليج) to that ctx. Tell PRE_SYS that when neutral, neither team is at home. Add a keep_lines/checks.py reject for أرضه/جمهوره/ملعبه/برا أرضه when neutral. Also reject «مب متوفرة/غير متوفرة». (3) The team report (stats.js:365-371) is confirmed on /m/6052086/: drop the «يستقبل/يسجل» line when the count is 0, and replace «في الدوري» with «في هالبطولة» when md.home/away is a national team. (4) The Latin «أوائل» name (stats.js:551) is confirmed on /m/6052085/: map `who` through players_ar.json.

findings.title: /watch/ shows English research notes, covers the UAE only, and duplicates /guide/
findings.evidence: curl /watch/ shows «beIN subscription (tier carrying AFC not stated)», «Shahid VIP | Sports (tier carrying Bundesliga not stated by Shahid; inferred)», «ULTIMATE (beIN MAX football channels)» and «Registration + activation». The title is «وين تنقل المباريات في الإمارات». /watch/sa/ returns 404, while /guide/ already has a 22-country picker. next_watch_390_full_s36.png is 4,606px long on a phone.
findings.proposal: Merge /watch/ into /guide/ with a 301 redirect, so there is one country-aware page. Replace the tier notes with an Arabic word («اشتراك» or «مجاني») plus the price, and keep «المصدر» as the only extra link. Fold each competition to one line, with the details on tap.
findings.verified: I fetched https://tifo.elyoxe.com/watch/ with curl. It returns 200, and its title is «وين تنقل المباريات في الإمارات: القنوات والباقات والأسعار». The body contains every English string the claim quotes: «beIN subscription (tier carrying AFC not stated)» appears 5 times and «(package not specified for AFC)» once. The body also has «ULTIMATE (beIN MAX football channels) 202 درهم», «Shahid VIP | Sports (tier carrying Bundesliga not stated by Shahid; inferred)», «Registration + activation» (شووف), «Free-to-air», «Free (720p) / Basic / Premium», «TOD 4K/HDR | TOD HD | TOD Mobile», «STARZPLAY MAX (Entertainment + Sports)» and «ULTIMATE / PREMIUM (tier not specified)». Every price is in dirhams, so the page covers the UAE only. /watch/sa/ returns 404. /guide/ returns 200 and has a 22-country picker (الإمارات to جزر القمر) plus «المجاني بس». next_watch_390_full_s36.png is 390x4606. Two parts of the claim do not hold. First, /guide/ is a fixture list: it shows the next 3 days of matches, each with its channel name and «مجاني» or nothing. It has no packages, no prices and no «المصدر» links. /watch/ is a reference by competition, with packages, AED prices, a source for each fact, and «تحققنا منها في 27 سبتمبر». The two pages overlap on channel names only. Second, the two pages already link to each other: /guide/ links to /watch/ as «وين تنقل».
findings.corrected: The claim is mostly true, but its "duplicates /guide/" part and its proposal are wrong. /watch/ does show raw English research notes, covers the UAE only (AED prices; /watch/sa/ is 404), and runs 4,606px on a phone. But it does not duplicate /guide/. /guide/ lists the next 3 days' matches with a channel and a free flag for each. /watch/ is the only page that has packages, prices and sources for each competition. A plain 301 from /watch/ to /guide/ would throw away the price and package data and the «المصدر» links. Corrected proposal, in three parts. (1) Keep the content and have /guide/ absorb it: under each competition or fixture, add one line that opens on tap, e.g. «بي إن سبورتس · اشتراك · 202 درهم · المصدر». Then 301 /watch/ to /guide/ only once that is done. Alternatively, keep /watch/ as the price reference but make it follow the /guide/ country choice. (2) Replace every English tier note in the watch data with «مجاني» or «اشتراك» plus the price. Drop the unknown-tier notes, and change «Registration + activation» to «تسجيل مجاني». (3) Fold each competition to one line on phones. Severity is high for the English text, which is a visible bug and quick to fix. It is medium, not remove, for the merge.

findings.title: Foreign venues get an emirate distance dropdown and an English stadium name
findings.evidence: next_live_390_full_feat.png, for a match in Jeddah, shows «المسافة من دبي 1687 كم، حوالي 1125 دقيقة سواقة» with a dropdown of the 8 emirates, and «Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Sports City Stadium» with no city or country. FotMob shows the stadium as Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, 27,000, with 32°C.
findings.proposal: Show the distance only when the venue is in the UAE and the visitor is in the UAE. For every venue, show «الملعب · المدينة، الدولة» in Arabic. Get weather from Open-Meteo for any venue with coordinates, since FotMob's infoBox already provides them.
findings.verified: I checked the screenshot, the live page and the code, and the claim holds. In next_live_390_full_feat.png, the match details for Bahrain v UAE in Jeddah show the stadium as «Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Sports City Stadium» in English, with no city or country. Under «المسافة من» there is a dropdown set to دبي, showing «1687 كم» and «حوالي 1125 دقيقة سواقة». The live page https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/6052085/ (fetched with curl) serves the same English name and a data-km object for all 8 emirates (dubai 1686.9). In the code, site/src/render.js:228 prints name_ar, falling back to name_en, with no city or country. site/src/render.js:229 adds the emirate dropdown whenever venue.distance_km exists, and nothing checks whether the venue is in the UAE. compute/venues.py:60 distances() works out a straight-line distance to every emirate for any stadium that has lat/lon, and poller.py:206 attaches it to every match. site/src/app.js:222 then turns the km into driving minutes at 90 km/h, which gives 1125 min for Jeddah, even though it is a straight line and a sea route to Saudi Arabia. I did not check the weather suggestion or FotMob's infoBox coordinates or capacity.
findings.corrected: Confirmed as stated. The fix: in compute/venues.py distances(), return None unless the stadium is in the UAE (check its country, or a UAE bounding box). Also guard site/src/render.js:229 on that country check. For foreign venues, change render.js:228 to show «الملعب · المدينة، الدولة» with an Arabic name. Weather from Open-Meteo is a nice extra, and its data was not checked.

findings.title: /today/ promises «القنوات الناقلة» but no row shows a channel
findings.evidence: The /today/ <title> is «مباريات اليوم…: المواعيد والقنوات الناقلة», but the HTML contains 0 channel strings: grep for الرياضية, مجاني, بي إن and SNRT all return 0. next_today_390_full_s36.png shows team, time and a single «وين تنقل كل بطولة» button at the bottom. Kooora and Yallakora show the channel on every row, and Kooora's daily headline adds «والمعلقين».
findings.proposal: Under each row's time, add a small chalk text chip with the first channel for the visitor's country from bc.json, plus the existing «مجاني» tag (not green). Use it in /today/, list:day and the home rails. Keep «المجاني في بلدك» as the filter. The prerender shows the UAE value and the client swaps it for the visitor's country.

findings.title: On a phone, the first screen shows one match and no list
findings.evidence: v3.css sets .hhero{min-block-size:clamp(30rem,86svh,46rem)}. next_home_390_feat.png shows only Yemen–Qatar. In next_home_390_full_feat.png «كل المباريات» starts at about y=1670 of 3437, and in _after at about y=2030 of 4202, roughly 2.4 screens down. In _after, Bahrain–UAE appears in the hero, again in rail:live right below, and a third time in the list. FotMob, 365 and Flashscore show 8–10 rows on the first screen, with followed teams first.
findings.proposal: On screens under 880px, set .hhero to clamp(22rem,52svh,28rem) so rail:live is visible without scrolling. Exclude the hero match from rail:live. When favourites exist, list:day puts followed teams' matches in a «فرقك» group at the top. This works with 388, which is already in progress.

findings.title: No «فريقي» tab: every competitor puts following in the nav
findings.evidence: DESIGN-v3.md:47 fixes the nav as اليوم · البطولات · المنتخبات · الأسبوع · المزيد. Favourites (app.js tifo.favs, pick 179) and since-last-visit (pick 292) exist, but they only appear in home slot 5, below three rails. FotMob has Following, SofaScore Favourites and 365Scores «نتائجي», each one tap from anywhere.
findings.proposal: Replace «الأسبوع» with «فريقي» and move الأسبوع into المزيد. /me/ is rendered on the client from favs and shows: the next-match countdown, the last result, the table position, since-last-visit, the followed Arab players playing tonight, and a quick switch between favourites. Empty state: the 403 crest grid. Use dune only for my-team accents.

findings.title: Proposal to un-defer: web push for my team (goal, kickoff, lineups out)
findings.evidence: Push alerts are the main retention loop for FotMob, SofaScore, 365Scores and Flashscore. Yallakora shows «خدمة الإشعارات» on its home page. Tifo only has in-page toasts (293), which reach nobody once the tab is closed. Tifo is already an installable PWA (353), and Web Push works in Android Chrome and in iOS 16.4+ home-screen apps.
findings.proposal: One-line case for the owner: anonymous push with no accounts. Store only {subscription, team ids} in the Lambda that serves /api/tifo/*. The live poller sends three kinds of alert: kickoff, goal and full time. Off by default, with the prompt shown only after the user taps «هذا فريقي».

findings.title: Proposal to un-defer: one-tap «مين بيفوز؟» with a local correct-pick streak
findings.evidence: FotMob shows "Who will win" on /match/6052085, and Kooora's home page has the «اختر الفائز» fco-who-will-win widget. Yallakora has «استطلاع يلاكورة» and 365 AR has polls; both come from WebFetch only. The Tifo pre-match tab has nothing to tap (/m/6052085/).
findings.proposal: One-line case for the owner: an anonymous 3-way counter per match (one DynamoDB item, no user data). The visitor's own pick and a «توقعت صح 3 على التوالي» streak live only in localStorage. Show crowd % bars in chalk and concrete, not green. The vote closes at kickoff and the result is revealed at full time.

findings.title: Prayer times at the viewer's location, then a Ramadan mode
findings.evidence: poller.py:209-213 computes weather and prayer clashes only when venue.in_uae, and at the venue rather than where the viewer is. stadiums.yaml has 23 venues, all in the UAE. grep for ramadan/رمضان across site/src finds 0 hits. None of the nine competitors shows prayer times.
findings.proposal: Port compute/prayer.py to about 3KB of client JavaScript. For the visitor's country from pick 199, use the capital's coordinates and that country's calculation method (for example Umm al-Qura for KSA). Show one line in the match hero: «العشاء 19:52 · حوالي الدقيقة 20». Before Ramadan (around Feb 2027), add a «بعد الإفطار / بعد التراويح» label to kickoffs using the same code.

findings.title: Leftover UAE-only wording in the title, meta, copy and More sheet
findings.evidence: Home <title>: «نتايج مباريات اليوم مباشر، الدوري الإماراتي والمنتخب». Meta: «…بتوقيت الإمارات: دوري أدنوك، والمنتخب…». The quick text and FAQ on /m/6052085/ hard-code «22:00 بتوقيت الإمارات». The More-sheet shortcuts are «دوري أدنوك · المنتخب · كأس الخليج» (next_home_390_more_final.png). FotMob /ar uses «نتائج كرة القدم المباشرة».
findings.proposal: Title: «تيفو — نتائج مباريات اليوم مباشر والقنوات الناقلة لكل العرب». Use the standard spelling نتائج in the title, H1 and meta, and keep dialect in the body. Generated copy should say «بتوقيت بلدك» and let the client fill in the time. Choose the More-sheet shortcuts by the visitor's country (for KSA: دوري روشن and المنتخب السعودي).

findings.title: Pre-match lacks the form strip and FIFA rank that FotMob shows
findings.evidence: FotMob /match/6052085 shows last-5 form, FIFA rank (#92 Bahrain, #68 UAE), venue, weather, H2H and insights. On Tifo /m/6052085/, grep for «آخر 5» and «فورم» both return 0. The form table exists (236), but not on the match page.
findings.proposal: Under each crest in the pre-match hero, add five square atoms with chalk letters ف/ت/خ (no green or red, per the identity rules), each linking to that match. For national teams, add «فيفا #68» from pick 144's data.

findings.title: Commentator names per match, and a daily «القنوات الناقلة والمعلقين» page
findings.evidence: Kooora's home page runs the daily headline «جدول مباريات اليوم الأحد 27 سبتمبر 2026 .. القنوات الناقلة والمعلقين». Yallakora shows channel details per match. Many Arab fans choose a channel by its commentator, and Tifo has no commentator field.
findings.proposal: Add a commentator field to the sourced broadcast research for the top 10 matches each day, taken from broadcasters' published daily line-ups with a URL and never from memory. Show «بصوت: …» under the channel chip. Retitle /today/ to «مباريات اليوم والقنوات الناقلة والمعلقين».

findings.title: On a phone, /arabs/ (Tifo's unique hub) opens as 16 text links
findings.evidence: next_arabs_390_full_s3c.png shows 16 plain links (نجوم الأسبوع … أرشيف النتايج) before any content. The «نجم الأسبوع» card only appears after them, and «Noureddine Ould Ali» is in Latin. build_arabs.cjs already builds a «العرب الليلة» section. FotMob and SofaScore have no hub like this, and OneFootball has no Arabic.
findings.proposal: Order the page as: a live «العرب الليلة» strip (player, club, minute, goal or assist), then the star card, then 4 icon tiles, then the 16 links folded under «كل الأقسام». Add a «تابع اللاعب» button that adds an Arab player to favs, so he shows in «فريقي» when he plays.

findings.title: Live score in the browser tab title and favicon
findings.evidence: app.js never sets document.title (grep returns 0), and goal toasts (293) show only while the page is open. Tifo is web-first, so a background tab is its version of an app's live notification.
findings.proposal: While a match is live on the page: set document.title to «⚽ 1-0 البحرين × الإمارات 34'» and draw a small pulse-green dot on the favicon canvas. Restore both at full time. Respect no-spoiler mode.

findings.title: Say «بدون مراهنات» out loud: it is a verified differentiator
findings.evidence: Kooora: 14 «إعلان» slots, an «احتمالات» odds button, and a sponsored almanasa.iq link. FotMob /ar match page: 84 "Odds" strings. Goal AR: 72 odds/betting strings in 873KB of HTML. 365 AR: an odds grid on game cards. Tifo: 0 odds and 7 scripts.
findings.proposal: Add one quiet line in the footer, the About page and the PWA install sheet: «تيفو بدون مراهنات». It is permanent under the owner's rule, and it matters to families in the Gulf. Say nothing about ads, to keep future options open.

lenses.summary:
Engagement audit of the live Tifo site (read-only). The biggest problem is that the habit loop is still built for UAE visitors, even though Tifo is now pan-Arab (owner decision, 2026-09-27):
- The visitor's national team is never mapped: `tifo.natids` is read but never written.
- Every visitor gets the UAE countdown, and the UAE gets a fixed bonus in the hero pick.
- /week/, /countdowns/ and /thisday/ cover the UAE only.

The retention tools that need no backend are approved but broken or not shipped:
- **PWA (353):** no manifest or icons (404).
- **Calendar feeds:** the link is webcal://, which Android Chrome can't open. The feed has no reminder, no link back to Tifo, and no per-match «ذكّرني».
- **Shared images:** they go out with no link, and cancelling the share triggers a download.
- **Link previews:** the Yemen–Qatar preview image still said «مباشر» 20+ minutes after the final whistle, and the home page has no preview image.

The "my team" moment keeps losing to other content:
- Any live match outranks the visitor's own match in the hero, even when theirs is 45 minutes away.
- The «فريقك» card jumps to the next fixture the moment the final whistle blows.
- "My players" doesn't exist: favourites only handle clubs.

Other issues:
- The match share sheet has 12 actions.
- The distance widget shows «1125 دقيقة سواقة» from Dubai to Jeddah.

New ideas are kept small and local-only, and are flagged needs_owner:
- A daily card for everyone, not only visitors with favourites.
- «فريقي» in the bottom nav.
- The live score in the tab title.
- A season record («موسمي»).
- Un-defer cases for a solo «توقعك» (local only) and for push.

I deliberately left out daily-visit streaks and any loss-aversion nagging. Items 387–403 are not re-proposed.

Every finding was checked against live curl output, code line numbers and the 390px screenshots.

findings.title: Pan-Arab personalisation is UAE-only in practice
findings.evidence: `app.js:67` reads `tifo.natids`, but nothing writes it (checked src/ and the live HTML). The home countdown is hard-coded to UAE (`app.js:177`, `get("team/5789.json")`) for every visitor. `heroPick` adds +120 only for 5789 (`v3.js:96`). /week/ says «بتوقيت الإمارات: مباريات الإمارات أول» (next_week_390_s36). /countdowns/ lists UAE matches only. The home meta description and the match og:description say «بتوقيت الإمارات». Yet /v1/team/7795.ics (Saudi) and 10255 (Egypt) exist, and /national/sa/ is live.
findings.proposal: The build writes `window.NAT={AE:5789,SA:7795,EG:10255,MA:6262,BH:5901,…}` from `arabs/national` (iso2 → team id). Then `country()` gives the natId, which feeds `heroPick` (swap 5789 for natId), the countdown (`#uaecd` becomes the visitor's national team) and `dayList` natIds. /week/ and /countdowns/ re-sort on the client by country. Meta copy becomes «بتوقيت بلدك». Replace the silent timezone guess with a one-time chip under the hero: «تتابع من الإمارات؟ غيّر».
findings.verified: Code in ~/workspace/saas/football/site and the live bundles (/assets/app|render|v3.235c403a26.js). Confirmed: (1) app.js:67 reads localStorage "tifo.natids" and nothing writes it, in src/, the repo or the live bundles, so the natIds sort in render.js:102 is dead code. (2) The countdown is hard-coded: app.js:175-181 does get("team/5789.json") and has "المنتخب يلعب الحين" / opp by 5789, and it runs on home for every visitor. (3) heroPick at v3.js:100 (and redesign/src/rx.js:95) gives +120 only to 5789, plus +60 to UAE_COMPS, with no country term. The same UAE bias is in render.js:258 and in build.cjs:593 and build.cjs:652. (4) The live home meta description says «بتوقيت الإمارات: دوري أدنوك، والمنتخب…», and /week/ serves «بتوقيت الإمارات: مباريات الإمارات أول». (5) /countdowns/ is almost all UAE (League Cup and ADNOC) with one Egyptian match (الزمالك والأهلي), so "UAE only" is close but not exact. Its meta already says «بتوقيت بلدك». What the claim gets wrong: personalisation is not UAE-only. app.js:17 country() reads "tifo.country" or guesses from the browser time zone against the 22-country R.COUNTRIES (render.js:94). applyCountry() sets R.TZ, so times show in the visitor's zone, and the header #ctry picker lets the visitor change it. render.js:102 dayList puts the visitor's own league first through compCountry/KEYC (saudi-→SA, egyptian-→EG, botola→MA …). So a Saudi or Egyptian visitor already gets local time and their league first in the home day list.
findings.corrected: [major, not critical] Pan-Arab personalisation stops halfway. Country detection already works: country() in app.js:17 uses the header picker or the browser time zone, sets the local time zone and sorts the visitor's domestic league first in the day list (render.js:102). But everything about the national team is hard-coded to the UAE. The natIds path is dead because nothing writes tifo.natids (app.js:67). The home countdown always shows team 5789 (app.js:177). heroPick favours only 5789 and UAE competitions (v3.js:100 and rx.js:95). /week/ and the home meta description say «بتوقيت الإمارات… الإمارات أول». /countdowns/ is almost all UAE. Fix: in the build, emit window.NAT (iso2→national team id) from the arabs/national data, and replace the tifo.natids read with [NAT[country()]]. Pass natId into heroPick in place of the literal 5789, and point #uaecd at team/NAT[country()].json (keep 5789 when the country is AE or xx). Re-sort /week/ and /countdowns/ on the client by country(). Change the home meta to «بتوقيت بلدك». The country chip already exists in the header (#ctry), so a new hero chip is optional, not required.

findings.title: Calendar feed (the no-backend alert) is broken on Android and buried
findings.evidence: `app.js:172` rewrites the link to webcal://, which Android Chrome has no handler for, so the tap does nothing on most Arab phones. The link is hidden in the «شارك وأدوات» sheet (`build.cjs:421`). /v1/team/5789.ics has 0 VALARM, no URL and no link back to Tifo. Match pages have no «أضف للتقويم», although feature 2 was approved in phase 1 (none in /m/6052085/ buttons). /v1/comp/538.ics returns 404.
findings.proposal:
On Android, link to `https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r?cid=`+encodeURIComponent(feed); keep webcal on iOS. Show «مبارياته في تقويمك» as a text link on the team hero, and offer it right after «هذا فريقي» is tapped. In each event:
- URL:https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/{id}/
- DESCRIPTION with the channel and the link.
- VALARM -PT30M (honoured on imported events; subscribed feeds may drop it).

Before kickoff, the match page gets «ذكّرني»: a one-event .ics blob with the alarm.
findings.verified: Code: src/app.js:172 does rewrite #ics to "webcal://"+host+"/v1/team/"+ID+".ics". Android Chrome has no default webcal handler, so on most Android phones the tap does nothing or shows an error. The link, «مبارياته في تقويم جوالك», is built at build.cjs:445 (the claim says :421). It is passed as o.tools and rendered only inside the «شارك وأدوات» sheet (build.cjs:63), not on the team hero. The live /t/5789/ page shows the link only inside that sheet. Live feed: /v1/team/5789.ics returns 200 text/calendar. It has 0 VALARM, 0 URL lines and no mention of tifo; DESCRIPTION holds only the competition name, and there is no channel or link. /v1/comp/538.ics returns 404. /m/6052085/ has no .ics, «تقويم» or «ذكّرني» anywhere in its HTML. Its hero buttons are «شارك وأدوات» plus «وين تنقل»/«التشكيلة» (build.cjs:521).
findings.corrected: The claim holds. The only correction is the line number: the link is built at build.cjs:445 (not :421) and shown in the share sheet through build.cjs:63. Everything else was checked and is accurate: webcal-only href (app.js:172), no VALARM/URL/Tifo link in /v1/team/5789.ics, 404 on /v1/comp/538.ics, and no add-to-calendar button on match pages. One caveat on the proposal: the Google Calendar cid= link needs the https (or webcal) feed URL, and Google refreshes subscribed feeds slowly (every 12-24h), so a one-event .ics download is still needed for «ذكّرني» on the match page.

findings.title: Shared images reach WhatsApp with no link; cancel downloads
findings.evidence: `share.js:29` calls `navigator.share({files:[f]})` with no text or url. The printed «tifo.elyoxe.com» on the image can't be tapped, so friends can't land on the match. If the user cancels (AbortError), it falls through to `dl()` and forces an unwanted download. The page share in `shell.js:56` sends title and url, but no score line.
findings.proposal: Use `share({files:[f], text:"البحرين 0-1 الإمارات · 67'\nhttps://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/ID/?s=wa"})` and download only when `canShare` is false, never on AbortError. The page share (`#nshare`) also sends the live score line as `text`. A landing with `?s=wa` shows the two crests of that match as a one-tap «تشجع منو؟», reusing 403's picker.
findings.verified: Source: ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/share.js:29 has `if (navigator.canShare && navigator.canShare({ files:[f] })) navigator.share({ files:[f] }).then(ok, function(){ dl(); ok(); }); else { dl(); ok(); }`. The call passes no text or url. Any rejection, including AbortError when the user dismisses the sheet, calls dl(), which forces a PNG download. On the image, footer() at share.js:25 only paints «tifo.elyoxe.com» as canvas text, so it can't be tapped. src/shell.js:58 (the auditor said :56) has `#nshare` calling `navigator.share({ title:document.title, url:u })`, with no score line. Live site: I curled https://tifo.elyoxe.com/assets/share.235c403a26.js and shell.235c403a26.js. They are unminified and contain the same code, so this is what is deployed. share.js is the only place that shares files.
findings.corrected: The claim is confirmed, with two small corrections. 1) The shell.js line is 58, not 56. 2) "Broken/high" overstates it. The image still gets shared; what's missing is the link, and the unwanted download only happens on cancel or error. Medium-high is fairer. Fix in share.js:29: pass `text` with the score line and the URL on one string, e.g. `"البحرين 0-1 الإمارات · 67'\nhttps://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/ID/?s=wa"`. Put the URL inside `text` and don't rely on a separate `url` field, because Android WhatsApp keeps only the caption text when files are attached. In the rejection handler, fall back to dl() only when `e.name !== "AbortError"`. The `?s=wa` landing with a «تشجع منو؟» picker is a new feature, not part of this bug.

findings.title: Link previews stale after the final whistle; none on home
findings.evidence: /og/m-6052084.png still showed «مباشر 0-1» at 18:16Z. The final whistle was at 17:53:39Z, the image's last-modified is 17:55:47, and the page was last modified at 17:55:06: no rebuild since. / and /national/sa/ have no og:image. The og image for 6052085 prints «بتوقيت الإمارات».
findings.proposal: The poller triggers a rebuild of the match page and its OG image when the status flips to finished, instead of waiting for the cycle (ties to 344). The image label becomes «انتهت». Add og:image to home (today's hero card) and to /national/xx/. On the OG image, print Mecca time next to UAE time.
findings.verified:
At 18:37Z I curled the live pages and OG images and read build.cjs.
(1) /og/m-6052084.png now has last-modified 18:35:28 and shows «انتهت 0-1» (I downloaded it and looked). The rebuild did land, but about 42 minutes after the 17:53 whistle. The page's own last-modified moved from 17:55 to 18:34:53. The 18:16 stale state could not be re-observed, but it fits a slow rebuild cycle.
(2) The «انتهت» label already exists. build.cjs:542 sets sub to «انتهت» when status is finished, and to «مباشر» when there is a score and it is not finished. Proposing it as new work is redundant.
(3) Confirmed: / and /national/sa/ emit no og:image. Only og:title appears. The home page() call at build.cjs:374 passes no `og` key. The meta at build.cjs:75 is written only when o.og is set.
(4) Confirmed: pre-match OG images print «<day> بتوقيت الإمارات» (build.cjs:542). m-6052085 now shows «مباشر 0-0» because the match is live.
(5) Both OG images are served with cache-control max-age=60 at a fixed URL (/og/m-<id>.png).
findings.corrected:
[medium] Match link previews lag the result, home has no preview, and pre-match cards hard-code UAE time.
- Lag: the OG image and page do rebuild after full time, but only on the next build cycle. For 6052084 that was about 40 minutes (whistle 17:53, image rebuilt 18:35 showing «انتهت»). The «انتهت» label already exists at build.cjs:542, so the fix is only the trigger. When the poller sees the status turn finished (and on each goal), rebuild that match's page and its m-<id> OG job right away.
- Cache: the image URL is fixed, so WhatsApp and X keep whichever version they fetched first. Add a version suffix to the og:image URL, for example ?v=<status>-<score>, so a share after full time is fetched fresh.
- Missing previews: add og:image to / (a today card) and to /national/xx/. Neither has one; the page() call at build.cjs:374 passes no og key.
- Time label: pre-match cards say «بتوقيت الإمارات» on a site aimed at all Arabs. Either drop the timezone words and print the time with a GMT+4 tag, or add Mecca time (GMT+3) next to it.

findings.title: Distance widget shows driving time to Jeddah
findings.evidence: next_live_390_full_feat (Bahrain–UAE in Jeddah) shows «المسافة من دبي 1687 كم، حوالي 1125 دقيقة سواقة». `render.js:228` checks only `venue.distance_km`, although live.json carries `venue.in_uae:false`.
findings.proposal: Render the row only when `md.venue.in_uae && country()==="AE"`, and hide it otherwise.
findings.verified: Code: src/render.js:228-229 gates the «المسافة من» row only on `md.venue && md.venue.distance_km`, with no check for `in_uae`. src/app.js:222 fills «حوالي N دقيقة سواقة» from `k/90*60`, and for 1686.9 km that gives about 1125 minutes, which matches the claim. Live page: curl of https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/6052085/ contains the distance row with data-km values from Abu Dhabi 1583.5 to Dubai 1686.9 to Fujairah 1789.9 km. Live data: /v1/live.json has venue Alinma Bank Stadium, Jeddah, `in_uae:false`, and `name_ar:null`. The claim is confirmed. It also misses a second broken spot: src/stats.js:334 uses the same `distance_km` gate to print «اطلع من بيتك الساعة …». In app.js:222 that leave time is kickoff minus (drive time + 45 min), so for Jeddah it tells people to leave home about 19.5 hours before kickoff.
findings.corrected: Confirmed [broken/medium]. For away venues like Jeddah (in_uae:false), both the «المسافة من» distance/driving-time row (render.js:228) and the «اطلع من بيتك الساعة» leave-time row (stats.js:334) are shown. Both are gated only on venue.distance_km, so they give a 1125-minute drive and a leave time about 19.5 h before kickoff. Fix: gate both on `md.venue.in_uae` at build time. Add a runtime check for visitors in the AE country (a hide class toggled in app.js) if wanted, but in_uae is the key fix. Better still, stop emitting distance_km for venues outside the UAE in the data pipeline.

findings.title: My team's match loses the hero and the card to other matches
findings.evidence: next_home_390_feat: Yemen–Qatar at 56' fills the hero, and «تابع المباراة» points there. The visitor's own Bahrain–UAE, 45 minutes away, is one small line. In `v3.js:96`, live +1000 beats mine +500, and finished −10 drops my result at the final whistle. `app.js:88` shows `t.last` only when there is no `t.next`, so right after the final whistle the card jumps to the next fixture.
findings.proposal:
New hero order:
1. My team: live, 90 minutes or less to kickoff, or up to 6 hours after the final whistle.
2. My national team, in the same window.
3. Other live matches, which stay in the «مباشر الحين» rail.

For 24 hours after the final whistle, the «فريقك» card puts the result first (score, «ليش هالنتيجة؟», «صورة للستوري») with the next match below. On matchday, from the morning, the hero is my match with the channel in my country (bc data). Item 388 decides that the hero shows one match; this decides which one.

findings.title: PWA install (353) approved but not live
findings.evidence: The live home has no `<link rel=manifest>`. /manifest.webmanifest, /manifest.json, /apple-touch-icon.png and /favicon.ico all return 404. Only favicon.svg and theme-color are present. /sw.js is live, so offline support already works.
findings.proposal:
Ship `manifest.webmanifest`:
- name تيفو, `start_url` "/?src=app", display standalone, background/theme #0A2620.
- Icons at 192 and 512, plus maskable versions from the 3x3 mark.
- Shortcuts «مباشر الحين» and «اليوم».

Add a 180px apple-touch-icon. Show the install ask only after a trigger (the 2nd visit, or right after «هذا فريقي»), never on first load. On iOS, show a one-line sheet instead: «شارك ← أضف للشاشة الرئيسية».

findings.title: Replace «من آخر زيارة» with a daily card for everyone
findings.evidence: `app.js:278-283` renders only when favourites exist and more than 3 hours have passed, and covers only club results and rank moves. Visitors with no favourites or on a first visit get nothing, and there is no «what's next». The home «فريقك» shows only a text instruction (next_home_390_full_feat).
findings.proposal:
On the first open of each day (`tifo.lastday` is not today), show one dismissible card above the rails:
- Yesterday's result for my team, my national team and followed players.
- Today's match for them, with the time and the channel in my country.
- One «هذا اليوم» line.

With no favourites, fall back to the country's national team and league. «×» hides it until tomorrow. Add a «جديد» dot on rows that finished since the last visit. The same text can later feed the WhatsApp morning post (382).

findings.title: «My players» doesn't exist although favourites claim it
findings.evidence: `app.js:46` says favourites hold «clubs and players», but every reader filters `t==="team"` (`app.js:84,158,279,285,301,308`). The player page has no follow control (next_player_390_s3c). The data is there: `/v1/player/{id}.json` has `form` `[[match,date,rating,min,g,a]]` (SCHEMA:257).
findings.proposal: Add an «تابعه» text toggle on the player hero (dune when on) that saves favs `{t:"p"}`. The «فريقك» rail gets a player row: last rating, goals/assists, and his club's next match. The daily card gets lines like «دجيكو سجّل أمس، تقييمه 7.8». This matters most for Arabs abroad (fans of Salah, Mahrez and similar players).

findings.title: Match share sheet has 12 actions; cut to one primary
findings.evidence: feat_pcard_list.png: share page, story, second screen, cinema, player card, embed, majlis, creator kit, 3 sized images and section image, plus copy link. This goes against DESIGN-v3's «one primary per area» rule and the owner's «مب سباقيتي».
findings.proposal: At the top, one large «أرسل النتيجة» that picks the image by state (before kickoff a matchday card, while live the score, after the final whistle the story) and sends image and link in one share. Below it, two options: «بطاقة لاعب» and «انسخ الرابط». Everything else goes into a folded «أدوات أكثر».

findings.title: Swap «الأسبوع» for «فريقي» in the bottom nav
findings.evidence: DESIGN-v3.md:47 fixes the bottom nav as اليوم·البطولات·المنتخبات·الأسبوع·المزيد. /week/ is a curated list that covers only the UAE (next_week_390_s36) and duplicates the day arrows. There is no one-tap path to my team from any page.
findings.proposal: The 4th slot becomes «فريقي», with my team's crest as the icon (dune underline). It opens /t/{mine}/, or the 403 crest grid when no team is set. /week/ moves into المزيد.

findings.title: /thisday/ opens on 2 يناير, not today
findings.evidence: next_thisday_390_s36 starts at «2 يناير», so 27 سبتمبر is about 270 sections down. `build.cjs:640` renders every mm-dd in sorted order.
findings.proposal: Prerender today's block first, titled «اليوم، 27 سبتمبر», with a «بكرة» teaser. The client jumps to today's anchor if the cached copy is from an earlier day. Link it from the daily card.

findings.title: Un-defer a solo local «توقعك» (not the league)
findings.evidence: Before kickoff, the match body says «المباراة ما بدت.» (next_live_390_full_feat), so there is nothing to do there. Deferred item 10 is a group league with links and accounts.
findings.proposal: One tap before kickoff (فوز/تعادل/فوز), stored in localStorage only, with no points, odds or betting language. After the final whistle: «توقعك طلع صح». «فريقك» shows «صح 7 من 10 هالموسم». The case for un-deferring: zero backend, and it gives fans a reason to open before kickoff and again after the final whistle.

findings.title: Live score in the tab title and app badge
findings.evidence: src/ has no `document.title` or `setAppBadge` (grep). Phone users switch between WhatsApp and Tifo, and the recents card shows a static title.
findings.proposal: While a match is live on the match page, set `document.title` to «1-0 · 67' البحرين ضد الإمارات». Once installed, `navigator.setAppBadge(n)` shows how many of my teams are live.

findings.title: Un-defer push (6) once the PWA ships
findings.evidence: The goal toast (`app.js:284`) fires only while a Tifo tab is open. The poller already detects goals every 20s.
findings.proposal: Web Push (Android Chrome, and installed PWAs on iOS 16.4+), per team only, with three toggles: بداية، هدف، نهاية. The case for un-deferring: it is the reason to install, and it is what keeps FotMob and 365Scores on the home screen.

findings.title: WhatsApp channel (349) approved, not linked anywhere
findings.evidence: The live home has no whatsapp link (grep). The only opt-in is the weekly email at /newsletter/, which is weak for Arab phone users.
findings.proposal: Once the owner creates the channel, add one «تابع تيفو على واتساب» line in the «فريقك» empty state, the footer and the post-match card. The channel posts full-time story images with the link.

findings.title: «موسمي»: a local season record with no streak nagging
findings.evidence: Nothing records what a fan followed. Share cards exist per match only.
findings.proposal: localStorage counts matches of my team opened live for 10 minutes or more, and the goals seen. «فريقك» shows «تابعت 9 من 11 مباراة للعين هالموسم», and a monthly card «شهري مع العين» can be shared. No loss-streak warnings.

lenses.summary:
Arabic copy and RTL audit, read-only. I looked at the 390px screenshots (home, match, live, comp, team, player, the 29 s36 templates and the 5 feat_* shots) and curled the live pages /, /m/6052085/ and /c/uae-pro-league/. I also scanned the built out/ HTML and grepped src/*.js, build.cjs and stadiums.yaml.

**What already works**
- RTL mirroring is right in the places I checked:
  - the event timeline runs 0→90 right-to-left
  - transfer arrows read «سانتوس ← الشارقة»
  - day-switcher chevrons point the right way
  - goal difference is bdi-isolated («-1» renders correctly)
  - the lab axis «← أكثر» matches its caption
- Western digits and Arabic month names are used almost everywhere, and no feminine address forms turned up.

**What is broken, in impact order**
1. Arabic number agreement is wrong everywhere. There is no plural helper («4 مباراة»، «2 تبديلات»، «3 يوم»، «1 مرات»).
2. «ال نهيان / ال مكتوم» is missing the madda on the ruling families' names, on stadium rows.
3. Club names get truncated so badly on phones that you can't tell them apart.
4. The AI preview copy on tonight's match page has defects, and the «مباراة الليلة» title shows on matches that aren't tonight.
5. UAE-first copy («منتخبنا»، «بتوقيت الإمارات»، «إمارتك») contradicts the pan-Arab decision.
6. Some Latin text isn't covered by items 387–403:
   - coaches and stadiums
   - positions and nationality codes
   - «Law 11»
   - the /memorable/ score cards
7. Formats are inconsistent:
   - ISO dates
   - a 12-hour «07:42 م» stamp
   - «المجموعة B»
   - «لـال»
   - the owner-forbidden «ووش»

**Overlaps and notes**
- The duplicate countdown in the hero overlaps with item «one match in home hero». The «في 60 ثانية» / «شارك وأدوات» labels overlap with «one primary button per area», so I didn't re-propose them.
- The lexicon's `_prep_fi` («فالشارقة») and ج→ي rules were written for film scripts before TTS. I didn't apply them to web copy; that needs the owner's call.
- out/ was being rebuilt during the audit, so some file paths may have moved. The URL and src line references still hold.

There are 20+ before→after rewrites spread across the proposals below.

findings.title: Bidi bugs: compare select and the minute mark in cinema mode
findings.evidence:
- next_compare_390_s36 selects show «( Nicolás Giménez» and «Adeel Al Chadli (يو»: the parentheses flip and the text is cut. `<bdi>` doesn't work inside `<option>`.
- feat_cinema: «′91 هدف», with the prime on the wrong side. The timeline shows «10'» correctly.
findings.proposal:
Options: put the Arabic first with no brackets («خيمينيز · الوصل»), or wrap the Latin name in U+2068…U+2069.

In the cinema overlay, wrap the minute in `<bdi dir=ltr>` the same way the timeline does.
findings.verified:
The claim is half right. The compare bug is real. The cinema bug is not.

Compare select, confirmed:
- In next_compare_390_s36.png the selects read «( Nicolás Giménez» and «Adeel Al Chadli (يو». The brackets are flipped and the Arabic club name is cut off.
- The cause is src/compare.js:14. It builds each option as `R.esc(name) + " (" + name_ar + ")"`. That puts a Latin name first inside an RTL select, so the brackets flip, and the club name is what gets cut off.
- The live file /assets/compare.235c403a26.js has the same code.

Cinema minute, refuted:
- src/shell.js:186 in cineDraw already wraps the minute as `<bdi dir="ltr">' + R.esc(ev.minute) + "'</bdi>`. It came in with commit 2026-09-27 21:18, which was before the screenshot was taken (22:26).
- The live /assets/shell.235c403a26.js contains the same bdi.
- A zoomed crop of feat_cinema.png shows «91'» at the right edge of the line, read first in RTL, with the mark after the digits. That is the correct order.
- The auditor's proposal to "wrap it in bdi like the timeline" is already done.
findings.corrected: [broken/medium] Only the compare select has a bidi bug. In src/compare.js:14 each option is built as «Latin name (Arabic club)». In the RTL select this shows as «( Nicolás Giménez» and «Adeel Al Chadli (يو» (next_compare_390_s36): the brackets flip and the club name is cut off. Fix: drop the brackets and put the Arabic first, for example «الوصل · Nicolás Giménez». Or wrap the name in U+2068…U+2069, since <bdi> doesn't work inside <option>. It would be better still to use the Arabic player name once it exists. The cinema minute is already wrapped in <bdi dir=ltr> (src/shell.js:186) and shows correctly as «91'» in feat_cinema. No change needed there.

findings.title: Arabic number–noun agreement is wrong site-wide (no plural helper)
findings.evidence:
Examples:
- Home: «4 مباراة مباشرة الحين» (app.js:69); streak rail «6 مباراة», «5 مباراة».
- Match timeline: «2 تبديلات» (v3.js:52, rx.js:51).
- next_countdowns_390_s36: «3 يوم 02:27» (app.js:182, :326).
- /m/6052085/ FAQ: «فاز البحرين 1 مرات… وتعادلوا 2 مرات» (stats.js:527); «(1 أهداف)», «0 تبديلات».
- Comp champion line: «28 فوز و 2 تعادل و 4 خسارة» (stats.js:612); «إيقاف 2 مباراة»; «العين 14 مباريات».
- Team page: «5 مرة» (stats.js:577).
- glossary.js:33: «ثلاث أهداف».
The owner's own rule is EMIRATI-LEXICON `_count_plural`.
findings.proposal:
Add `R.n(k, one, two, few, many)` in render.js with these rules:
- 1 → «مرة وحدة / مباراة وحدة»
- 2 → dual
- 3–10 → plural
- 11+ → singular
- 0 → «ولا هدف» or hide

Use it in every prose or inline count. Leave stat-tile labels as they are.

Rewrites:
- «4 مباراة مباشرة الحين» → «4 مباريات مباشرة الحين»
- «2 تبديلات» → «تبديلين»
- «3 يوم» → «3 أيام»
- «فاز البحرين 1 مرات… وتعادلوا 2 مرات» → «فاز البحرين مرة وحدة، والإمارات 5 مرات، وتعادلوا مرتين»
- «28 فوز و 2 تعادل و 4 خسارة» → «28 فوز وتعادلين و4 خسارات»
- «ثلاث أهداف» → «ثلاثة أهداف»

findings.title: Ruling-family names misspelled: «ال نهيان», «ال مكتوم»
findings.evidence: stadiums.yaml:33, 43 and 75 contain «استاد ال مكتوم», «استاد ال نهيان» and «استاد حمدان بن راشد ال مكتوم». These show on roughly 170 match pages, e.g. /m/1000020522/ «الملعب: استاد ال نهيان» (next_match_390_full_feat, details box).
findings.proposal:
Change the three names to:
- «استاد آل نهيان»
- «استاد آل مكتوم»
- «استاد حمدان بن راشد آل مكتوم»

Add a build check that fails on /\bال [^\s]/ in stadium and club names.

findings.title: Long club names truncate so badly on phones that you can't tell them apart
findings.area: match rows, rail cards, h2h, referee
findings.evidence:
- next_referee_390_s36: «مانشستر يونا…» next to «مانشستر سيـ…».
- next_h2h_390_s36: a two-team derby page where every row reads «الترجـ…» / «النادي …».
- next_home_390_full_s3c and next_today_390_s36: «المغرب التطو…», «المغربي الفا…».
- Latin names cut from the wrong end: «…dad Temara».
- R.tname (render.js:16) has no short form.
findings.proposal:
Add a `short_ar` field to teams and an `R.sname(t)` helper next to render.js:16. Use it in matchRow, rail cards and h2h rows; keep full names in heroes.

Seed list:
- مانشستر يونايتد → مان يونايتد
- مانشستر سيتي → مان سيتي
- الترجي التونسي → الترجي
- النادي الأفريقي → الإفريقي
- المغرب التطواني → التطواني
- المغرب الفاسي → الماص
- الوداد الرياضي → الوداد

Also give `.lat` `direction:ltr; unicode-bidi:isolate` so Latin names cut at the end.

findings.title: AI match previews: wrong «الليلة» title, false facts and clumsy phrasing on tonight's page
findings.evidence:
- build.cjs:487 hardcodes «مباراة الليلة في 60 ثانية». It also shows on /m/6040346/, which is «الاثنين 28 سبتمبر».
- /m/6052085/ (Bahrain v UAE, tonight):
  - «قوة الأول منتخب البحرين يبا يستغل أرضه» uses a vague label, and the venue is neutral (in Saudi)
  - «فوزه رقم 2» and «فاز عليهم 1 مرة بس»
  - «مفتاح المباراة مفتاح المباراة حق الإمارات» repeats its own label
  - «التوقع مب متوفرة نسب توقعات رسمية من تيفو الحين»
  - «يأكد»
- /m/6040346/: «برصيد 1 نقطة».
findings.proposal:
Title the card by date with R.dayLabel: «المباراة في 60 ثانية». Label the sections with team names: «قوة الأول» → «وين قوة البحرين».

Add prompt rules plus a post-filter:
- «1 مرة / 1 نقطة» → «مرة وحدة / نقطة وحدة»
- «فوزه رقم 2» → «فوزه الثاني»
- strip a line that starts by repeating its own label
- no «أرضه» when the venue is neutral

When there are no probabilities, drop the «التوقع» line instead of saying «مب متوفرة».

findings.title: Pan-Arab site, UAE-first copy
findings.area: home rail:tifo, week, ask, cast, match details, countdown
findings.evidence:
- Home rail:tifo card: «هذا اليوم في كورة الإمارات… منتخبنا». Every visitor sees it.
- next_week_390_s36: «بتوقيت الإمارات: مباريات الإمارات أول», while the footer says «المواعيد بتوقيت بلدك».
- AI preview for Tunisia v Botswana: «23:00 بتوقيت الإمارات».
- next_ask_390_s36: «عن الدوري الإماراتي والمنتخب».
- next_cast_390_s36: «من دورينا».
- Match details: «المسافة من [إمارتك]» for all countries (render.js:229).
- The countdown is hardcoded to team 5789 (app.js:177), with «المنتخب يلعب الحين».
findings.proposal:
Rewrites:
- «منتخبنا» → «منتخب الإمارات»
- «بتوقيت الإمارات: مباريات الإمارات أول» → «بتوقيت بلدك، ومباريات بلدك أول»

Also:
- Show the distance row only when country() is AE.
- Drive the countdown and the «المنتخب» shortcut from the visitor's country → national team id.
- Tell the AI prompts to write times as «بتوقيت بلدك», or leave them out.

findings.title: «آخر تحديث 07:42 م»: 12-hour clock and fixed Dubai time
findings.evidence:
- next_home_390_full_s3c: «آخر تحديث 07:42 م».
- next_comp_390_full_s3c: «01:48 م».

findings.proposal:
Pass `{hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit', hourCycle:'h23', timeZone:R.TZ}`.

Rewrite: «آخر تحديث 07:42 م» → «آخر تحديث 19:42».

findings.title: «لـال…» joined wrongly (should be «لل…»)
findings.evidence:
