lenses.summary:
I audited accessibility and phone usability on the live site using the screenshots, curl of the home, match, ask, newsletter and 404 pages, and the code. Colour contrast on night is strong: body text on the page ground is 9 to 15:1. Reduced motion is handled well.

The biggest risks are how the site behaves on a weak network during a live match:
- On the match page, one failed request stops the 20-second live updates for good. The score stays frozen and nothing on screen says the data is old.
- On the home page, one failed day request replaces the correct match list with «ما في مباريات في هاليوم.».

On a 390px phone:
- The live score chip is hard to read: 3.4:1 contrast, and the minute is 10.5px.
- Team names in match lists get cut to the same few letters, so two different clubs look alike.
- On tonight's pre-match page, the fifth match tab is cut off.
- The distance row shows «1125 دقيقة سواقة» for a match in Jeddah.

For screen readers:
- The home and match pages have no h1.
- Scores have no spoken label, so «0 - 1» can be read as "minus".
- Nothing is announced when a goal goes in.

The forms (ask, newsletter) have several gaps:
- On iPhone, the page zooms in when you tap a field, because the text is under 16px.
- On the ask page, the mic button sits on its own row and looks like a second empty text field.
- No box announces results or errors to screen readers.

Install as an app (item 353) was approved but is not live: the manifest returns 404. The service worker has no offline page.

Smaller items:
- Several labels are 10.5 to 11.5px, too small for older fans.
- Some "see all" links and the footer links are small to tap.
- Background focus is not locked while a sheet is open.
- The 404 page is a dead end.
- Two home-page copy slips: «4 مباراة» and «وش».

I did not re-propose any of items 387–403. Item 12 touches the home hero, which the design agent is working on.

findings.title: Live score stops updating after one failed request, with no sign it is stale
findings.evidence: app.js:144-152: match() re-arms poll(match,20e3) only inside .then; .catch at :152 swallows the error and never polls again. Home: index() has no catch, so run().catch at app.js:351 kills the first-load poll too. sw.js LIVE branch serves the cached match/live JSON as a 200 when offline, so frozen data looks fresh. The only freshness cue is «آخر تحديث» in the footer (next_home_390_full_feat, bottom).
findings.proposal: In both .catch paths call poll(fn, backoff) (20s, then 40s, then 60s cap). In the hero kicker or mini-bar, show «الاتصال ضعيف · آخر تحديث 22:14» when a match is live and now − md.generated > 90s (use generated, not fetch success), and dim the live chip to stone until fresh data arrives.
findings.verified:
Compared the live bundle /assets/app.235c403a26.js with ~/workspace/saas/football/site/src/app.js; they are identical. Also read src/sw.js and the footer markup in build.cjs:85. I did not open the screenshots; the footer was confirmed from build.cjs and a curl of /m/6052085/.
(1) app.js:146-152: match() calls poll(match,20e3) only inside .then (line 151). The .catch at :152 is empty, so after one rejected get("match/ID.json") (5xx/403, a network error with no cached copy, or a JSON parse error) nothing re-arms the poll. Confirmed.
(2) app.js:52-53: poll() sets `timer` and never resets it to null. The visibilitychange handler re-runs run() when `timer` is set. So after a mid-match failure, locking and unlocking the phone or switching tabs brings polling back. If the page stays in the foreground it stays frozen.
(3) Home, app.js:61: day/ and live.json each have their own .catch. Only index() (:56) has none, and it is memoised in INDEX after the first success. So home dies only when index.json fails on the very first load; the run().catch at :351 swallows that, and because `timer` is still null, visibilitychange cannot revive it. A home page that loaded once keeps polling.
(4) sw.js:15-16: the LIVE branch goes network-first and falls back to the cached copy only when fetch throws (offline). Offline therefore does not kill polling, because the request resolves. The cached JSON keeps its old `generated`, so stamp() (app.js:50) shows the old time. The data is not disguised as fresh, but the only cue is the footer «آخر تحديث» (build.cjs:85, id="updated"). Nothing in the hero or live chip shows staleness.
findings.corrected:
[broken/high] The claim is partly true. On the match page, one failed match JSON request (HTTP error, parse error, or offline with no cached copy) stops the 20s live refresh for good while the page stays in the foreground (app.js:151-152). Polling only resumes after the viewer backgrounds and returns to the tab (visibilitychange, app.js:53). On the home page, polling dies only if index.json fails on the very first load (index() at app.js:56 has no catch, and run().catch at :351 swallows it). After one successful load, home keeps polling, because day/live have their own catches. Offline does NOT stop polling: the SW (sw.js:15-16) serves the cached copy and polling continues. That copy carries its old `generated` time, so the footer «آخر تحديث» (build.cjs:85) does show the old time. The real gap is that this footer is the only freshness cue, and nothing near the score or live chip tells the viewer the data is stale. Fix:
- Re-arm poll(match, backoff) in the .catch at :152 (20s, then 40s, capped at 60s).
- Add .catch(poll) to home's first load.
- Show «الاتصال ضعيف · آخر تحديث HH:MM» in the hero or mini-bar, and dim the live chip, when the match is live and now − md.generated > 90s.

findings.title: A failed day fetch wipes the home list to «ما في مباريات»
findings.evidence: app.js:61 catches the day fetch as {matches:[]}. app.js:68 then set('#day', dayList([])), which overwrites the correct prerendered list with «ما في مباريات في هاليوم.». The poll also drops to 120s (app.js:74) because ms is empty. On a weak stadium signal or a CloudFront 5xx, fans are told there are no matches.
findings.proposal: Make the catch return null. If day is null, keep the existing #day DOM untouched, put «ما قدرنا نحدّث، نحاول مرة ثانية…» in #livecount, and re-poll at 30s. Only render the empty state after a successful fetch that really has 0 matches.
findings.verified:
I confirmed the claim in the source and in the live bundle.
- src/app.js:61: a failed day fetch is caught as {matches:[]}. The live file /assets/app.235c403a26.js has the same code.
- src/app.js:68: the page then runs set("#day", R.dayList(ms, …, {empty:"ما في مباريات في هاليوم."})) with nothing to show. That overwrites the list already built into the page (curl of / shows #day holding the Gulf Cup group B block with «1 مباشر»).
- src/app.js:74: with no live matches and no day matches, polling drops to 120 s.
- src/sw.js: for /v1/day/ it only serves a saved copy when the network fails outright AND a copy was saved earlier. A CloudFront 5xx still reaches get(), which throws on !r.ok and hits the catch. A first visit with a dropped connection has no saved copy either.
- run() (app.js:351) calls home() on load, so this happens on the first hydrate, not only on later polls.
findings.corrected:
The claim holds, with three additions:
1. The service worker covers one case only: a returning visitor with no connection at all, who already has a saved copy of today's file. A 5xx, or a first visit on a weak signal, still gets the empty state.
2. The same catch-to-empty pattern is at app.js:191 (the today/TV list) and should get the same fix.
3. If index() fails, Promise.all rejects and run() swallows the error. The list is not wiped, but poll() is never set again, so live refresh stops silently until the page is reloaded or the tab becomes visible again.

The fix: make the catch return null. If day is null, leave #day as it is, show «ما قدرنا نحدّث، نحاول مرة ثانية…» in #livecount, and poll again in 30 s. Only show the empty state when a successful fetch really has 0 matches. Also schedule the next poll when home() rejects.

findings.title: Distance row gives a 1125-minute drive to an away match
findings.evidence: next_live_390_full_feat «تفاصيل المباراة»: «المسافة من دبي 1687 كم · حوالي 1125 دقيقة سواقة» for the Jeddah stadium. The #msum JSON has venue.in_uae:false. render.js:228 only checks distance_km, and the emirate picker is shown to visitors from every Arab country.
findings.proposal: Gate render.js:228 on md.venue.in_uae && md.venue.distance_km. In app.js dist(), hide .dist unless country()==='AE'. For non-UAE venues show only «الملعب: … ، جدة».
findings.verified: Ran curl on the live page https://tifo.elyoxe.com/m/6052085/. The venue JSON is {"name_en":"Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Sports City Stadium","city":"Jeddah","emirate":null,"in_uae":false}, and the rendered HTML has 1687 inside the .dist emirate picker. src/render.js:228 checks only `md.venue && md.venue.distance_km` and never looks at in_uae. src/app.js:219-223 dist() works out the time as k/90*60 rounded to the nearest 5: 1687/90*60 = 1124.7, so the page shows «حوالي 1125 دقيقة سواقة». dist() has no country or in_uae gate. The claim holds. One addition: the .leave[data-kick] "time to leave" logic in dist() comes from the same distance, but this page has no .leave element, so it does not show here.
findings.corrected: Confirmed as stated. For the fix, put the gate at render time (render.js:228: `md.venue && md.venue.in_uae && md.venue.distance_km`). Then a Jeddah or any other non-UAE venue shows only «الملعب: … ، جدة», and there's no .dist element left for app.js dist() to fill. The extra app.js check for country()==='AE' is optional, and only matters if we want to hide the picker from non-UAE visitors at UAE venues too.

findings.title: Live score chip fails contrast and its minute is 10.5px
findings.evidence: next_home_390_full_feat list shows «56' 0-0» and «50' 0-0» in white on #10A04B: 3.41:1. The minute <small> is .66rem (10.5px) in #E4F8EC: 3.08:1 (tifo.css:86-91, v3.css:184). Mini-bar minute is also .66rem (v3.css:105). Form guide letters are .6rem, and D is white on #9BA39E at 2.58:1 (tifo.css:120-121; v3 only overrides .L at v3.css:286).
findings.proposal: Keep the green fill but use night text: .v3 .chip.live,.v3 .chip.live small{color:#0A2620} (4.69:1); chip small and .mini .ms small at .75rem/600. Form: .form i 1.25rem with .72rem letters. D becomes #2A3833 fill with chalk text, and W becomes chalk fill with night text (also stops W reusing the live-only green).

findings.title: Team names in match lists are cut to the same few letters
findings.evidence: next_home_390_full_feat: «المغرب التطو…» and «المغربي الفا…» are indistinguishable. next_week_390_full_s36: «الكوكب المراك…», «النادي المكنا…», «…idad Temara». Cause: tifo.css:79 .m grid 1fr 4.2rem 1fr plus :82 nowrap/ellipsis.
findings.proposal: <420px: .m .t span{white-space:normal;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;line-height:1.3}, .m .t img.logo 1.4rem, .m{align-items:center}. Two lines of a full club name beat one ambiguous line.

findings.title: Fifth match tab is clipped at 390 on pre-match pages
findings.evidence: next_live_390_feat (tonight's Bahrain v UAE page): the tab bar reads «قبل المباراة · التشكيلة · الإحصائيات · التحليل · المواجها», with the last tab cut at the screen edge. v3.css:318 only shrinks the font; its comment promises an edge fade that does not exist.
findings.proposal: <420px: .mtabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)} .mtabs button{padding-inline:.15rem;font-size:.78rem;white-space:normal;line-height:1.25;text-align:center}. Or rename «قبل المباراة» to «قبلها» in the build.cjs tab list. All 5 tabs must be visible without scrolling.

findings.title: Screen readers: scores may be read as «minus» and goals are never announced
findings.evidence: render.js:78 (matchRow) and v3.js:75 (rail card) output a bare «0 - 1» and «86'» with no label. aria-live count = 0 on / and /m/6052085/ (curl). goalMoment (shell.js:164-165) is visual only. .rail-s has tabindex=0 but no name (home.html). Latin .lat names have no lang.
findings.proposal: Add an aria-label on each match <a>, e.g. «اليمن 0، قطر 1، مباشر الدقيقة 86» or «البحرين ضد الإمارات، الساعة 22:00». Add one <div class=vh role=status aria-live=polite> and write to it ONLY on a goal («هدف للإمارات… الدقيقة 34») and at full time, never on every poll. .rail-s gets role=region plus aria-labelledby its h2. .lat gets lang=en.

findings.title: Home and match pages have no h1
findings.evidence: curl counts: / h1=0, /m/6052085/ h1=0, /m/6052084/ h1=0. Team, comp, today, week and national each have 1. Screen-reader heading navigation has no top level on the two most-used templates, and search engines get no page title heading.
findings.proposal:
Match hero:

البحرين ضد الإمارات، كأس الخليج العربي، الجولة 2

before .board (or make the board's team line the h1). Home:

نتايج مباريات اليوم مباشر

in the hero. Both are build.cjs template changes.

findings.title: Forms: iPhone zooms on focus, mic looks like an empty field, results not announced
findings.evidence: body is .97rem, about 15.5px (tifo.css:14), and .ask input (tifo.css:413, used by both forms) and .dist select (.85rem, :407) are under 16px, so iOS Safari zooms. next_ask_390_full_s36: the mic (app.js:317) wraps to its own full-width row that looks like a 2nd text box, and the placeholder is truncated. Queries under 4 characters are ignored silently. #aska and #nlmsg are not live regions. The email input is RTL, has no autocomplete, and double-submit is possible.
findings.proposal: input,select,textarea{font-size:max(1rem,16px)}. .ask{grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto} so the mic sits as a 3rem square in the row. Add 4 tappable example chips under the ask box («آخر مرة فاز الوصل على العين؟»…). #aska and #nlmsg get role=status. Disable the button while sending. Email input: dir=ltr autocomplete=email enterkeyhint=send.

findings.title: Text too small for older fans; add a «خط أكبر» toggle
findings.evidence: Bottom tab labels .7rem, about 11px (v3.css:37). Rail competition line .72rem (v3.css:146). Crest grid country .72rem (v3.css:195). Table th .74rem. Day subtitle .75rem. Substitution lines .78rem in stone (next_match_390_full_feat, timeline). These are the labels people read at night.
findings.proposal: Set a floor of .78rem for every label (tabbar .78rem, .rc .cp .78rem, .ct small .78rem). New: a «خط أكبر» toggle in المزيد that sets html{font-size:112.5%} from localStorage via a 1-line inline head script, so there is no flash. The site is all rem, so it scales cleanly.

findings.title: Approved install-as-app (353) is not live, and there is no offline page
findings.evidence: ROADMAP 353 (approved 2026-09-27). /manifest.webmanifest and /manifest.json both return 404. home.html has no <link rel=manifest> and no apple-touch-icon. sw.js install precaches nothing, so an unvisited page opened offline shows the browser error screen.
findings.proposal: Add manifest.webmanifest (name تيفو, lang ar, dir rtl, display standalone, theme/background #0A2620, 192/512 icons of the mosaic mark, start_url /?src=app) and a 180px apple-touch-icon. In the SW install step, precache /offline/ plus the current CSS and JS. When a navigation fails with no cache hit, serve /offline/, listing the cached /m/ pages («بدون نت: هذي الصفحات اللي فتحتها قبل»).

findings.title: Home hero fills the phone screen; no scores above the fold
findings.evidence: next_home_390_feat: at 390x844 the viewport shows one match only, and the «مباشر الحين» rail title is hidden behind the tab bar. v3.css:55 sets .hhero{min-block-size:clamp(30rem,86svh,46rem)}. This does not duplicate items 387/388 (those change content, not height), but the design agent should be told.
findings.proposal: <880px: .hhero{min-block-size:min(64svh,34rem)} so the first live or today rail card peeks above the tab bar. Keep 86svh from 880px up.

findings.title: Search: Enter does nothing, offline failure is silent, results not announced
findings.evidence: app.js:35 builds the box as a bare <div> + <input> with no form, so the phone's Enter/Go key does nothing. The index fetch (app.js:37) has no catch, so offline the box stays blank. #sr results are not announced, and the box is not a dialog.
findings.proposal: Wrap it in <form role=search>, with input type=search enterkeyhint=search; submit opens the first hit. On catch show «ما قدرنا نحمّل البحث، تأكد من النت». #sr gets aria-live=polite with a count line («7 نتايج»).

findings.title: Keyboard: focus leaks out of open sheets; tabs have no arrow keys
findings.evidence: shell.js:17 open() focuses the first button, but Tab walks into the page behind the aria-modal sheet or panel. The country box (app.js:21-24) does not move focus. tabs() (app.js:51) has no arrow-key support or aria-controls. .rail-s (v3.css:131) is overflow-x:auto with no top padding, so the card focus ring is clipped.
findings.proposal: On open, set inert on main, header.top, footer and .tabbar; remove it in closeAll. Country box gets role=dialog and focuses its current button. In tabs(), ArrowLeft/Right move between tabs (RTL-aware) using a roving tabindex. .rail-s{padding-block:.35rem}.

findings.title: Small tap targets on «see all» links and footer links
findings.evidence: .more-l («مباريات اليوم», «مباريات بكرة», «كل البطولات») has padding 0 at .85rem, about 23px tall (v3.css:129). Footer links are .82rem, about 22px tall with .6rem row gaps (tifo.css:241-242; next_home_390_full_feat footer). The top-bar icons are 40px (v3.css:25).
findings.proposal: .more-l{padding-block:.7rem;margin-block:-.7rem}. Below 880px, show footer links as a 2-column list with rows at min-block-size 44px (fits with 396's 4-column footer on desktop). .ib 2.75rem.

findings.title: 404 page is a dead end
findings.evidence: curl /m/999999999/ returns 404 with only «الصفحة مب موجودة» and one link. Old shared match links and mistyped URLs land here with nothing useful.
findings.proposal: Prerender the 404 with a search input (same index), today's #day list and the «البطولات» crest grid, headed «ما لقينا هالصفحة، بس هذي مباريات اليوم».

findings.title: Home copy: «4 مباراة» and a forbidden «وش»
findings.evidence: app.js:69 writes «N مباراة مباشرة الحين» (next_home_390_full_feat shows «4 مباراة مباشرة الحين»). Editorial card e2 on home.html: «…ووش على المحك في الترتيب» uses وش, which the dialect rules forbid.
findings.proposal: Pluralise: n===1 «مباراة وحدة مباشرة», n===2 «مباراتين», 3-10 «N مباريات», 11+ «N مباراة». Change «ووش على المحك» to «وشو على المحك».
